title: Junior Service Desk Specialist
description:
We are looking for a Junior Service Desk Specialist to join our geo-distributed team in providing end-user support to EPAM’s clients. We support more than 20 clients across the globe, representing Healthcare, e-commerce, Retail, Travel, Technology, and other industries. Our team acts as a single point of contact for user requests and queries related to the applications and systems supported.

As a Junior Service Desk Specialist, you will undertake analysis, diagnosis, and resolution of tickets/incidents, which may range from straightforward questions to more complicated technical issues using ITIL best practices and a wide range of ticketing tools. The role also involves the initial processing of all types of service requests, proactive communication with businesses, and knowledge base updates.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as an entry point to all requests from EPAM employees
  • Provide timely request fulfillment according to the workflow (training and knowledge transfer will be provided)
  • Answer users’ questions via phone, email, and web app (knowledge base guide is constantly growing)
  • Communicate with other teams, including L2/L3 support, to guarantee correct request assignment and resolution

Requirements

  • Strong analytical and research skills, proactive approach to tasks and issues
  • Ability to work effectively in a team and think collaboratively, strong sense of personal responsibility and accountability
  • Stress resistance and ability to adapt to changes of a different kind
  • Readiness to work in shifts (night, early morning, and weekend shifts included)
  • Fluent in English (B2 or higher), excellent verbal and written skills, strong phone etiquette

Benefits

We connect like-minded people:

  • Delivering innovative solutions to industry leaders, making a global impact
  • Enjoyable working environment, whether it's the vibrant office or the comfort of your own home
  • Opportunity to work abroad for up to two months per year

We invest in your growth:

  • Leadership development, career advising, soft skills and well-being programs
  • Unlimited access to EPAM's internal learning database
  • Free English classes with certified teachers

We cover it all:

  • Comprehensive medical & family care package
  • Seven trust days per year (sick leave without a medical certificate)
  • Discounts from 800+ partners (sports activities, restaurants, stores and services)

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Role Overview We are seeking a Full Stack & AI Engineer to design, develop, deploy, and maintain secure, scalable, and high-performance applications across frontend, backend, cloud, and AI platforms. The role involves full-stack application development, maintenance of the Chatbook Application, and the development and integration of enterprise-grade AI solutions.

Key Responsibilities Full Stack Application Development Design, develop, deploy, and maintain secure, scalable, and high-performance web applications across frontend, backend, and cloud platforms. Ensure application quality, performance, security, reliability, and maintainability through modern software engineering practices. Work in an Agile and DevOps-driven environment, applying CI/CD, automation, testing, and secure development practices. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable and production-ready software solutions.

Chatbook Application Maintenance Take ownership of the Chatbook Application following knowledge transfer. Provide ongoing application maintenance, enhancements, performance optimisation, troubleshooting, and incident resolution. Ensure application stability, reliability, and continuous improvement.

Solution Development & Integration Design and implement AI-powered solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), agentic frameworks, and Model Context Protocol (MCP)-based integrations. Develop enterprise AI workflows and production-ready AI applications. Implement monitoring, observability, evaluation, and guardrails for AI solutions. Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and production-ready AI solutions.

Requirements Education Degree or Diploma in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.

AI & Agentic Engineering Hands-on experience building AI agents and multi-agent systems using frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph, AutoGen, or CrewAI. Strong understanding of agentic design patterns, including planning, tool use, memory, and reflection. Experience with MCP-based tool integrations and maintaining GenAI and agentic applications in production environments. Experience implementing AI guardrails, application evaluation, and production monitoring. Knowledge of LLMOps practices, including prompt management, model evaluation, LLM observability tools such as LangSmith or similar platforms, AI governance, and responsible AI principles.

Software Engineering Strong software engineering fundamentals, including clean code, design patterns, automated testing, REST API development, containerisation, container orchestration, CI/CD pipelines, and Git-based version control. Proficiency in Next.js, React, Python, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. Strong experience with relational and NoSQL databases, including query optimisation, schema design, and data management. Familiarity with vector databases for RAG and semantic search. Knowledge of secure software development practices, including authentication and authorisation, API security, secrets management, and OWASP best practices.

Cloud & Infrastructure Hands-on experience with AWS cloud services, including Lambda, API Gateway, S3, CloudWatch, and IAM. Experience with AWS Bedrock for accessing and orchestrating foundation models such as Anthropic Claude. Familiarity with AWS Bedrock capabilities such as Knowledge Bases, Agents, and Guardrails for production-grade generative AI applications. Experience developing and deploying applications on Government Commercial Cloud (GCC) is an advantage.

title: Associate Director, Diagnostic Partnerships, Oncology
description:
Location: Barcelona - Spain (3 days working from the office and 2 days working from home)

Are you ready to make a significant impact in the world of oncology diagnostics? As the Associate Director, Diagnostic Partnerships within the Oncology Business Unit, you will play a pivotal role in delivering the Global Diagnostics (GDx) mission of shaping the patient testing landscape and ensuring no patient is left behind. Reporting to the Senior Director, Diagnostic Partnerships, you will lead key partnership activities within GDx; your expertise will be crucial in refining business needs, engaging with prospective diagnostic partners, and collaborating on scoping, negotiation, and contracting. Are you prepared to take on this challenge and lead partnerships initiatives that deliver diagnostic solutions in-market?

Accountabilities

  • Shape GDx projects towards meeting business requirements, fitting into overarching strategies while considering cost, quality and timeline requirements.

  • Develop and manage relationships with external diagnostic partners and potential partners in a compliant and professional manner, ensuring AstraZeneca is regarded as a partner of choice by third parties.

  • Lead specific schedules of work according to project needs, owning the deal process and aligning with cross-functional colleagues to support execution.

  • Ensure post-contract activities are successfully completed with optimal handover of solutions to wider GDx colleagues for implementation.

  • Work with Business Development colleagues in the negotiation, contracting and deal-closing processes for enterprise-wide agreements.

  • Ensure that diagnostic partnering opportunities are evaluated thoroughly and objectively with ownership of certain due diligence processes.

  • Present partnering opportunities to the oncology business effectively and efficiently.

  • Build personal networks to aid early identification of relevant partnering opportunities and efficient delivery of partnership projects.

  • Attend key external scientific congresses to identify partnership opportunities and nurture existing relationships.

  • Work collaboratively and flexibly to accommodate projects which arise from varied parts of the business.

  • Provide broader diagnostics teams with inputs and expertise according to personal domain and partnerships knowledge.

  • Support or lead in building business cases for specific partnerships projects.

  • Report on project activities and achievements to senior management, feed into OBU updates as appropriate.

  • Positively develop, manage and maintain stakeholder relationships with colleagues across Oncology Business Unit, Business Development, Legal, Compliance, in-country diagnostic teams, R&D, and other cross-functional colleagues as needed.

Essential Skills/Experience

  • Post-graduate level education in a relevant subject (e.g. Masters/MBA/MSc or above)

  • +5 years of relevant contracting, business development, strategy, consulting and/or pharma/diagnostic partnership experience

  • Knowledge of pharmaceutical and diagnostic company businesses, processes and activities

  • Knowledge of scientific, commercial and financial evaluation techniques

  • An understanding of governance procedures relevant to deal progression and business development work (CDAs, agreement structures, delegation of authorities, due diligence processes, etc.)

  • Analytical skills and ability to ascertain the relevant issues from large volumes of information

  • Interpersonal and teamwork skills, demonstrating flexibility and a proven ability to deal with complexity under time pressure and contribute skills to deliver projects

  • Experience and effectiveness in the presentation of written and oral business cases to senior management

  • Numerate and having financial literacy, excellent spoken and written English

  • Tenacity and resourcefulness, an ability to deliver under pressure, intuitive prioritization and sense of urgency

  • A clear self-starter approach, ability to extract practical steps for contracting and project design from ambiguous high-level vision

Desirable Skills/Experience

  • Experience through education or work in a relevant area of oncology diagnostics, providing credibility to scientific audiences.

  • Experience in international, multi-functional project teams to deliver to time, cost and quality.

  • A working understanding of diagnostic regulatory frameworks.

  • Understanding of commercial in-market needs for novel oncology diagnostics.

  • Knowledge of alternative deal structures and legal principles applicable to a range of deal types.

  • Negotiation skills and experience of working in a deal environment.

  • Good knowledge of disease areas, and drug/diagnostic development activities and commercial processes.

  • Existing deep diagnostic scientific knowledge and an established external network is an advantage

Why Astrazeneca?

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.

At AstraZeneca, we are driven by a bold ambition to eliminate cancer as a cause of death. Our relentless pursuit of scientific excellence challenges the status quo to deliver more effective treatments for patients. With a game-changing pipeline backed by pioneering research, we are transforming cancer care through precision medicine. Our entrepreneurial spirit fosters collaboration across diverse teams, empowering us to redefine cancer treatment. Join us on this exciting journey where your contributions can make a real difference.

Ready to take on this exciting challenge? Apply now to join our team!

title: Backend Engineer
description:
About the Role

Join a fast-moving energy technology company building the operating system for the next generation of electricity supply in Europe. The engineering team is developing a modular billing engine, low-level energy-market communication protocols, and a full accounting ledger — powering dynamic electricity plans for households and hardware manufacturers across the continent.

As a Backend Engineer on the core infrastructure team, you'll work on the systems that sit at the heart of the platform: scalable, reliable, and designed to handle the complexity of real-time energy markets, embedded billing, and regulated electricity supply.

What You'll Do

  • Solve for complexity through design — translate ambiguous, multi-layered business and regulatory requirements into clean, maintainable backend architecture.

  • Scale the core — own and evolve the critical services underpinning billing, ledger, and market communication systems as the platform grows.

  • Bias for action — ship with speed and confidence; make pragmatic trade-offs and iterate quickly in a fast-paced environment.

  • Raise the bar — champion engineering best practices, participate actively in code review, and help grow the technical culture of a small but high-calibre team.

What We're Looking For

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.

  • 3–10+ years of backend development experience.

  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript (Node.js), including a solid grasp of asynchronous programming patterns.

  • Production experience with PostgreSQL and an ORM (e.g. Drizzle) for data access and schema management.

  • Experience with Next.js, including API routes or server components used for backend services.

  • Familiarity with distributed systems concepts — designing scalable, maintainable core services.

  • Experience integrating Stripe payments and related billing flows.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, an ownership mindset, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.

  • Willingness to work on-site in Berlin, Germany.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with workflow orchestration tools (e.g. Temporal).

  • Experience in energy, fintech, or other regulated / billing-heavy domains.

  • Exposure to API-first or headless platform architecture.

Tech Stack

  • TypeScript, Node.js, Next.js, Hono

  • PostgreSQL, Drizzle ORM

  • Temporal, Stripe

  • Tailwind (front-of-backend / server components)

Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary: €80,000 – €120,000 per year, depending on experience.

  • Visa sponsorship is available for eligible candidates.

  • Opportunity to join a small, high-impact team at an early stage and shape core technical decisions from the ground up.

Location

This role is on-site in Berlin, Germany. Candidates must be willing to work from the Berlin office full-time. Visa sponsorship is available.

title: Staff Engineer (Founding)
description:
About the Role

We are a fast-growing, early-stage B2B SaaS company automating inside sales workflows — quoting, order processing, and customer request handling — for distributors and manufacturers using AI. Our platform integrates deeply with enterprise ERP and CRM systems, and our AI capabilities span specification parsing, voice agents, and email automation.

We're hiring a Founding Staff Engineer to serve as the technical backbone of our engineering organization. This is a high-ownership, hands-on role for someone who thrives at the intersection of deep technical craft, cross-product architecture, and team mentorship. You'll set the bar for quality, reliability, and engineering standards across the organization — and you'll do it primarily by writing and shipping production code.

What You'll Do

  • Act as the technical anchor across multiple products and development streams, owning the highest-leverage engineering work.

  • Design and evolve architecture decisions — core systems, shared frameworks, and critical infrastructure — that prevent long-term dead-ends.

  • Spend the majority of your time writing and shipping production code, leading by example.

  • Identify and eliminate technical debt through thoughtful refactoring and by raising engineering standards.

  • Mentor engineers via code review, pairing, and direct feedback to improve overall team output and reduce hidden risk.

  • Contribute to the architecture and implementation of AI capabilities, including LLM pipelines and data infrastructure.

What We're Looking For

Requirements

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience with a proven track record of solving genuinely hard problems in production systems.

  • Deep full-stack expertise with a strong focus on backend, APIs, and infrastructure; comfortable on the frontend when needed (Python, React, TypeScript).

  • Demonstrated experience designing and evolving systems across multiple products and teams, including long-term architecture strategy.

  • Experience contributing to AI capabilities, including design and implementation of LLM pipelines and data infrastructure.

  • Cloud and DevOps fluency: containerization (Docker), cloud platforms (Azure / AWS / GCP), and infrastructure as code (Terraform).

Nice to Have

  • Experience building or integrating large-scale AI systems or data pipelines beyond LLM integration.

  • Background in enterprise SaaS, ERP/CRM integrations, or distribution and manufacturing software.

Who You Are

  • A technical leader who leads through doing — you multiply team effectiveness without moving to a management track.

  • You notice and fix slipping quality without being asked; deep ownership is your default mode.

  • Mission-driven, pragmatic, and decisive under uncertainty.

  • Willing to work on-site in Munich with a high level of intensity and commitment.

Location

This role is on-site in Munich, Germany. Candidates must be willing to relocate to or already be based in Munich. Visa sponsorship is not available.

Compensation & Benefits

Compensation details were not provided for this role. Our team is small and equity upside is meaningful — this is an early, founding-level position with significant long-term ownership potential.

title: Stagiair Adviseur Vermogen regio Zwolle
description:
Stagiair Adviseur Vermogen

Heeft beleggen jouw interesse? En sta je open voor een carrière binnen de financiële sector? Deze meewerkstage voor de periode vanaf februari 2027 betekent dat je onder begeleiding van een persoonlijke coach binnen Adviesteam Vermogen in- en outbound werkzaamheden verricht die een Adviseur Vermogen dagelijks doet. Afgestemd op jouw kennis en ervaring doorloop je, samen met maximaal drie andere stagiaires, een leertraject en ga je aan de slag met het (verder) ontwikkelen van jouw gespreksvaardigheden, sales skills en het behalen van de benodigde vakdiploma’s. Het doel is om je zelfstandig, op een ING locatie en digitaal (vanuit huis), te laten werken en dagelijks contact te laten hebben met particuliere- en zakelijke klanten over beleggen bij ING.

Leertraject fase 1:

  • Je start tegelijkertijd met maximaal vier stagiaires en komt te werken binnen het Digitaal Vermogen Team (DVT). Een groot team van adviseurs die het 1e aanspreekpunt zijn voor bestaande klanten in het ‘Guided model’ (belegd vermogen van € 50.000 tot € 500.000) én verantwoordelijk zijn voor de centrale leadgeneratie vanuit outbound-, inbound- en online activiteiten richting de commerciële teams van Adviesteam Vermogen en Private Banking.
  • Je gaat onder begeleiding van een persoonlijke coach vrijwel direct starten met klantcontact via outbound bellen om je gespreksvaardigheden ‘on the job’ te ontwikkelen en de Way of Working te leren. Indien nodig behaal je onder werktijd de benodigde vakdiploma’s waardoor je meer verschillende type klantcontacten mag afhandelen.

Leertraject fase 2:

  • Na het succesvol afronden van fase 1 ga je ‘echt’ aan het werk. De nadruk in deze fase ligt op het verder ontwikkelen van je (sales) vaardigheden en gaat het tempo van klantcontact omhoog via outbound- en inbound belwerkzaamheden.
  • Je krijgt targets en gaat deelnemen aan performance dialogen met de andere stagiaires met als doel om van elkaar te leren. Een persoonlijke coach blijft je gedurende deze periode begeleiden.
  • Je krijg presentaties van collega’s die jou gaan uitleggen wat zij doen en gaat op locatie meekijken. Hiermee krijg je een beter beeld van mogelijke banen binnen ING.

Wat vraagt deze stage van je?

Je wilt graag tijd investeren in het verder ontwikkelen van jouw gespreksvaardigheden en je ervaring in klantcontact. Beleggen heeft je interesse, je bent een goede gesprekspartner en wilt klanten graag helpen bij het maken van de juiste keuzes. Je bent sales gedreven, resultaat gericht, neemt initiatief en kunt goed omgaan met feedback. Verder:

  • Je studeert aan een Hbo-opleiding en spreekt vloeiend Nederlands.
  • Je hebt WFT Basis in je bezit of bent bereid deze te halen voordat je bij ons start. Het liefst heb je ook WFT Vermogen en/of MiFID Informeren of ben je bereid deze te halen. Alle opleidingskosten worden vergoed door ING.
  • Je bent flexibel inzetbaar en combineert thuiswerken met werken vanuit één van de hub locaties Den Haag, Eindhoven, Leeuwarden, Zaandam en Zwolle of vanuit een ING-huis bij jou in de buurt.

Wat bieden wij?

  • Een meewerkstage vanaf februari 2027 afgestemd op de eisen vanuit jouw opleiding.
  • Een persoonlijke coach en leren onder werktijd.
  • Een uitdagende en leerzame omgeving met veel inzichten over mogelijke werkzaamheden binnen ING.
  • Een marktconforme stagevergoeding van EURO 700,- (bruto) bij een 36-urige werkweek.

Jouw sollicitatie

Stuur je CV voorzien van een motivatie waarin je uitlegt wie je bent, waarom jij de juiste kandidaat bent voor dit leertraject en op welke wijze je affiniteit met beleggen en/of de financiële markten hebt? Wij maken graag kennis met je.

Heb je vragen? Stuur dan een mail naar Bart Janssen, Digitaal Vermogen Team: Bart.Janssen1@ing.com.

An established aerospace organisation is looking for an Aircraft Quality Engineer / Airworthiness Engineer to join its aircraft maintenance and quality team.

This role is particularly suitable for licensed Aircraft Maintenance Engineers (AMEs) who are looking to develop their career beyond hands-on maintenance into aircraft quality, airworthiness, compliance and surveillance.

Previous Quality Engineer experience is not mandatory. Candidates who have recently obtained their aircraft maintenance licence and have relevant aviation experience may also be considered.

Job Highlights

  • Basic Salary: $4,000 – $6,500/month

  • Overtime payable

  • Additional license approval allowance upon obtaining the required approval

  • Monday – Friday, 8:00am – 5:30pm

  • Mainly based in the Changi area, with occasional operational requirements at other aviation locations

Key Responsibilities

  • Liaise with customer representatives on aircraft documentation, certification and maintenance release procedures.

  • Ensure aircraft documentation remains valid and compliant, including relevant registration, airworthiness, radio license, insurance and other required documents.

  • Conduct internal quality audits in accordance with the Quality Audit Plan and instructions from the Quality Manager.

  • Assist in reviewing and evaluating new or amended operator interface procedures.

  • Conduct reviews of applicable Airworthiness Directives (ADs).

Requirements

  • FAA A&P or other relevant recognised aviation professional license may also be considered.

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in the aviation industry.

  • Diploma in Engineering or equivalent qualification.

  • Good knowledge of airworthiness requirements and/or aviation Quality Management Systems such as AS9110.

  • Experience in aircraft maintenance, inspection, airworthiness or aviation quality will be advantageous.

  • Experience conducting internal or external quality audits is an added advantage.

You will own the firm’s most important business unit, sit on the firm’s leadership team, and be responsible for delivering an exceptional client experience at every tier.

What Success Looks Like (Key Outcomes)

  • Operational Excellence: The tax department runs with consistency, accountability, and quality—returns are accurate, deadlines are met, strategies are implemented, and the team doesn’t need to be managed to the clock.
  • Team Health: Your advisors and preparers are developed, supported, and performing well. Turnover is low. Standards are high.
  • TAS Growth: The advisory practice expands and deepens across the client base. TAS clients receive proactive, high-value guidance, and they feel it.
  • Client Relationships: High-value clients are retained, well served, and growing with the firm. The senior-most clients trust you personally.

What You’ll Do

Lead, Manage & Develop the Team

Grow the Tax Advisory Practice

Drive TAS engagements for Prime and Elite clients—proactive planning, multi-scenario tax strategy, and white-glove service delivery. You will be expected to participate in planning and executing the growth of this practice, not just maintaining it.

Maintain a Strong Compliance Foundation

Own the quality and consistency of the compliance practice. Reviews get done right. Deadlines are met. The team doesn’t cut corners because you don’t.

Lead High-Impact Client Relationships

Serve as the firm’s senior client-facing presence for complex engagements—business owners, HNW individuals, and multi-entity structures. You’ll also support and elevate the relationships being managed across your advisory and compliance teams.

Training & Quality Assurance

Be the Technical Authority

Are you ready to lead medical strategy in GI cancers and translate breakthrough science into better outcomes for patients worldwide? Do you thrive at the intersection of science, strategy, and cross-functional influence where your decisions shape clinical practice and business results?

In this role, you will set the medical direction for a critical GI oncology franchise, fusing robust evidence with clear strategy to change how patients are treated. You will partner closely with colleagues across the enterprise—from research and safety to field teams and market access—to ensure our science is communicated with integrity, our insights drive action, and our launches and lifecycle plans deliver real impact.

  • A minimum of 3+ years of related work experience in industry, clinical or research institution, preferably in oncology, rare disease, or related experiences

title: Senior Director, Boston Corporate Affairs and Communications

description:
Senior Director, Boston Corporate Affairs and Communications

Location: Boston, US

Role Outline


At AstraZeneca (AZ), science compels us to push the boundaries of what is possible to turn science into life-changing medicines for patients who need them most. We deliver breakthrough science by creating thriving, vibrant and open science centres where our scientists are free to pursue their ideas and collaborate both with colleagues and our academic and industry partners.

Across our global footprint, we have a total of six strategic sites, which play a critical role in delivering our portfolio and driving our reputation. These sites are often located in vibrant innovation ecosystems and are designed to allow us to strengthen collaboration, attract talent and encourage an entrepreneurial approach to our science and our business operations.

The Senior Director, Boston Communications will define and drive activities that enhance our reputation in Boston and strengthen relationships with those within this thriving ecosystem, in the US and globally. You will become a key representative of AZ in the community and utilize this role and relationships to guide the development and execution of a robust programme of activities, aligning broader corporate affairs activities, to support the company’s strategy and maximises the impact of AstraZeneca in Boston; bringing together diverse stakeholder needs to optimize and amplify our voice.

You will be a key member of the R&D Communications teams, working closely with internal stakeholders across Global Corporate Affairs (GCA) and the broader organisation to build the reputation of AZ in Boston and showcase our most exciting science and benefit to the ecosystem and beyond. Positioning AstraZeneca as the best science-led organisation in the industry, a business leader investing for the future and the partner of choice.

Candidate Focus & Challenge

  • Act as a key representative of AstraZeneca within Boston, aligning contributing and also learning from others in the wider ecosystem, and translating these insights into activities
  • Leads the development and delivery of an integrated corporate affairs strategy and plan that showcases AstraZeneca’s leadership and positive impact to enhance reputation and collaborations in Boston, including internal, external and policy / Government affairs activities. Aligning activities with internal stakeholders to maximise the broader impact within the US and globally.
  • Reinforces and leads the company's approach to external / strategic stakeholder engagement in Boston and serves as an effective ambassador in the community.
  • Ensures Boston milestones, events and external news flow are maximised/effectively managed to achieve Boston objectives.
  • Identifies and mobilises input and output from key groups inc media relations, government affairs, community relations, R&D, digital/social media, internal communications and recruitment marketing, to deliver reputation enhancing communications programmes and events
  • Works as part of a matrix and community of practice, sharing learnings, best practice and knowledge
  • Anticipates and manages reputational issues in addition to playing a corporate affairs leadership role in business continuity/incident management if required.
  • Leverages positive impact of AZ STEM activities locally (as appropriate)
  • Aligns activities with other Boston community support programmes (managed in Ops BAU) which focuses predominantly on science education in the community
  • Provides coaching and counsel on corporate affairs topics to internal stakeholders including the senior leaders on the Boston Leadership Team
  • Establishes measures of success and implements relevant evaluation tools. Ensures external environment is monitored to identify local and national communication opportunities and risks.

Candidate Knowledge, Skills & Experience

  • Minimum Bachelor Degree in communication, public health, life science
  • More than 10 years of experience in communication in pharma industry
  • Established track record of delivering impactful, integrated corporate affairs strategies and plans in support of business priorities across multiple channels and stakeholders with demonstrable measures of success
  • Has a track record of creating and developing networks, with an entrepreneurial approach and desire to challenge the status quo
  • Understands the US Life-sciences and / or Boston ecosystem, and can adeptly navigate and understand the challenges and opportunities they present
  • Broad, multi-channel communication experience including media, events, digital, change and crisis communications
  • Working knowledge of the US political and media environment.
  • Experience of managing different internal and external stakeholder relationships. Confident around senior leaders. Comfortable delivering contrary viewpoint when necessary
  • Strong issues management capability across corporate affairs disciplines. Sound judgment; strong reputational 'radar'
  • High level of integrity, able to handle highly confidential/sensitive information
  • Track-record of team and programme leadership, with exceptional influencing and relationship building skills
  • Team worker with high levels of motivation and personal accountability, bringing enthusiasm & energy to the team
  • Excellent eye for detail and upholding visual and verbal identity
  • Able to develop and maintain relationships across business and cultural boundaries

title: Senior Compliance Investigator
description:
You could be the one who changes everything for our 28 million members as a clinical professional on our Medical Management/Health Services team. Centene is a diversified, national organization offering competitive benefits including a fresh perspective on workplace flexibility.

Position Purpose: Under the general direction of the VP of Compliance Investigations this position assists with the development, implementation, and continuous monitoring of an enterprise-wide Compliance Investigations Program and leads the Company's Compliance Investigations for all Business Units, Health Plans, and Corporate functions. Leads and oversees compliance and ethics investigations, facilitates and leads meetings with business management and cross-functional stakeholders, and prepares, reviews, and analyzes internal and external reporting. Supports the Director, Ethics & Investigations in the day-to-day operations of the Compliance Investigations Unit (CIU).

  • Leads and conducts compliance and ethics investigations across all business units and health plans, including but not limited to assessment of allegations, review of relevant documents, witness interviews, analysis of facts, root cause analysis, and preparation of investigation reports with recommended remedial or disciplinary actions.

  • Independently evaluates and assesses allegations to determine applicable criteria, including federal and state regulations, the Centene Code of Conduct, and internal policies, procedures, and standards that are alleged to have been violated.

  • Adheres to Compliance Investigation workplans and protocols and conducts investigations in compliance with established protocols and timelines.

  • Provides weekly case summaries and adheres to established minimum case review quotas to ensure timely progression and resolution of the investigative caseload.

  • Ensures all investigative findings are clearly tied to applicable company policies (e.g., Code of Conduct), federal and state regulations, and to maintain regulatory defensibility and support appropriate remediation.

  • Provides timely reports, both orally and in writing, to the Director of Ethics & Investigations and/or senior management regarding the status and outcomes of investigations.

  • Thoroughly documents, organizes, and reviews case files within centralized case management systems (e.g., Archer) in accordance with Company policy and CIU protocols.

  • Collaborates cross-functionally with other departments, including Legal, People Relations, SIU, Privacy, Finance, and Business Operations on investigations and the investigative process.

  • Prepares and analyzes departmental metrics, including investigation KPIs, case aging, and trending data, and makes recommendations accordingly.

  • Prepares presentations and presents findings to departmental and business management, executive leadership, and other stakeholders as needed.

  • Identifies risks, interprets investigation results, and recommends and communicates remedial actions to mitigate future potential risks.

  • Performs follow-up to ensure remedial/disciplinary measures are implemented appropriately and timely, including tracking remediation activities through case management systems.

  • Assists with various projects as assigned by the Director of Ethics & Investigations or the VP of Compliance Investigations.

  • Performs other duties as assigned.

  • Complies with all policies and standards.

Education/Experience:

  • A Bachelor's Degree in Related Field or Associates with 5 years of applicable experience, or a High School/GED with 6 years of applicable experience may substitute for the Bachelor's Degree, required.

  • 4+ years of experience in investigations, auditing and risk analysis required.

  • 1+ year of experience in reading, analyzing and interpreting State and Federal laws, rules and regulations required.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Managed care or health insurance company experience preferred.

  • Experience with compliance case management systems (e.g., Archer, Navex) preferred.

  • Demonstrated experience conducting ethics and compliance investigations in a regulated healthcare environment preferred.

  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams including Legal, People Relations, SIU, and Privacy preferred.

Licenses and Certifications:

  • Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE) preferred.

  • Certified Compliance & Ethics Professional (CCEP) or Certified Healthcare Compliance (CHC) preferred.

Pay Range: $70,100.00 - $126,200.00 per year

title: Development Scientist II, Analytical Development and Clinical QC (ADQC)
location: New Haven, Connecticut, United States of America
description:
This is what you will do:

This Development Scientist II will be a key team member in Alexion’s External Analytical Development and Quality Control group. This position is responsible for maintaining the highest standard of quality and compliance of external quality control testing (GMP) laboratories. This candidate will be responsible for initiation and ownership of laboratory investigations (LIRs) through strong liaison with external contract laboratories and change controls relevant to ADQC biologic programs. The candidate will ensure timely, compliant, and high-quality delivery for LIR closure to enable the generation of final release CoAs. The role will work closely with internal Quality Assurance, Compliance, Analytical Development and Stability teams to ensure product to patients.

You will be responsible for:

  • Responsible for generating and/or mirroring, reviewing, providing assessments, and driving ownership of LIRs to close out Out-of-Specification (OOS), Out-of-Trend (OOT), and atypical results with structured root cause analysis, impact assessment, and/or corrective/preventive actions (CAPAs).

  • Design investigational testing plans ensuring compliant closure of all testing related investigations within the quality system.

  • Lead and/or facilitate cross-functional meetings with quality assurance to ensure structured investigation alignment.

  • Create plans, track, and present timelines to meet established targets, goals, and objectives.

  • Perform review of analytical data to ensure expected assay performance.

  • Identify opportunities for improvement in systems and make recommendations for effective changes to ensure compliance with cGMP.

  • Strong presentation skills

You will need to have:

  • A successful candidate will have strong mental acuity with high attention to detail and ability to maintain accuracy in documentation and processes.

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to conduct risk assessments and root cause analysis.

  • A broad knowledge of Pharmaceutical Quality Assurance, regulatory compliance, and/or quality control inclusive of cGMP, FDA regulations, familiarity with ICH guidelines and EU regulations.

  • Strong proficiency in quality management systems and effective communication skills for interacting with cross-functional teams.

  • Strong proficiency with MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint.

  • Ability to bend, reach and stand, with lifting to 15 pounds and carrying over short distances.

  • Ability to travel up to 10%, if needed.

  • Advanced (M.S. or Ph.D.) degree in Biochemistry, Chemistry or related discipline with 2-5 years (Ph.D.) or 10+ (M.S.) hands on biological analytical development experience in pharmaceutical industry.

We would prefer you to have:

  • Working knowledge in validated documentation systems: Veeva Vault (EQV), LIMS, ValGenesis, Kneat, etc.

  • Knowledge of pharmaceutical/biotechnology manufacturing process

  • Database management /statistical analysis (e.g., JMP, Tableau, SAS) with proficiency in Microsoft SharePoint and/or BOX.

title: Chief Data Officer - 12 month FTC - Quilter
description:
Fixed Term Contract Duration - 11 Months

About the Business

Quilter plc is a leading wealth management business, helping to enable brighter financial futures for every generation. Quilter oversees £141.9 billion in customer investments (as of March 2026). It has an adviser and customer offering spanning financial advice, investment platforms, multi-asset investment solutions, and discretionary fund management. The business is comprised of two segments: Affluent and High Net Worth.

Affluent encompasses the financial planning business, Quilter Financial Planning, the Quilter Investment Platform and Quilter Investors, the multi-asset investment solutions business. High Net Worth includes the discretionary fund management business, Quilter Cheviot, together with Quilter Cheviot Financial Planning - offering a highly personalised service to private clients, charities, trustees, and professional partners. Quilter Cheviot has presence throughout the UK, Ireland and Channel Islands.

At Quilter we never stand still. Our foundations are rooted in our extraordinary expertise, which is trusted by hundreds of thousands of customers, but we have great ambitions to stay one step ahead and make an even greater difference to the people and communities we serve, including our colleagues.

Our business is transforming, continually modernising, and becoming even more customer centric. So, if you want to be bold in the pursuit of your ambitions, bring new ideas, and challenge and evolve what we do, it's the perfect time to join us!

About the Role

Quilter is currently investing in an ambitious transformation programme to drive growth, modernise its technology infrastructure and deliver an excellent customer experience. High quality data is core to the success of our strategy, and we have therefore created a new position reporting directly to the Group Chief Operating Officer to lead the creation and implementation of a Quilter wide data strategy.

Based in London, or Southampton (hybrid, 2-3 days in office), our Chief Data Officer (CDO), will shape how we harnesses data, insight and AI to drive growth, improve customer outcomes and strengthen decision-making across the Group. Reporting to the Chief Data and Technology Officer, this is a pivotal enterprise leadership role with responsibility for defining and delivering Quilter's data strategy. You'll ensure data is treated as a strategic asset, creating the foundations that enable advanced analytics, digital transformation and the responsible adoption of AI at scale.

Working closely with Executive Committee members, business leaders and technology teams, you'll identify opportunities where data can unlock commercial value, enhance client and adviser experiences, improve operational performance and support our ambitious growth agenda.

In this role, you will:

  • Define and lead our enterprise-wide data strategy, aligning data investments with business priorities and measurable outcomes.
  • Drive a data-driven culture where trusted insight informs strategic and operational decision-making.
  • Build and lead a high-performing data organisation recognised as a trusted partner across the business.
  • Establish modern, scalable data platforms, architectures and engineering capabilities that support analytics, automation and AI.
  • Create robust governance, ownership and data quality frameworks that balance innovation with regulatory requirements.
  • Shape the foundations for responsible AI adoption through trusted, accessible and well-governed data.
  • Influence Board and Executive-level decision-making, acting as a trusted adviser on opportunities, risks and emerging technologies.
  • Strengthen Quilter's position externally by building relationships with regulators, industry bodies, partners and technology providers.
  • Deliver tangible business value by connecting data strategy to commercial growth, operational efficiency and enhanced customer outcomes.
This is a unique opportunity to define the next chapter of Quilter's data journey and play a central role in shaping the future of our business.

About You

You're a commercially minded data leader who understands that great data strategies only matter when they deliver real business outcomes. You bring a proven track record of leading enterprise-scale data transformation within complex, regulated organisations and know how to turn ambitious strategies into practical, measurable results. Comfortable operating at Board and Executive Committee level, you build credibility quickly and influence through expertise, collaboration and strong relationships.

You will bring:
  • Executive-level leadership experience in data, analytics, information management or digital transformation.
  • A strong track record of delivering measurable business value through data-led initiatives.

title: Job Shop Inventory Specialist
description:
Overview

We're hiring Inventory Control Specialists for our Nashville manufacturing facility.

You'll kit the material that keeps production moving, pulling heavy, oversized steel components with forklifts and combi-lifts, then staging them at assembly, mechanical processing, and welding cells. Every move gets logged in the inventory system.

The job runs in two halves: material handling on the floor, and accurate transactions in the system.

Compensation

  • $25 – $28 / hr
  • Overtime available

Hiring on Weekend Shift

  • Friday - Sunday: 5am - 5pm (work 36, paid for 40)

Responsibilities

  • Kitting: Pull and stage every component a job needs before production starts.
  • Material Delivery: Move steel components to assembly, machining, and weld cells.
  • Lift Operation: Handle heavy, oversized loads with forklifts and combi lifts.
  • Inventory Transactions: Log every material move in the system as it happens.
  • Receiving: Unload and stage incoming steel from inbound trucks.
  • Load Securing: Strap and block heavy loads before moving them.
  • Equipment Checks: Complete pre-shift inspections and report mechanical issues immediately.
  • Warehouse Organization: Organize storage areas to keep staging lanes clear.

Requirements

Qualifications

Required

  • Experience operating large-capacity forklifts
  • Comfortable handling long, awkward steel loads
  • Basic rigging, strapping, and securement knowledge
  • Computer literacy for inventory transactions
  • Accurate record-keeping on every material move
  • Lift 50 lbs; bend, squat, climb frequently
  • Reliable attendance and overtime flexibility

Preferred

  • Combi lift or side-loader experience
  • ERP experience: SAP, NetSuite, Epicor, or Fulcrum
  • Prior inventory control or kitting background
  • Experience staging material for weld or assembly cells
  • Current forklift certification
  • 5+ years in manufacturing or yard environments

title: Software Engineer II - Engineering Services (Full Stack)
description:
Welcome to the Agentic Commerce Era

At Commerce, our mission is to empower businesses to innovate, grow, and thrive with our open, AI-driven commerce ecosystem. As the parent company of BigCommerce, Feedonomics, and Makeswift, we connect the tools and systems that power growth, enabling businesses to unlock the full potential of their data, deliver seamless and personalized experiences across every channel, and adapt swiftly to an ever-changing market. We believe in harnessing AI responsibly to unlock new possibilities, and we’re looking for individuals who use it intentionally to solve problems, accelerate outcomes, and expand what’s possible in their role. Our purpose is to help businesses confidently solve complex commerce challenges so they can build smarter, adapt faster, and grow on their own terms. If you want to be part of a team of bold builders, sharp thinkers, and technical trailblazers who shape the future of commerce, this is the place for you.

The Engineering Services team is looking for a Software Engineer who wants to see their work land directly in merchants' hands. Sitting within Commerce's professional services organization, our team designs, builds, and maintains single-click apps published to the BigCommerce App Marketplace. We also deliver data migration projects that help merchants move onto BigCommerce with confidence. Because our roadmap is shaped by what merchants and services teams encounter in the field, you'll work with short feedback loops, varied projects, and code that ships to real stores quickly.

What The Team Owns

  • The end-to-end lifecycle of a portfolio of single-click apps on the BigCommerce App Marketplace: design, development, publishing, versioning, and ongoing maintenance

  • The shared foundations these apps depend on — OAuth-based install flows, webhook processing, and services that scale reliably across thousands of merchant stores

  • Tooling and delivery for merchant data migration projects

  • Production health of our apps, including monitoring, triage, and resolution of merchant-reported issues

What You'll Do:

  • Collaborate with the team to design, build, and maintain single-click apps across the full stack - backend services in Node/TypeScript and PHP, and frontends in React

  • Integrate deeply with BigCommerce platform APIs (REST and GraphQL), webhooks, and OAuth flows

  • Write code that is performant, maintainable, clear, and concise, with appropriate test coverage

  • Build new features with a focus on extensibility and quality - a single codebase serving many merchants raises the bar for both

  • Support apps in production: monitor health, troubleshoot issues and resolve merchant-impacting bugs

  • Contribute to data migration projects, from scripting and validation through cutover

  • Participate in code reviews to maintain and improve quality

  • Partner with Product Managers, solutions architects, and other services teams to translate merchant requirements into technical designs, occasionally joining client and partner conversations alongside Product Managers

  • Move comfortably between projects and codebases, choosing the right tools and patterns for each job

Who You Are:

  • 3+ years of professional experience as a Software Engineer

  • You have a solid understanding of programming principles and write code that others enjoy inheriting

  • Hands-on experience with NetJavaScript/TypeScript (Node) and/or PHP on the backend, and React and on the frontend - depth in one with willingness to work across the stack

  • Experience integrating with third-party APIs and services (REST, GraphQL, webhooks, OAuth)

  • You think in multi-tenant terms: one app, thousands of stores, and the performance, data-isolation, and upgrade considerations that come with that

  • You're comfortable context-switching across concurrent projects and picking up unfamiliar codebases quickly

  • You have excellent interpersonal skills - able to collaborate and communicate efficiently in person, video calls, Slack or email, including explaining technical concepts to non-engineering stakeholders

  • You’re driven to take action and enjoy owning work from inception to delivery

  • You enjoy being part of a collaborative team focused on building products that delight customers and our partners

  • Preferred minimum: Bachelor's degree in CS or equivalent experience; or completion of a comprehensive software engineering boot camp.

  • Bonus: experience with ecommerce platforms, BigCommerce APIs, or building apps for a marketplace/app-store distribution model

(Pay Transparency Range: $111,956 - $167,934)

Final compensation will be determined based on factors such as relevant experience, skills, qualifications and geographic location. We also consider internal equity to help ensure fair and consistent pay practices across our teams.

Where applicable, this role may also be eligible for variable compensation (such as bonus or commission), equity, and benefits in accordance with local policies. Details will be shared during the hiring process. We are committed to equitable and transparent pay practices that align to market data, internal equity, and individual contribution.

Inclusion and Belonging

At Commerce, we believe that celebrating the unique histories, perspectives and abilities of every employee makes a difference for our company, our customers and our community. We are an equal opportunity employer and the inclusive atmosphere we build together will make room for every person to contribute, grow and thrive.

Runner

Operations

NO

title: Lead/Staff Full Stack Engineer, AI Platform & Agents (US/Canada Hybrid/Remote)
description:
Build the GenAI platform that powers critical decisions in healthcare, legal, tax, and compliance industries. Your work will directly shape the future of these fields, enabling faster, safer, and more impactful decision-making at a global scale.

-Location: : US/Canada, Hybrid or Remote
-Work Hours: Must have 9–11 AM CST overlap

  • Candidates within commuting distance of a Wolters Kluwer office will be considered for hybrid employment, with 2 days per week onsite.

  • Candidates not within commuting distance will be considered for remote employment.

About this role

Our team is building a central GenAI Platform to empower hundreds of product teams across the organization with scalable capabilities for rapid development, validation, and deployment of AI agents. We also drive the development of the most impactful AI agents, ensuring faster delivery and greater impact across multiple domains. With over 20 agents already launched and many more in progress, our work accelerates innovation and improves outcomes in critical industries.

You'll join a 100-engineer remote-first team within a larger organization that combines the stability of an established company with the agility of a startup. In this high-autonomy, high-impact role, you'll take problems from concept to production. You'll design and ship full-stack systems, shape platform capabilities to empower hundreds of product teams, and directly contribute to the development of the most impactful AI agents.

Flagship Agent: UpToDate Expert AI

In Health, we’re launchingUpToDate Expert AI—a medical research and clinical reasoning agent that transforms the world’s most widely used point‑of‑care knowledge resource into a real‑time medical assistant. Millions of physicians will rely on it to accelerate differential diagnosis, refine treatment decisions, and reduce cognitive load—while maintaining rigorous safety, privacy, and guideline fidelity. Improvements you ship (latency, reliability, hallucination reduction) will translate directly into faster, higher-quality patient care at global scale.

Tech stack

You don't need to know all of these on day one, but you should be ready to learn quickly.

  • TypeScript, Node.js, React, Python, LangChain/LangGraph, MCP/A2A, Rust
  • AWS (primary), Azure, GCP; Docker, Terraform, GitHub Actions
  • DocumentDB, DynamoDB, OpenSearch, Azure AI Search
  • Azure OpenAI, AWS Anthropic, Google Gemini
  • GitHub, Confluence, Slack

What you’ll do

  • Design and implement full‑stack applications, AI agents, and platform components that enable rapid GenAI agent development, validation, and deployment.
  • Build developer tooling, CI/CD, and observability for safe, fast iteration (evals, canaries, rollout/rollback, cost and quality telemetry).
  • Apply secure SDLC and privacy‑by‑design practices (threat modeling, least privilege).
  • Collaborate with product, UX, and domain experts to deliver customer‑focused solutions with measurable outcomes.
  • Apply current LLM patterns (RAG, retrieval, routing, tool‑use, evals) to deliver measurable customer value—faster, more reliable AI systems; reduced time‑to‑decision; improved trust/safety metrics; and lower cost per query.
  • Lead by example through writing high-quality, maintainable code that demonstrates engineering craftsmanship.

Team context

  • Org and Sub‑teams: Central GenAI Platform within Wolters Kluwer, driving innovation across businesses by creating re‑usable platform services and components. Sub‑teams are fewer than 10 engineers, focused on platform services or customer‑facing agents.
  • Culture and Reporting: We value a "manager of one" mindset, where outcomes matter more than optics. Authority is earned through demonstrated impact, not tenure or title. You’ll report directly to the VP of Engineering, AI Platform.
  • Team Size and Impact: Our globally distributed team of ~100 engineers combines the stability of an established company with the agility of a startup. We are moving fast, and there are many areas where you can have a big impact.
  • Work setup: Remote‑first in US or EU, with hybrid options near major offices. Collaboration requires 9–11 AM CST overlap. Occasional travel for team onsites/offsites as needed.

Minimum qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience.
  • Strong full‑stack development skills and cloud experience (AWS/Azure/GCP).
  • Expert in at least one, and proficient across the others:
    • AI Agent development and evaluation
    • Backend development
    • Frontend development
    • Cloud services (AWS/Azure/GCP)
    • CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code
    • Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)
    • Quality engineering / testing strategy
    • Secure SDLC and privacy by design
  • Proven track record delivering secure, reliable, cloud‑native systems to production.
  • Excellent problem‑solving, ownership, and cross‑functional communication.

Nice to have

  • Proven ability to deliver software products independently or as part of a small, fast‑paced team.
  • Experience of taking AI agents from concept to production, including safety evaluations, iterative testing (e.g., A/B testing), and continuous improvement.
  • Experience with LangChain/LangGraph and MCP; vector/RAG systems; OpenSearch.
  • Worked on traditional ML tasks like training, deployment, and monitoring.
  • Understand how LLMs work, their failure modes, and techniques like fine‑tuning and model adaptation.
  • Familiarity with regulatory frameworks such as SOC2, HIPAA, etc.

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in‑person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI‑generated responses or third‑party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

Compensation:

$97,400.00 - $174,050.00 USD

Compensation range listed is based on primary location of the position. Actual base salary offer is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skills, experience and actual hiring location. Your recruiter can share more information about the specific offer for the job location during the hiring process.

Additional Information:

Wolters Kluwer offers a wide variety of competitive benefits and programs to help meet your needs and balance your work and personal life, including but not limited to: Medical, Dental, & Vision Plans, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Commuter Benefits, Tuition Assistance Plan, Vacation and Sick Time, and Paid Parental Leave. Full details of our benefits are available upon request.

As a leading internet technology company based in China, NetEase, Inc. (NASDAQ: NTES and HKEX:9999, “NetEase”) provides premium online services centered around content creation. With extensive offerings across its expanding gaming ecosystem, the Company develops and operates some of China’s most popular and longest-running mobile and PC games.   4. Strong cultural sensitivity and editorial judgment — not satisfied with literal translation; able to propose better idiomatic rewrites and articulate the rationale.
  5. Excellent communication and scheduling skills; comfortable working in cross-cultural team environments.

Bonus Points

  • Familiarity with casual games or female-oriented content expression.
  • Experience building a localization system from scratch or managing external vendors.
  • Knowledge of automated QA tooling or AI-assisted translation tools.

title: Backend-Leaning Product Engineer

About the Role

Join a small, high-ownership product team at an early-stage AI and automation startup as a Backend-Leaning Product Engineer. You'll work closely with founders and customers in a hybrid in-office environment in San Francisco.

This is a great fit if you thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving startup environments and have a track record of shipping, not just planning.

What You'll Do

  • Own features end-to-end — from design through shipping and iteration.

  • Make independent product and engineering decisions with minimal oversight.

  • Build and maintain backend systems, APIs, data models, and automation pipelines.

  • Integrate with external tools, legacy systems, and third-party services.

  • Design workflows and orchestration layers for AI/automation-driven products.

  • Debug production issues and exercise strong engineering judgment under pressure.

  • Contribute full-stack when needed, with a clear emphasis on backend ownership.

  • Collaborate directly with founders, customers, and cross-functional stakeholders.

What We're Looking For

Required:

  • Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, and maintaining data models and automation pipelines for backend systems.

  • Proven ability to debug production issues and apply strong engineering judgment in troubleshooting.

  • Track record of shipping real customer-facing products, ideally in 0-to-1 or ambiguous/messy startup environments.

  • Experience with backend systems, APIs, data modeling, integrations, and automation.

  • Comfort working in a very small, fast-moving team with little structure.

  • Based in San Francisco or willing to relocate; hybrid/in-office presence required.

Nice to Have:

  • Applied AI or workflow/orchestration experience — agentic workflows, RAG, or LLM-enabled features.

  • Python experience; modern web/backend stacks are acceptable — engineering quality matters more than specific stack.

  • Background as an early/founding engineer, startup generalist, or product engineer from a scaling startup.

  • Close prior collaboration with founders or customers on customer-facing features.

Not a fit if: you are frontend-only, data/internal-tools-only, pure DevOps/SRE without product ownership, pure research/ML without shipping experience, or primarily motivated by corporate titles.

  • Base salary: up to $275,000 USD annually

title: Data Engineer
description: Job Description Role Summary Join Team to build innovative Neo4j-powered solutions that detect fraud rings, money laundering networks, and account takeovers in real-time. You'll work at the intersection of data science, graph analytics, and financial crime prevention-helping our clients in the banking sector safeguard their operations and protect their customers. Key Responsibilities - Model Complex Banking Data in Neo4j: Design and implement graph data models representing customers, accounts, transactions, devices, and their interconnected relationships. - Apply Graph Data Science (GDS) Algorithms: Leverage Community Detection, Link Prediction, Node Embeddings, and Pathfinding algorithms to uncover hidden fraud patterns and suspicious networks. - Build Real-Time Investigation Dashboards: Develop interactive visualisations using Neo4j Bloom to empower Risk and AML teams with actionable insights. - Collaborate Across Teams: Partner closely with Risk Management, Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Compliance, and Data Science teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions that reduce fraud losses. - Optimise Performance: Ensure scalability, performance tuning, and reliability of graph databases in production environments. - Drive Innovation: Stay current with emerging graph technologies and fraud detection techniques, and contribute to continuous improvement of our analytics capabilities. Qualifications Must-Have - 5-6 years of overall IT experience, with 2+ years of hands-on experience working with Neo4j, Cypher query language, and Graph Data Science (GDS) library. - Strong proficiency in Python for ETL pipelines, data processing, and integration with Neo4j GDS workflows. - Solid understanding of graph database concepts, including data modelling, indexing, query optimisation, and performance tuning. - Experience applying GDS algorithms such as Community Detection (Louvain, Label Propagation), Link Prediction, Node Embeddings (Node2Vec, GraphSAGE), and Centrality measures. - Familiarity with Neo4j Bloom or similar graph visualisation tools for building investigative dashboards. - Experience in the Banking, Fraud Detection, or AML domain is highly preferred. - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex business requirements into technical solutions. - Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams. Good-to-Have - Experience with other graph databases (e.g., Amazon Neptune, TigerGraph, JanusGraph). - Knowledge of machine learning frameworks (e.g., scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch) and integrating ML models with graph analytics. - Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and deploying Neo4j in cloud environments. - Understanding of data streaming technologies (Kafka, Kinesis) for real-time fraud detection pipelines. - Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation), and DevOps practices. - Knowledge of regulatory frameworks related to AML, KYC, and financial crime compliance. - Neo4j Certified Professional or Graph Data Science certification is a plus. Qualifications: - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Technology, or a related field. - 5-6 years of experience in IT production, preferably in banking or financial services - Good problem-solving skills and ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment. - Strong communication skills with the ability to liaise effectively across teams.

title: Stagiair Adviseur Vermogen regio Utrecht
description:
Stagiair Adviseur Vermogen

Heeft beleggen jouw interesse? En sta je open voor een carrière binnen de financiële sector? Deze meewerkstage voor de periode vanaf februari 2027 betekent dat je onder begeleiding van een persoonlijke coach binnen Adviesteam Vermogen in- en outbound werkzaamheden verricht die een Adviseur Vermogen dagelijks doet. Afgestemd op jouw kennis en ervaring doorloop je, samen met maximaal drie andere stagiaires, een leertraject en ga je aan de slag met het (verder) ontwikkelen van jouw gespreksvaardigheden, sales skills en het behalen van de benodigde vakdiploma’s. Het doel is om je zelfstandig, op een ING locatie en digitaal (vanuit huis), te laten werken en dagelijks contact te laten hebben met particuliere- en zakelijke klanten over beleggen bij ING.

Leertraject fase 1:

  • Je start tegelijkertijd met maximaal vier stagiaires en komt te werken binnen het Digitaal Vermogen Team (DVT). Een groot team van adviseurs die het 1e aanspreekpunt zijn voor bestaande klanten in het ‘Guided model’ (belegd vermogen van € 50.000 tot € 500.000) én verantwoordelijk zijn voor de centrale leadgeneratie vanuit outbound-, inbound- en online activiteiten richting de commerciële teams van Adviesteam Vermogen en Private Banking.
  • Je gaat onder begeleiding van een persoonlijke coach vrijwel direct starten met klantcontact via outbound bellen om je gespreksvaardigheden ‘on the job’ te ontwikkelen en de Way of Working te leren. Indien nodig behaal je onder werktijd de benodigde vakdiploma’s waardoor je meer verschillende type klantcontacten mag afhandelen.

Leertraject fase 2:

  • Na het succesvol afronden van fase 1 ga je ‘echt’ aan het werk. De nadruk in deze fase ligt op het verder ontwikkelen van je (sales) vaardigheden en gaat het tempo van klantcontact omhoog via outbound- en inbound belwerkzaamheden.
  • Je krijgt targets en gaat deelnemen aan performance dialogen met de andere stagiaires met als doel om van elkaar te leren. Een persoonlijke coach blijft je gedurende deze periode begeleiden.
  • Je krijg presentaties van collega’s die jou gaan uitleggen wat zij doen en gaat op locatie meekijken. Hiermee krijg je een beter beeld van mogelijke banen binnen ING.

Wat vraagt deze stage van je?

Je wilt graag tijd investeren in het verder ontwikkelen van jouw gespreksvaardigheden en je ervaring in klantcontact. Beleggen heeft je interesse, je bent een goede gesprekspartner en wilt klanten graag helpen bij het maken van de juiste keuzes. Je bent sales gedreven, resultaat gericht, neemt initiatief en kunt goed omgaan met feedback. Verder:

  • Je studeert aan een Hbo-opleiding en spreekt vloeiend Nederlands.
  • Je hebt WFT Basis in je bezit of bent bereid deze te halen voordat je bij ons start. Het liefst heb je ook WFT Vermogen en/of MiFID Informeren of ben je bereid deze te halen. Alle opleidingskosten worden vergoed door ING.
  • Je bent flexibel inzetbaar en combineert thuiswerken met werken vanuit één van de hub locaties Den Haag, Eindhoven, Leeuwarden, Zaandam en Zwolle of vanuit een ING-huis bij jou in de buurt.

Wat bieden wij?

  • Een meewerkstage vanaf februari 2027 afgestemd op de eisen vanuit jouw opleiding.
  • Een persoonlijke coach en leren onder werktijd.
  • Een uitdagende en leerzame omgeving met veel inzichten over mogelijke werkzaamheden binnen ING.
  • Een marktconforme stagevergoeding van EURO 700,- (bruto) bij een 36-urige werkweek.

Jouw sollicitatie

Stuur je CV voorzien van een motivatie waarin je uitlegt wie je bent, waarom jij de juiste kandidaat bent voor dit leertraject en op welke wijze je affiniteit met beleggen en/of de financiële markten hebt? Wij maken graag kennis met je.

Heb je vragen? Stuur dan een mail naar Bart Janssen, Digitaal Vermogen Team: Bart.Janssen1@ing.com.

title: Junior Product Designer
description:
About the Role

We're a Series A AI-powered B2B SaaS company operating in the procurement intelligence and supply chain space, backed by top-tier European and global investors. With a team of over 150 people based in Munich, we're shipping agentic AI products to industrial customers every week — and we're looking for a Junior Product Designer to help define what that experience looks like.

This is a rare opportunity to invent UX patterns that don't yet exist: how procurement professionals supervise AI agents, how those agents surface work, and how trust is built between humans and automated systems. You'll be part of a small, cross-functional team with direct impact on a product used by paying customers in a real industry vertical.

What You'll Do

  • Design end-to-end product flows, screens, and prototypes that ship to customers within weeks — not quarters.

  • Define how AI agents surface work, how humans review it, and how trust is built over time between user and system.

  • Prototype rapidly in Figma, code, and with AI tools to communicate ideas quickly and clearly.

  • Collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and domain experts to minimise handoff friction.

  • Review PRs and make last-mile interaction and visual tweaks to ensure shipped quality matches design intent.

  • Raise visual and interaction standards across the product and contribute to a shared design system.

  • Own features from discovery through launch — not just isolated screens.

  • Iterate rapidly based on real customer feedback and in-production usage data.

What We're Looking For

Required:

  • 0–2 years of product design experience (strong internships count) with a portfolio of shipped work, ideally in B2B, complex workflows, or data-heavy products.

  • Experience contributing to and maintaining a design system with a focus on consistency across the product.

  • End-to-end ownership experience: discovery, definition, design, and launch.

  • Daily use of AI tools in your design workflow — e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, v0, Figma Make — for ideation, prototyping, or collaboration.

  • Strong instinct for both visual design and interaction design, with genuine attention to detail.

  • Systems thinking: you care about how many features work together, not just individual screens.

  • Comfort with ambiguity and a bias toward shipping rather than endless polish.

  • Practical understanding of the design-to-development lifecycle and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Nice to Have:

  • Prototyping in code (HTML, CSS, React).

  • Experience designing for non-technical users operating in complex, domain-specific environments.

  • Opinions on how AI should appear in products beyond a simple chat interface.

We are an equal opportunity employer committed to equal employment regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or gender identity.

Location

This role is based on-site in Munich, Bavaria, Germany. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this position.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
About the Role

We are a bootstrapped AI platform studio based in Munich, Germany, building an all-in-one AI platform that empowers teams across the SME sector to integrate AI into their everyday workflows. Our platform already serves a large and rapidly growing user base across hundreds of companies, and we're scaling fast. You'll join a small, product-focused engineering team where your architectural decisions will have real, immediate impact.

We're looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer who thrives on complex infrastructure challenges, cares deeply about user experience, and wants to help shape engineering culture alongside a talented team.

What You'll Do

  • Own the most complex architectural problems on the platform — including multi-terabyte data synchronization and secure sandbox infrastructure.

  • Architect, build, and ship high-quality full-stack features using React and TypeScript with a focus on long-term scalability and UX.

  • Design and implement systems to synchronize and index large volumes of client data while enforcing fine-grained permissions.

  • Build infrastructure to process millions of LLM calls per month with high reliability and security.

  • Implement scalable, secure code sandbox solutions capable of spawning thousands of sandboxes per day.

  • Create base infrastructure and tooling for fast custom integrations, enabling new systems to be connected in hours.

  • Collaborate on technical roadmaps and drive alignment on architectural decisions with the wider development team.

  • Debug production incidents, identify root causes, and implement durable fixes to maintain platform stability.

  • Mentor junior engineers and elevate the codebase through thorough, constructive code reviews.

  • Continuously improve development processes, code quality standards, and overall team performance.

What We're Looking For

Required:

  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience with React, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and the surrounding ecosystem (Docker, CI/CD).

  • Proven experience designing, scaling, and maintaining complex software architectures for high-growth products.

  • Hands-on experience with tRPC (or an equivalent type-safe API communication framework), Kubernetes, and Docker.

  • Experience with PostgreSQL relational data modeling and query performance optimization.

  • Experience designing and implementing secure, multi-tenant sandbox environments.

  • Experience operating at scale: synchronizing large datasets, handling high volumes of LLM/API calls, and building secure multi-tenant systems.

  • Strong product ownership mindset with genuine attention to user experience and long-term product success.

  • A passion for mentoring engineers and actively shaping engineering standards and processes.

  • Willingness to work on-site in Munich, Germany (hybrid arrangement).

Nice to Have:

  • Prior experience working in AI platforms, LLM infrastructure, or similar AI/ML-adjacent products.

  • Background at an IT consulting, enterprise software, or B2B SaaS company.

  • Experience contributing to a fast-paced, small team environment where you've worn multiple hats.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Hybrid work arrangement based in Munich, Germany.

  • A high-impact role in a close-knit, product-focused team at an early-stage company.

About the Role

Join a small, product-focused team at a bootstrapped AI platform and consulting studio based in Munich, Germany. You'll work on the core platform that enables thousands of users to interact with AI every day — building high-quality full-stack features, scalable backend systems, and the infrastructure that powers massive LLM workloads, large-scale data synchronisation, and rapid custom integrations.   • Take pride in long-term code quality and scalable system design.

Compensation & Benefits
