description:
The group you’ll be a part of

Global Order Fulfillment - Global Operations

The Systems Planning organization within Global Order Fulfillment is at the center of Lam’s ability to deliver predictable, scalable, and responsive operations. By bringing together planning, manufacturing, supply chain, and logistics, Systems Planning ensures that customer demand is translated into clear, executable outcomes across the global factory network.

The impact you’ll make

The Kinaxis Subject Matter Expert (SME) serves as the primary business owner and single point of contact (SPOC) for all Kinaxis-related activities supporting the Factory Production Planning (FPP) organization. This role is responsible for driving system adoption, process optimization, break-fix resolution, and continuous improvement initiatives that enhance planning effectiveness, data integrity, decision quality, and overall business performance.

Acting as the liaison between Planning, Digital Transformation (DT), IT, and Kinaxis support teams, the SME ensures Kinaxis capabilities align with evolving business requirements and support the delivery of reliable, executable production plans across the global factory network. The role provides leadership in identifying system gaps, prioritizing enhancement opportunities, managing issue resolution, and enabling planners to maximize the value of the Kinaxis platform.

What you’ll do

In this role, you will serve as the Kinaxis SME for Factory Production Planning, maximizing the value of the Kinaxis platform through system support, continuous improvement, business-driven reporting and analytics, and cross-functional partnership by:

•Serve as the FPP Kinaxis Subject Matter Expert (SME) and Single Point of Contact (SPOC), providing business ownership, support, and guidance for all Kinaxis-related activities.
•Own the intake, prioritization, communication, and resolution of Kinaxis break-fix issues, partnering with DT, IT, and Kinaxis teams to drive timely resolution and minimize operational disruption.
•Lead continuous improvement (CIP) initiatives by identifying, prioritizing, and implementing system enhancements that improve planning quality, automation, efficiency, and user experience.
•Develop, maintain, and enhance Kinaxis reporting and analytics that enable business decision-making, including reports and dashboards for SRF changes, capacity gaps, available-to-promise (ATP), next available slot, schedule adherence, and planning performance.
•Gather and translate business requirements into system solutions, managing the Kinaxis enhancement backlog and ensuring planning processes, business rules, and data are accurately represented within the platform.
•Coordinate testing, validation, training, and deployment of new capabilities while partnering across Planning, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and DT teams to maximize the value of Kinaxis and support predictable planning outcomes.

Who we’re looking for

Qualifications
•Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering, Business, Information Systems, or related field.5+ years of experience in production planning, supply chain planning, manufacturing operations, or related disciplines.
•Demonstrated experience with Kinaxis RapidResponse or equivalent advanced planning systems.
•Strong understanding of production planning, capacity planning, scheduling, MRP, and S&OP processes.
•Experience translating business requirements into system solutions.
•Proven project management and stakeholder management capabilities.
•Strong analytical, problem-solving, and process improvement skills.
•Experience supporting enterprise system implementations and continuous improvement initiatives.
•APICS / ASCM CPIM or CSCP certification preferred

Professional Characteristics – Who we’re looking for

•Strategic and analytical thinker with strong business acumen and attention to detail.
•Data-driven decision maker with strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
•Effective communicator and collaborator who influences and aligns stakeholders across functions and regions.
•Demonstrates a high level of ownership, accountability, and commitment to execution excellence.
•Adaptable and resilient in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities and competing demands.
•Passionate about continuous improvement, standardization, and building scalable planning processes.

Preferred qualifications

About the Role The

Application Engineer – DX & VRV

plays a key role in delivering technically sound, optimized, and commercially competitive HVAC solutions across Daikin's sales organization. This role is responsible for equipment selection, system design validation, technical compliance, and application engineering support throughout the project lifecycle. You will work closely with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, and other internal stakeholders, and ensure that proposed DX and VRV solutions meet customer requirements, local regulations, and Daikin engineering standards while contributing to successful project execution and business growth in Qatar.

How You Will Make an Impact

Provide application engineering support to all Sales functions throughout the project lifecycle, from project inquiry to order confirmation.

Design, size, and select DX, VRV and AHU equipment using Daikin selection software (VRV, AHU selection software, and other approved engineering tools).

Review project specifications, tender documents, HVAC drawings, and schedules to develop compliant and optimized technical solutions.

Validate equipment selections to ensure technical feasibility, energy efficiency, compliance with project requirements, and adherence to Daikin engineering standards.

Prepare technical submittals, equipment schedules, selection reports, and engineering documentation to support project proposals.

Provide value engineering recommendations and alternative solutions that improve technical performance and commercial competitiveness.

Coordinate with Product Management, Sales, Factory Engineering, and other internal teams to resolve technical queries and ensure timely project support.

Support quotation preparation by providing accurate technical selections, engineering calculations, and costing inputs.

Participate in technical meetings with consultants, customers, contractors, and internal stakeholders to present solutions, discuss design requirements, and address application-related questions.

Stay current with HVAC technologies, local regulations, industry standards, and Daikin product developments to provide best in class application support.

Ensure smooth technical handover to the execution team following order confirmation.

What You Need to Succeed

Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, HVAC Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.

Minimum 5 years of experience in HVAC Application Engineering, Technical Support, or HVAC System Design, with strong expertise in DX and VRV systems, preferably within the Qatar or GCC market.

Strong knowledge of HVAC system design, equipment selection, psychometrics, heat load calculations, and energy‑efficient system applications.

Hands‑on experience using HVAC selection and design software, including VRV, Auto CAD, AHU selection software and Microsoft Office applications.

Solid understanding of MEP drawings, HVAC design standards, tender specifications, and consultant requirements.

Proven experience providing technical support across multiple sales channels, including equipment selection, solution optimization, value engineering, and technical proposal development.

Ability to analyze project requirements, identify technical risks, and recommend practical engineering solutions.

Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to build effective relationships with consultants, contractors, customers, and internal stakeholders.

Excellent planning, organizational, and problem‑solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and meet tight deadlines.

Fluent in English. Arabic language skills are an advantage.

Knowledge of international HVAC standards (ASHRAE and AHRI) and familiarity with the Qatar Construction Specifications (QCS) and other applicable local regulations will be an advantage.

Good climate starts with people Our employees are the beating heart of our company. At Daikin, you get to work in a positive environment backed by trust, creativity and continuous improvement. Together, we create our top-quality solutions by empowering talented teams. You will get plenty of opportunities to learn and grow. We are deeply committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace culture that reflects the communities we serve. Good climate starts with people.

title: Data Center Engineering Ops Engineer, Data Center Engineering Operations
description:
Description

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we're looking for talented people who want to help.

You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Infrastructure Operations (Data Center) Team is the backbone of AWS, supporting the rapidly growing AWS business and customers 24/7. We are committed to maintain the physical infrastructure of AWS, ensuring the standards for operational performance in the areas of safety, security, availability, productivity, capacity, efficiency, and cost.

We are looking for a Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO) Engineer with experience in critical facilities management, and a result-driven individual with strong technical understanding and the drive and vision to take our data center engineering operations to the next level. The DCEO Engineer is responsible for engineering operations including risk management and mitigation, planning, implementation of corrective and preventative maintenance for critical infrastructure and vendor management within our AWS Data Center environment. They are responsible for day-to-day operational excellence, maintenance of the critical infrastructure, supervising specialist vendors, acting as first responders to incidents, and becoming subject matter experts for the facility.

Key job responsibilities

The Data Center Engineering Operation Engineer is responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating within contract parameters within facilities. Often this will be including risk management and mitigation, corrective and preventative maintenance of critical infrastructure, vendor management and metric reporting.

Act as the site primary point of contact for internal and external stakeholders involving communication and relationship management. Meet daily hours of operations, on call requirements and response during rotations. Manage minor and major planned and unplanned site works for critical infrastructure, with a solid understanding of the works involved, risks, mitigation and seeking approvals within relevant SLA's as required. Responsible for the on-site management of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation. Establish performance benchmarks, conduct analysis, and prepare reports on all aspects of the data center facility infrastructure operations and maintenance. Generate change management requests & incident management tickets for DCEO activities. Work with DCO managers (IT), Networking, Logistics, Safety, Security and other business leaders and operating partners to coordinate projects, manage capacity, and optimize plant safety, performance, reliability, sustainability and efficiency. Establish documentation relevant to technical support of business & facility operations. Drive & implement projects to increase current facility capacity, efficiency, sustainability & reliability. Assist in recruiting efforts. Support operating partners in the resolution of any infrastructure engineering issues fine with 24x7 rotational shift hours

A day in the life

Troubleshoot facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA). Perform rack installs, rack decommissioning, and facility management. Provide operational readings and key performance indicators to make sure uptime is maintained Responsible for the on-site management of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation. Performance and oversight of maintenance and operations on all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center. Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.

About The Team

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career growth

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.

Basic Qualifications

4+ years of relevant work in a data center or other critical environment, or 4+ years of electrical and mechanical facilities maintenance experience Experience in a data center or other critical environment Tertiary or Bachelor's degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering

Preferred Qualifications

Knowledge of electrical systems in critical Data Center operations that include but are not limited to utility substation feeds, transformers, switchgear, VFI Class UPS, DRUPS, PDUs, ATS, STS, SLA/VRLA batteries and associated systems, diesel/gas turbine generators and related fuel systems, Surge Suppression, Active Harmonic Filtering, battery monitoring systems, branch circuit monitoring systems or SCADA systems Knowledge of mechanical systems in critical Data Center operations including but not limited to CRAC/CRAHs/AHUs, chillers, cooling towers, storage tanks, chemical systems, heat exchangers, piping systems, pumps, valves, duct systems, fans, or dampers

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. description:

People who live with cancer – those who work to prevent it, fight it, and survive it – are at the heart of every decision we make. The IT Quality Control Specialist oversees quality control and assurance of software, process, and data integrity validation processes. Provides guidance and support to operational teams within Sarah Cannon Research Institute to ensure compliance with GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, and regulatory requirements.   • Provides quality review of related to changes that impact validated systems and/or processes.

  • Bachelor's Degree required; professional qualified experience may be substituted for education.

  • Direct experience in QA/QC role in computerized systems validation

  • Experience in GCP clinical space, such as CRO or SMO, is highly preferred

  • 3+ years' professional work experience in a clinical research, biotech, or pharmaceutical environment focused in FDA GxP requirements for systems, 21 CFR Part 11 and FDA software validation guidelines.

  • Experience and knowledge of EU regulations, e.g., Annex 11 is preferred.

  • Knowledge of industry and international standards for software quality, such as GAMP V, PIC/S, ICH, etc.

title: Head of Artificial Intelligence – ICC
location: Waltham, Massachusetts, United States of America
description:
Head of Artificial Intelligence – ICC


Are you ready to build and lead a high-impact AI organization that turns sophisticated biology into decisive action for patients? Can you unite distributed expertise into a single, strategic engine that accelerates discovery and transforms how we work end to end?

AstraZeneca is creating a new leadership role to consolidate and direct AI across Cell Therapy Discovery and Targeted Immune Engagers. Based in the United States (GTB or BOS), the United Kingdom (Cambridge) or the Netherlands (Amsterdam), you will compose the AI strategy, lead delivery of a high-value portfolio, and embed AI as a core capability powering our next wave of medicines. As a member of the CTD and TIE leadership teams reporting to the SVP for IO Discovery and Cell Therapy Oncology, you will set direction, mobilize talent, and deliver measurable impact across discovery and operations.

This is a hands-on, build-and-scale mandate. You will form a centralized group of AI experts embedded with R&D teams, orchestrate initiatives from agentic knowledge hubs to predictive CAR-T models and in silico binder design, and establish the governance and operating rhythm that turns prototypes into durable platforms and outcomes.

Accountabilities:


- Strategic Leadership: Define and implement the end-to-end AI strategy across CTD and TIE, aligned to enterprise AI goals, with a clear roadmap for 2026–2027 and beyond.
- Portfolio Orchestration: Prioritize and deliver a focused slate of initiatives including agentic knowledge hubs, predictive modeling for cell therapy, in silico protein and binder design, TCR affinity maturation, CRISPR off-target safety, and next-generation analytics.
- Agentic AI Development: Build, test, and scale knowledge hub capabilities that enable collaborative analysis, rapid retrieval of institutional knowledge, and faster, better decisions.
- Predictive Modeling for Cell Therapy: Lead models that optimize CAR-T design and performance, reducing cycle times from hypothesis to validation and improving program selection.
- In Silico Protein and Binder Design: Deploy AI workflows that generate and refine binders and mature affinity, increasing hit quality and reducing experimental burden.
- CRISPR Safety and Risk: Implement sophisticated off-target workflows to improve safety assessments, strengthen study build, and de-risk pipelines.
- Workflow Automation: Automate research and analytics processes to streamline operations, reduce manual effort, and increase reproducibility across sites and teams.
- AI Upskilling and Culture: Orchestrate training that lifts foundational AI literacy and fosters an innovative, high-integrity culture where scientists and engineers co-create solutions.
- Collaborator Partnership: Build deep collaboration with enterprise AI, platform, and external partners to align standards, share knowledge, and improve resource leverage.
- Governance and Value Realization: Implement robust governance, regulatory compliance, and budget/resource management; institute KPIs that quantify scientific and operational value.
- Communication and Influence: Translate sophisticated technical insights into clear narratives for executive and non-technical collaborators, shaping R&D strategy and investment decisions.

Essential Skills/Experience:


- Advanced degree (Master’s or PhD) in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.
- Demonstrated 10+ years of experience successfully leading high-performing AI teams and sophisticated AI programs, ideally in life sciences, technology, or R&D-driven environments.
- Strategic skill in shaping, scaling, and transforming AI activities for maximum business and scientific impact.
- Expertise in the development and deployment of AI/ML technologies, with proven outcomes in sophisticated, multi-stakeholder environments.
- Strong understanding of biology or R&D workflows preferred but not required; ability to translate between technical and scientific teams is essential.
- Outstanding organizational, communication, and collaborator engagement skills, including experience communicating/translating sophisticated technical findings and priorities to executive and non-technical partners.
- Proven experience building, mentoring, and scaling multi-disciplinary teams comprised of machine learning scientists, AI engineers, and data professionals, distributed across multiple locations and embedded in different R&D teams.
- Track record of encouraging a collaborative, innovative, and high-integrity team culture.

Desirable Skills/Experience:


- Direct experience applying AI/ML to cell therapy, protein engineering, immunology, or related modalities.
- Demonstrated delivery of one or more: agentic knowledge hubs, CAR-T predictive models, in silico binder generation, TCR affinity maturation workflows, CRISPR off-target analyses, or computational mutagenesis.
- Familiarity with LLMs, knowledge graphs, MLOps, and cloud-native platforms; experience integrating these into enterprise environments.
- Experience with data governance, model risk management, and compliance practices relevant to R&D and regulated settings.
- Success managing multi-site teams and external ecosystems, including vendors, consortia, and academic collaborations.
- Portfolio management experience with clear KPI frameworks and budget ownership.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash ambitious thinking with the power to encourage life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our outstanding and ambitious world!

Why AstraZeneca:


Here, ground breaking science meets ambitious technology in service of patients. You will join a community that thrives on collaboration across subject areas, where ideas move quickly from exploration to scaled platforms that change how we discover and develop medicines. We put unexpected teams together to unlock new thinking, invest deeply in digital capabilities across the R&D lifecycle, and value kindness alongside ambition so people can take smart risks and learn fast. Your leadership will connect AI breakthroughs to tangible outcomes for patients and programs, while opening new horizons for your own growth.

title: Director, Cyber Security Detection Engineering
location: Gaithersburg, Maryland, United States of America
description:
Leverage technology to impact patients and ultimately save lives

Do you have expertise in, and passion for, information technology? Would you like to apply your expertise to impact the IT strategy in a company that follows the science and turns ideas into life changing medicines? If so, AstraZeneca might be the one for you!

ABOUT ASTRAZENECA

AstraZeneca is a global, science-led, patient-focused biopharmaceutical company that focuses on the discovery, development and commercialization of prescription medicines for some of the world’s most serious disease.

But we’re more than one of the world’s leading pharmaceutical companies. At AstraZeneca, we're dedicated to being a Great Place to Work.

ABOUT ROLE:

The Director, Cyber Security Detection Engineering is a senior leader in the Cyber Operations function, based in Gaithersburg, Maryland, working with the Head of Cyber Operations. The role encompasses command of enterprise detection capabilities across cloud, on-premises, and OT/ICS environments, ownership of detection governance and validation, and delivery of executive reporting, coverage assessments, and capability maturation in partnership with GSOC, CTI, Vulnerability Management, Offensive Security, IT, Legal, Risk and Compliance, and business customers.

What You'll Do:

  • Detection strategy and roadmap: Direct the development and execution of comprehensive detection engineering programmes aligned to interpersonal risk appetite and threat landscape; establish capability roadmaps spanning data engineering, detection development, purple teaming, and automation/AI.

  • Data engineering oversight: Ensure robust data pipelines support detection activities through telemetry collection, normalization, and quality assurance across hybrid and OT environments; define data retention, schema standards, and platform configuration to enable effective threat detection.

  • Detection content development: Oversee creation, testing, and deployment of detection logic across SIEM, EDR, and cloud-native tooling; enforce detection standards, naming conventions, and MITRE ATT&CK mapping; prioritise coverage based on threat intelligence and risk assessments.

  • Purple Team Exercising: Oversee purple team operations to validate detection efficacy systematically; orchestrate adversary emulation exercises across technology domains; drive remediation of detection gaps identified through testing and operational feedback.

  • Automation and AI integration: Operationalise AI agents, machine learning models, and orchestration workflows to enhance detection accuracy, reduce false positives, and augment GSOC analyst capabilities; oversee development of automated enrichment, triage, and investigation playbooks.

  • Metrics and reporting: Own detection engineering targets (e.g., MITRE ATT&CK coverage, mean time to detect, false positive rates, purple team success metrics) and deliver executive-ready briefings, dashboards, and quarterly maturity assessments.

  • Policy and governance: Develop and enforce detection engineering policies, standards, and quality frameworks; maintain detection content libraries with version control and organizational change field; ensure regulatory compliance in data handling.

People Leadership:

  • Strategy and planning: Develop and maintain detection engineering area plans aligned to Cyber Operations strategy; set direction and goals with autonomy across data engineering, detection development, purple teaming, and automation functions.

  • Performance and tiers: Define and review reporting and team targets; align objectives to detection outcomes, coverage improvements, and operational efficiency.

  • Talent and capability: Lead inclusive recruitment; build career paths and targeted upskilling in detection development, threat hunting, cloud security, OT/ICS detection, and SOAR/AI through multi-functional, regional, and external partnerships.

Knowledge, Experience, and Understanding Of:

  • Detection engineering lifecycle: Proven leadership across detection development, testing, deployment, and tuning at enterprise scale; deep understanding of detection logic design, coverage mapping, and efficacy validation.

  • Threat detection frameworks: Extensive knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK, Cyber Kill Chain, and detection engineering methodologies; experience mapping organisational coverage and prioritising development based on threat intelligence.

  • Purple team operations: Experienced in designing and accomplishing adversary emulation exercises; skilled in translating purple team findings into actionable detection improvements and coverage enhancements.

  • Automation and AI: Experience operationalizing modern detection platforms (SIEM, XDR, SOAR) including integration of artificial intelligence, machine learning models, and agentic features to enable detection at scale.

  • Data engineering and platforms: Proficient with data pipeline architecture, log aggregation, normalisation, and query optimisation; solid grasp of data quality requirements for effective detection.

  • Cloud, identity, and endpoint detection: Deep understanding of detection approaches across multi-cloud environments, identity systems, endpoints, and network infrastructure; familiar with cloud-native security services and integration patterns.

  • Manufacturing Operational Technology/Industrial Control Systems: Coordinating detection engineering in industrial/OT environments with safety, availability, and production continuity considerations; knowledge of industrial protocols and OT-specific threats.

Minimum Skills & Experience Required

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in information security, computer science, or related field (or equivalent experience).

  • Enterprise-scale detection leadership: Over 5 years managing detection engineering or security operations in enterprise-sized organisations, commanding capabilities across hybrid cloud, on-premises, and OT environments.

  • Global coordination with distributed teams: Experience integrating and working alongside global, 24×7, geographically dispersed teams to deliver detection capabilities and support security operations missions.

  • Communication and facilitation: Well-developed skills to explain complex technical concepts in clear business terms; produce concise written material (executive updates, coverage reports); and lead briefings to diverse stakeholders.

  • Analytical decision making: Ability to analyse complex threat landscapes, assess detection gaps, and balance strategic capability development with tactical operational requirements, risk appetite, and resource constraints.

  • Customer orientation and cross-cultural working: Demonstrated ability to collaborate across regions and functions (GSOC, IT, Legal, GRC, business units) with a strong service approach and commitment to enabling organisational resilience.

Preferred Skills & Experience:

  • Certifications: Security certifications preferred (e.g., CISSP, CISM, GIAC such as GCIA/GCDA/GMON; cloud certifications; ITIL).

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to encourage life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.

title: Bio-Process Technician (24/7 Shift)
description:
Are you ready to apply your bioprocess expertise to deliver life-changing therapies for people living with rare diseases? Join a manufacturing team where precision, ownership, and cross-functional collaboration turn complex science into reliable supply for patients who count on us.

In this shift-based role, you will become fully trained and competent across core operations and develop a specialist focus where you lead improvements for your area. Do you thrive in a fast-moving environment where you mentor others, resolve deviations, and elevate standards in cGMP every day? Your impact will be felt on the floor and, ultimately, by patients whose journeys drive our mission.

Accountabilities
-Core Production Operations: Independently perform cell culture, media preparation, purification, buffer preparation, and equipment preparation to deliver consistent, compliant batches.
-cGMP Execution and Documentation: Execute all tasks according to SOPs and batch records with full attention to detail and excellent documentation, safeguarding product quality and patient safety.
-Area Specialism and Technical Leadership: Develop subject matter expertise in at least one operational area and act as a Champion, leading improvements and excellence within the shift team.
-Deviation and Change Control: Assist with investigations of operational deviations through the QTS system; lead and own investigations and change controls when required to restore control and prevent recurrence.
-Training and Knowledge Transfer: Mentor colleagues in SOPs, process execution, and equipment operation; act as designee to prepare and deliver shift handovers, reporting to leadership, technical services, and engineering stakeholders.
-Stakeholder Engagement: Engage with Technical Services, QA, and Automation to resolve issues; interface effectively with MCS to anticipate, diagnose, and troubleshoot operational challenges.
-Validation and Start-up Support: Assist in facility and equipment start-up and validation; provide input on installation, start-up, operation, and troubleshooting to support new product introduction into sustaining operations.
-Lean and Continuous Improvement: Demonstrate a Lean mindset and lead by example, driving standard work, waste reduction, and process stability.
-EHS, GMP, and Productivity: Be a positive example in environmental health and safety, GMP compliance, and productivity to support a high-performance culture.
-Shift Operations: Work a varied shift pattern that typically includes weekends and periodic rotation between day and night, aligning with business requirements.

Essential Skills/Experience
- Trained and competent to independently perform core production tasks in cell culture, media preparation, purification, buffer preparation, and equipment preparation.
- Responsible for execution of all tasks according to SOPs and batch records in a cGMP environment, ensuring full attention to detail and excellent documentation skills.
- High level of SME knowledge and experience in at least one area of operations (e.g., Level 1/Level 2); effective process leader within that area.
- Able to anticipate and troubleshoot operational issues and interface effectively with MCS.
- Engage with stakeholders including Technical Services, QA, and Automation to resolve issues.

- Lead and own investigations and change controls if required; assist with the investigation of operations deviations through the QTS system.
- Demonstrate a Lean mindset and lead by example in this area.
- Shift working required, including weekend working and periodic rotation between day and night shifts; shift pattern may vary according to business requirements.

Desirable Skills/Experience
- Cross-trained across multiple unit operations, with flexibility to move between cell culture and downstream purification as needed.
- Experience with electronic systems supporting manufacturing (e.g., QTS, MCS) and familiarity with data-driven troubleshooting.
- Exposure to equipment installation, qualification, and validation, including start-up of new lines or technologies.
- Proven contributions to SOP and batch record creation or optimization.
- Formal training in root cause analysis, problem-solving, or Lean/continuous improvement methodologies.
- Strong communication skills to engage confidently with QA, Technical Services, Automation, and operations leadership during investigations and handovers.

Why AstraZeneca
Here you will help deliver therapies for people often overlooked by the healthcare system, guided by their lived experiences and needs. We bring unexpected teams into the same room—operators, engineers, quality specialists, and automation experts—to unleash bold thinking and build reliable, scalable manufacturing. You will work with cutting-edge biologics processes and digital tools, in a culture that values kindness alongside ambition and supports you to lead improvements that matter for patients and for your growth.

Call to Action
If you’re ready to lead on the line, elevate standards, and turn rigorous cGMP execution into real impact for patients, take the next step and apply today!

title: Deployment Strategist
description:
The Role

The Deployment Strategist is the technical architect and implementer for each AI deployment, bridging customer needs and technical execution. You'll design agent workflows, manage the build process, handle integrations, and ensure deployments deliver measurable clinical value.

This role demands strong technical judgment, customer empathy, and the ability to scope complex problems under uncertainty. You're not writing code—you're orchestrating integrations, configuring AI agents, and running the deployment from initial scoping through optimization.

What Success Looks Like

  • Impact at deployment: Your scoping process accurately translates customer workflows into well-structured agent designs that deliver measurable results

  • Efficient builds: You use established tools and patterns to configure agents quickly, spending your time on high-value technical decisions rather than low-level coding

  • Smooth integrations: You define integration requirements clearly, work with engineering to execute them, and ensure data flows reliably between our agents and customer systems

  • Customer leadership: You're the trusted technical and operational advisor to the customer, explaining trade-offs, managing expectations, and proposing solutions

  • Analytics-driven optimization: You monitor agent performance, identify opportunities to improve accuracy or efficiency, and drive continuous refinement

  • Knowledge capture: You document patterns, create reusable configurations, and build institutional knowledge that accelerates future deployments

  • Effective project management: You are leading use case implementations end to end - tracking to milestones and ensuring successful timely go-lives.

Core Responsibilities

  • Initial Scoping & Requirement Analysis – partner with the customer to understand workflows, define agent scope, and identify integration touchpoints

  • Agent Build & Configuration – design agent workflows, select tools, configure prompts and behaviors, and validate functionality

  • Technical Account Management – act as the lead during deployment, managing scope decisions and explaining technical constraints to customers

  • Project Management – develop build timelines, coordinate with engineering, track progress, and escalate blockers early

  • Integration Architecture – define data requirements, design integration workflows, and partner with engineering to implement them

  • Post-Launch Analytics & Optimization – monitor agent performance, analyze usage patterns, and drive continuous improvements

Location & Travel

  • This is a forward-deployed, onsite role.

  • This is an onsite role based in the North Seattle area, with five days per week at the client site and occasional travel to Hippocratic AI headquarters (Menlo Park, CA) for strategic planning and team sessions.

What You Bring

Must Haves

  • 5+ years of technical experience (software engineering, cloud architecture, systems design, or technical consulting)

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills—ability to translate ambiguous customer needs into clear technical requirements

  • Customer empathy and communication: you can explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences and listen deeply to understand underlying customer needs

  • Project management capability: you scope work, estimate timelines, manage dependencies, and communicate status proactively

Nice to Haves

  • Healthcare domain expertise (clinical workflows, EHR systems, healthcare data standards like FHIR)

  • Experience with AI/ML orchestration, prompt engineering, or LLM-powered applications

  • Healthcare IT experience (EHR integrations, healthcare data pipelines, clinical informatics)

  • Experience building tools for complex, regulated environments

Why Hippocratic AI

  • You're architecting deployments of the world's first healthcare-only, safety-focused LLM—a breakthrough platform designed to transform patient outcomes at global scale. As the DS, you shape how that safety-first approach translates into real agent designs that clinicians trust. This is category creation, and you're the technical strategist making it work.

  • You work with an exceptional caliber of technical and clinical talent: AI pioneers from Google, Meta, Microsoft, NVIDIA alongside physicians and hospital leaders from Johns Hopkins, Washington University, Stanford. The insights you gain from customers and partners will accelerate your growth exponentially. You'll solve harder technical problems alongside smarter people.

  • Backed by $404M in funding from the world's leading healthcare and AI investors—CapitalG, a16z, General Catalyst, Kleiner Perkins, and strategic investors like UHS, Cincinnati Children's, and WellSpan Health. This resources and confidence in the vision mean you can focus on technical excellence without worrying about runway. You're building for scale and longevity.

  • Every agent you architect has measurable clinical impact. Unlike many technical roles where success is indirect, your designs directly improve patient outcomes, increase clinician efficiency, and transform how healthcare operates. You'll see the clinical value of your technical decisions and know that your work matters in a way few engineering roles do.

Please be aware of recruitment scams impersonating Hippocratic AI. All recruiting communication will come from @ email addresses. We will never request payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process.

title: Associate Scientist, Analytical Development
description:
Working with Us
Challenging. Meaningful. Life-changing. Those aren’t words that are usually associated with a job. But working at Bristol Myers Squibb is anything but usual. Here, uniquely interesting work happens every day, in every department. From optimizing a production line to the latest breakthroughs in cell therapy, this is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it. You’ll get the chance to grow and thrive through opportunities uncommon in scale and scope, alongside high-achieving teams. Take your career farther than you thought possible.

Bristol Myers Squibb recognizes the importance of balance and flexibility in our work environment. We offer a wide variety of competitive benefits, services and programs that provide our employees with the resources to pursue their goals, both at work and in their personal lives. Read more: .

Business Unit Overview
Our Chemical Process Development (CPD) team is committed to CMC design, development, and commercialization of innovative drug substances to improve patient lives. We leverage the best people, collaboration, and cutting-edge innovation to achieve this commitment. BMS’s internal engine of innovation includes unrivaled industry leading expertise in CMC development of small molecules, protein biotherapeutics, protein degraders, and other therapeutic modalities. We collaborate closely with our colleagues in R&D and Commercial designing our medicines. Here, you’ll get the chance to grow and thrive through opportunities that are uncommon in scale and scope.

Position Summary
This Analytical Development role will be responsible for developing effective collaborations within CPD project teams consisting of organic chemists, chemical engineers, and analytical scientists to support an increasingly complex portfolio of small molecules and milla-molecular (ADCs, peptides, oligonucleotides) drug candidates.

  • Accountable for providing fit-for-purpose analytical methods and analyses which provide key insights and process knowledge for scale-up and process optimization studies for projects within the portfolio.
  • Facilitate analytical problem solving by utilizing various analytical techniques in the development of drug substance programs.
  • Accountable for collaborating within project teams to provide innovative analytical approaches to help solve challenging problems encountered to support route selection and process optimization studies conducted by chemists and chemical engineers.
  • Partners with other Analytical Functions within CPD, and across Product Development to evolve, integrate and optimize analytical support to create a world-class analytical function.


Key Responsibilities
The Associate Scientist will collaborate as an individual contributor within an analytical project matrix team for multiple development candidates across BMS sites to develop analytical methodology to support drug substance process development. This includes:

  • Development of in-process and release analytical methods throughout the synthetic chemistry of drug substances including chromatography-based methods such as HPLC/UHPLC/SEC/GC/IC, as well as other pharmaceutically relevant techniques (e.g., KF, LOD, titration, etc.), under the supervision of a senior scientist.
  • Critical analysis of analytical results with the goal of improving the robustness of analytical methods and enhancing understanding of key quality attributes.
  • Responsible for actively collaborating with other key scientists within the team.
  • Expected to consistently display a can-do attitude and demonstrate the willingness and capability to adapt and grow within a complex and changing environment.
  • Review and discuss analytical results and conclusions both orally and in writing.

Qualifications & Experience
Required:

  • BS or MS in Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or equivalent, with 1–5 years of demonstrated pharmaceutical industry experience in relevant analytical techniques (or 0–2 years with an MS).
  • Experience with various analytical techniques, including chromatography and/or spectroscopy preferred.
  • Familiarity with modern laboratory equipment, automation, and digital tools
  • Demonstrated commitment to safety.
  • Ability to execute and document scientific experiments and effectively communicate study results.
  • Demonstrated problem solving skills and strong desire to grow scientifically.
  • Strong written and oral communication skills.
  • Excellent interpersonal, collaborative, team building, and communication skills to ensure effective collaborations within matrix teams. Demonstrated performance against cooperation principles and enterprise mindset.

title: Analyst - Real Estate
description:
This is a remote position.

We are seeking a detail-oriented, highly analytical, and experienced Remote Title Abstractor to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for conducting comprehensive title searches, examining real estate records, and preparing accurate title abstracts for properties located in North Carolina (NC) and/or South Carolina (SC).

The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of the unique real estate recording laws, probate processes, and tax structures in Carolinas' counties. You must be able to work independently in a remote environment while maintaining strict accuracy and meeting fast-paced deadlines.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Title Examination: Conduct thorough full-search, current-owner, and update searches by examining chain of title, deeds, mortgages, liens, judgments, probate records, maps, and tax assessments.
  • Public Records Research: Utilize online county portals, ROD (Register of Deeds) systems, Clerk of Court platforms, and geographic information systems (GIS) to abstract necessary information.
  • Abstract Preparation: Compile and analyze search findings to produce clear, concise, and structured title abstracts, ensuring all clouds on title or potential liabilities are clearly flagged.
  • Data Entry & Management: Input abstract details accurately into the title production software, keeping files organized and current.
  • Problem Solving: Identify and resolve missing links, name discrepancies, legal description errors, or complex vesting issues in the chain of title.
  • Compliance & Standards: Ensure all abstracting work adheres to individual county standards, state legal requirements, and underwriter guidelines.

Required Qualifications:

  • Experience: Minimum of 2–4 years of proven experience performing real estate title abstracting or examination.
  • Geographic Expertise: Direct, hands-on experience abstracting properties in North Carolina and/or South Carolina. Deep familiarity with local county recording systems and probate practices is essential.

About the Role

Join a small, fast-moving energy software startup in Munich building an end-to-end platform for industrial battery storage — covering AI-driven operations, real-time optimization, and energy market trading. What You'll Do

  • Strong database design and data modeling skills (PostgreSQL/MySQL or similar).

  • Prior startup experience — ideally at a company under 3 years old and fewer than 50 employees.

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, or Electrical Engineering (grade better than 2.0 on the German scale or equivalent).

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in the energy industry (battery storage, grid management, energy markets, or similar).

title: Product Owner
description:
Product Owner

About Us

We are a leading provider in the sports betting and gaming industry, known for our innovative approach and high-quality products. As we continue to expand our product offering, we are looking for a talented and experienced Sportsbook Product Owner to join our dynamic team.

Job Description

We are seeking a Product Owner to help shape and continuously improve our Sportsbook platform, taking ownership of defined features and initiatives from discovery through delivery and post-launch. You will work within a structured product team, partnering closely with a senior Product Manager while having meaningful ownership of your assigned product areas.

As you demonstrate impact, sound judgement, and domain mastery, you will progressively take on broader ownership and greater autonomy. This role offers a clear path for developing your expertise in product discovery, prioritisation, stakeholder management, and the Sportsbook domain.

Key Responsibilities

Create clear and comprehensive product requirements by writing user stories with well-defined acceptance criteria and providing visual aids such as wireframes and flowcharts when needed, ensuring development teams have the information needed to achieve the desired outcomes.

Participate in and contribute to product discovery for assigned initiatives, generating hypotheses, gathering requirements, and proposing solutions in close collaboration with the Product Manager, senior colleagues, product designers, data analysts, and engineering teams.

Manage and prioritise the product backlog for assigned features and initiatives, working closely with the Product Manager to ensure priorities reflect business value, customer needs, technical feasibility, and strategic goals.

Contribute to product direction and strategy for assigned initiatives, ensuring that feature decisions align with the broader product vision, strategic goals, and customer needs.

Work closely with development teams by answering questions, clarifying requirements, resolving product-related issues, and helping remove blockers to facilitate timely product delivery.

Collaborate with other departments as needed to ensure successful product outcomes. Define success metrics for your initiatives where appropriate, track them through delivery and post-launch, and report progress and learnings to the Product Manager.

Communicate updates on product releases and the status of ongoing development efforts to the broader organization, ensuring transparency and alignment.

Coordinate and support user acceptance testing (UAT) for new product releases, ensuring that functionality meets the agreed requirements and acceptance criteria.

Maintain product documentation and internal wikis, ensuring they are always up-to-date and accessible for relevant teams.

Conduct demos and training sessions for stakeholders on new product concepts and releases, ensuring effective knowledge transfer and adoption.

Continuously assess the live product, identifying areas for improvement and addressing gaps between the expected and actual user experience. Develop improvement proposals and work with the Product Manager to prioritise and implement them.

Key Requirements

Must

2–4 years of Product Owner, Business Analyst, or equivalent product role experience, with demonstrable ownership of features through the full delivery lifecycle - from discovery through post-launch.

Solid experience managing and prioritising a product backlog, working closely with the Product Manager and development teams to deliver value incrementally.

Solid experience with Agile practices (Scrum, Kanban), including sprint planning, sprint reviews, and backlog refinement, with the ability to work effectively in fast-paced, iterative environments.

Experience writing clear, actionable user stories and defining well-structured acceptance criteria, ensuring development teams and stakeholders have a shared understanding of requirements and intended outcomes.

Strong ability to work with cross-functional teams, including engineering, data, product design, business analysis, marketing, and operations.

Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to identify issues, evaluate options, make informed trade-offs, and drive resolution across both product development and live operations.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts in a simple and accessible way for non-technical stakeholders.

Desirable but Not Required

A solid understanding of backend systems, including architecture, databases, APIs, and microservices.

Prior experience in the gambling, betting, gaming, or sportsbook industry will be considered a plus.

An interest in sports, sports betting, or the broader gambling industry is an advantage and can help build domain knowledge quickly.

What success looks like in this role

Within the first 6 months, you will have led the delivery of at least one product initiative as the primary Product Owner, with PM oversight - produced high-quality specifications that required minimal rework, and demonstrated consistent, proactive communication with your team and stakeholders.

Within 12 months, you will be operating with increasing autonomy, contributing meaningfully to discovery with reduced reliance on PM guidance, and demonstrating a growing command of the domain and its technical underpinnings.

title: Senior Power Platform Developer / Technical Lead
description:
About the Organization

E2 Consulting Engineers, LP (E2) is a professional services firm established in 1988 specializing in a full spectrum of engineering services including, project engineering and design, federal base operations and infrastructure support services, gas pipeline construction and inspection services, environmental consulting and remediation, and information technology services. At E2, we value safety, innovation and collaboration, and we are dedicated to excellence.

Overview

We are looking for an experienced Senior Power Platform Developer / Technical Lead to help design, develop, and mature our use of Microsoft Power Platform and Dynamics 365.

This role will initially partner closely with the CTO / Systems Architect of our sister organization on a Power Platform proof of concept and subsequent production initiatives. The successful candidate will bring deep, current platform expertise and help guide solution design, development, integrations, governance, security, and application lifecycle management.

This is a hands-on technical role. We are looking for someone who can both advise on architecture and build solutions, identify platform limitations, challenge assumptions, and recommend when Power Platform, Dynamics 365, Azure, Microsoft 365, APIs, or custom development are the appropriate tools.

Because Power Platform evolves rapidly, candidates must demonstrate recent, practical knowledge of the platform as it exists today, not simply experience with approaches that were common several years ago.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with the CTO / Systems Architect to design secure, maintainable, and scalable Power Platform solutions.
  • Design and develop solutions using Power Apps, Dataverse, Power Automate, Dynamics 365, and related Microsoft technologies.
  • Design Dataverse data models, relationships, business rules, security models, forms, views, and application components.
  • Design and implement integrations between Power Platform and internal or third-party systems using APIs, custom connectors, Azure services, and other appropriate technologies.
  • Evaluate when functionality belongs in Power Platform versus Azure or traditional application development.
  • Establish reusable architecture patterns, development standards, naming conventions, and governance practices.
  • Design and support Development, Test/UAT, and Production environments.
  • Implement professional application lifecycle management using Solutions, environment variables, connection references, deployment pipelines, source control, and CI/CD where appropriate.
  • Design solutions using Microsoft Entra ID, Dataverse security roles, ownership models, and least-privilege principles.
  • Support Power Platform governance capabilities including Data Loss Prevention policies, connector controls, Managed Environments, auditing, monitoring, and administrative standards.
  • Review solutions for performance, scalability, security, licensing, maintainability, and platform limitations.
  • Stay current with changes across the Power Platform ecosystem and recommend improvements as Microsoft introduces new capabilities and changes recommended practices.
  • Document architectural decisions, development standards, integration patterns, and lessons learned for future initiatives.

Qualifications

  • Significant professional experience building and supporting production Microsoft Power Platform solutions.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Power Apps, Dataverse, Power Automate, Power Platform Solutions, security, and ALM.
  • Experience with Dynamics 365, including configuration, extension, or integration with the broader Power Platform ecosystem.
  • Strong understanding of Dataverse data modeling, relationships, ownership, security, and application architecture.
  • Demonstrated experience integrating Power Platform with external business systems.
  • Experience designing and consuming REST APIs, working with authentication and authorization, and developing or using custom connectors.
  • Experience implementing structured Development, Test/UAT, and Production environments and repeatable deployment processes.
  • Experience with Microsoft Entra ID and Microsoft 365 integrations.
  • Ability to independently evaluate technical requirements, identify tradeoffs, and recommend appropriate solutions.
  • Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills.

Candidates must also demonstrate current Power Platform expertise, including recent production experience and familiarity with modern environment management, governance, deployment practices, Dataverse capabilities, licensing considerations, and Microsoft’s evolving AI and Copilot capabilities. Candidates should be prepared to discuss how their Power Platform design and development practices have changed as the platform has evolved.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience with Azure services such as Azure Functions, App Service, API Management, Service Bus, Azure SQL, Key Vault, and Storage.
  • Experience with Microsoft Graph.
  • Professional development experience using C#/.NET, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar technologies.
  • Experience developing Dataverse plugins, custom APIs, PCF controls, or other Power Platform extensions.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps or similar CI/CD tooling.
  • Experience integrating ERP or other enterprise systems with Dataverse.
  • Experience with SharePoint, Teams, Outlook, OneDrive, and other Microsoft 365 services.
  • Experience establishing Power Platform governance and development standards within an organization.
  • Familiarity with Copilot Studio and AI-enabled Power Platform capabilities

We offer an excellent benefits package including health, dental, vision, and life insurance, and 401(k).

Job Summary: Keep critical manufacturing operations running smoothly as a Lube Operator at Pratt & Whitney’s Columbus Forge site.   • Identify and report equipment issues, assist with troubleshooting, and support corrective actions as needed.
  • Safely operate a forklift to transport material, maintain a clean and organized work area, and follow all safety, quality, and operating procedures.

title: Sanitation Worker
description:
Sanitation Worker

The Organization

At Wholesome Kids Catering, our core values are deeply ingrained in everything we do. With a purpose to Nourish Lives, we take pride in providing childcare centres and schools with healthy, delicious, and child-friendly meals and snacks. Our dedicated and experienced team is driven by a passion for delivering WOW to our valued customers and stakeholders.

Our menus are thoughtfully crafted to align with our Eat Grow Thrive philosophy, emphasizing excellent nutrition while incorporating flavours and foods that children love. Over the next three years, our focus is to be the dominant brand for childcare catering in the Greater Toronto and Hamilton Area. Our state-of-the-art, custom-designed facility supports continued growth and our commitment to being a strong, trusted partner.

The Opportunity

The Sanitation Worker is a hands-on role responsible for completing assigned cleaning and sanitation activities throughout the food production facility. This position plays an essential part in maintaining a clean, safe, compliant, and production-ready workplace while protecting food safety, product quality, and employee safety.

The Role

Reporting to the Sanitation Lead, the Sanitation Worker cleans and sanitizes food-contact and non-food-contact surfaces, equipment, utensils, production areas, welfare areas, and waste-handling areas in accordance with Standard Sanitation Operating Procedures (SSOPs), the Master Sanitation Schedule (MSS), Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs), HACCP programs, WHMIS requirements, and company health and safety procedures.

The Sanitation Worker follows approved chemical handling and equipment-cleaning procedures, completes required records accurately, identifies abnormal or unsafe conditions, and immediately reports food safety, allergen, chemical, equipment, or workplace hazards to the Sanitation Lead or Sanitation Supervisor.

Success

The successful Sanitation Worker consistently completes assigned sanitation tasks safely, thoroughly, and on time. Equipment and work areas meet inspection standards, sanitation records are accurate, and any sanitation or food safety concerns are promptly reported. The employee is dependable, detail-oriented, responsive to coaching, and contributes positively to a disciplined and food safety-focused sanitation team.

Key Accountabilities

Sanitation Execution

  • Complete assigned daily, weekly, and periodic sanitation tasks in accordance with SSOPs, the MSS, GMPs, and HACCP requirements.
  • Clean, wash, rinse, sanitize, and reassemble food-contact and non-food-contact equipment as trained and authorized.
  • Clean and sanitize kettles, pots, pans, utensils, cutting surfaces, food containers, racks, carts, processing equipment, floors, walls, drains, and other assigned areas.
  • Perform specialized cleaning activities, including drains, exhaust hoods, overheads, coils, and Clean-Out-of-Place (COP) systems, when assigned and trained.
  • Follow required cleaning sequences, chemical concentrations, water temperatures, dwell/contact times, and rinsing requirements.
  • Inspect cleaned equipment and areas for visible residue, damage, foreign material, or unsanitary conditions before advising the Sanitation Lead that the task is complete.
  • Promptly re-clean and correct sanitation deficiencies identified during inspections or verification activities.
  • Maintain cleanliness of restrooms, cafeteria and welfare areas, exterior grounds, waste areas, and other assigned facility spaces.
  • Safely collect, sort, and dispose of waste, recyclables, and food debris in accordance with company procedures.
  • Protect tools, parts, ingredients, packaging, and equipment from contamination during sanitation activities.
  • Use sanitation supplies, water, and chemicals responsibly to minimize waste while achieving required standards.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

Food Safety, Allergen Control and Escalation

  • Follow all GMP, hygiene, allergen-control, foreign-material, and cross-contamination prevention requirements.
  • Immediately stop the affected task and notify the Sanitation Lead or Sanitation Supervisor when a condition may create a food safety, allergen, chemical, or employee safety risk.
  • Immediately report failed cleaning results, visible contamination, pest activity, damaged equipment, leaking lines, chemical misuse, missing guards, or other abnormal conditions.
  • Do not release equipment or areas for production. Await verification and direction from authorized personnel.
  • Support environmental or equipment swabbing and corrective cleaning activities as directed.

Documentation and Compliance

  • Complete assigned MSS logs, sanitation checklists, chemical concentration records, equipment-cleaning records, and corrective action records accurately and on time.
  • Ensure records are complete, legible, truthful, and submitted to the Sanitation Lead for review.
  • Follow WHMIS and Safety Data Sheet (SDS) requirements for chemical handling, dilution, labeling, use, and storage.
  • Use only approved and correctly labeled chemicals; never mix chemicals unless specifically permitted by the manufacturer’s instructions and company procedure.
  • Monitor assigned sanitation supplies and notify the Sanitation Lead before stock is depleted.
  • Participate in required GMP, HACCP, allergen, chemical safety, equipment safety, and refresher training.

Teamwork and Workplace Conduct

  • Follow daily work assignments and priorities provided by the Sanitation Lead or Sanitation Supervisor.
  • Work cooperatively with sanitation, production, maintenance, warehouse, and FSQA employees to support safe and timely production start-up.
  • Communicate task status, delays, supply needs, and concerns clearly and promptly.
  • Support the training of new team members by demonstrating approved procedures when requested.
  • Maintain dependable attendance, punctuality, respectful conduct, and a positive team-focused attitude.
  • Participate in continuous improvement initiatives and make practical recommendations to improve safety, quality, efficiency, and cleaning effectiveness.

Workplace Safety

  • Maintain a safe working environment and comply with all occupational health and safety requirements.
  • Wear required personal protective equipment (PPE), including safety/steel-toed footwear, gloves, eye/face protection, aprons, hearing protection, and other PPE appropriate to the task.
  • Follow Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), chemical safety, ladder, lifting, machine-guarding, and equipment safety procedures.
  • Use hoses, foaming equipment, pressure-cleaning equipment, scrubbers, and other sanitation tools only when trained and authorized.
  • Immediately report hazards, near misses, injuries, spills, chemical exposure, damaged PPE, or unsafe conditions.
  • Maintain clear walkways and control wet-floor and slip hazards using required signs and barriers.

Physical and Work Environment Requirements

  • Ability to lift, carry, push, or pull up to 60 lbs.
  • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods and perform repetitive bending, reaching, twisting, kneeling, and scrubbing.
  • Ability to work safely in wet, noisy, cold, hot, humid, and refrigerated production environments.
  • Ability to wear required PPE for extended periods.
  • Availability to work assigned days, evenings, nights, weekends, holidays, and overtime based on operational requirements.
  • Willingness and ability to complete required training for powered walkies, reach equipment, or scissor lifts where the role requires it.

Success Measures (KPIs)

  • At least 99% completion of assigned MSS tasks by the required deadline.
  • At least 95% first-pass acceptance of assigned areas during sanitation or pre-operational inspection.
  • Accurate and complete sanitation documentation with minimal errors.
  • Zero unreported critical sanitation, food safety, chemical safety, or workplace safety concerns.
  • Timely completion of corrective cleaning and rework when deficiencies are identified.
  • Zero preventable lost-time incidents and consistent compliance with PPE and safety procedures.
  • Reliable attendance, punctuality, teamwork, and demonstrated alignment with company values.

Required Education and Experience

  • High school diploma or equivalent is preferred.
  • Previous sanitation, industrial cleaning, food manufacturing, commercial kitchen, or related experience is an asset.
  • Experience in a HACCP- or GMP-controlled food production environment is preferred.
  • Basic understanding of food safety, sanitation, WHMIS, and chemical handling is an asset; training will be provided.
  • Ability to read and follow written work instructions, chemical labels, SDS information, schedules, and safety procedures.
  • Ability to complete basic written records and communicate effectively in English.
  • Must be willing to complete all company-required food safety, health and safety, equipment, and sanitation training.

Technical Skills and Competencies

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to cleaning and sanitation excellence.
  • Ability to follow SSOPs, the MSS, GMPs, HACCP controls, and safety instructions consistently.
  • Basic understanding of chemical dilution, application, contact time, rinsing, and safe storage, or willingness to learn.
  • Ability to recognize visible sanitation deficiencies and promptly report food safety or equipment risks.
  • Reliable, organized, and able to complete physically demanding work within production deadlines.
  • Able to work independently after training while remaining responsive to direction and coaching.
  • Clear verbal communication and accurate basic recordkeeping skills.
  • Positive, respectful, team-oriented approach and willingness to support changing operational priorities.
  • Problem-solving mindset with a desire to make recommendations and help find practical solutions.
  • Alignment with the Wholesome Kids Catering Charter and core values.

title: Sports Computer Vision Engineer
description:
SumerSports is a leading football intelligence technology company that specializes in providing an innovative suite of products for football fans and NFL clubs. We are a collection of executives, engineers, data scientists, and visionaries from NFL clubs, technology startups, finance, and academia.

Our data-driven platform empowers teams with insights and tools to make informed decisions within salary cap constraints. The platform also serves the NCAA, offering insights around the transfer portal and more.

What sets us apart is our unique blend of big tech talent, data scientists, and former NFL personnel, who have a combined 600+ years of NFL experience. Our domain knowledge is augmented by AI and machine learning technologies to create a unique view into many aspects of Football.

We’re hiring a hands-on Computer Vision Engineer to build and improve sports video intelligence models—detection, tracking, pose, event understanding, and multi-view reasoning. You’ll spend most of your time on CV research + applied modeling (experiments, architectures, training, evaluation), and partner with data/platform teammates to ensure your work can ship reliably.

This role is CV-first. A bend toward scalable pipelines / MLOps is a plus, not a requirement. Level (mid vs senior) depends on scope ownership and how independently you can drive results.

Responsibilities

CV Modeling & Experimentation

  • Build and train CV models for sports video: player/ball detection, multi-object tracking, pose/keypoints, event/action recognition, identity association (re-ID).
  • Own the experimentation loop: hypotheses → ablations → error analysis → measurable improvements.
  • Design and maintain evaluation: task-appropriate metrics (e.g., MOT metrics, keypoint accuracy, event precision/recall), dataset slices, and failure taxonomy.
  • Improve data efficiency: augmentations, sampling strategies, handling label noise, weak/self-supervision where helpful.
  • Prototype and iterate on modern architectures (e.g., transformer-based detection/tracking, temporal models, multi-task setups).

Research that Ships

  • Collaborate on dataset + labeling design: formats, schemas, tooling, versioning.
  • Help productionize models: packaging, batch/stream inference patterns, throughput/latency tradeoffs, robustness checks.
  • Add lightweight quality gates: reproducibility, automated eval, regression detection

Qualifications

Must-have:

  • Strong applied CV experience with hands-on model development (not just running existing repos).
  • Solid PyTorch skills: training loops, debugging, data pipelines for vision workloads, DDP basics.
  • Comfort with video CV fundamentals: occlusion, identity switches, temporal consistency, calibration, domain shift.
  • Strong Python engineering and a bias toward measurable outcomes.

Nice-to-have (Bonus):

  • Sports video CV or adjacent domains (multi-agent tracking, pose, crowded scenes).
  • Experience with video tooling (FFmpeg), efficient dataset formats (WebDataset/shards), or streaming/batching to GPUs.
  • MLOps/production experience: model packaging, CI for training/eval, serving (Triton/TorchServe), monitoring.

Benefits

  • Competitive Salary and Bonus Plan
  • Comprehensive health insurance plan
  • Retirement savings plan (401k) with company match
  • Remote working environment
  • A flexible, unlimited time off policy
  • Generous paid holiday schedule - 13 in total including Monday after the Super Bowl

SumerSports is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices.

Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, certifications, and specific work location. This may be different in other locations due to differences in the cost of labor.

The total compensation package for this position may also include annual performance bonus, benefits and/or other applicable incentive compensation plans.

  • Ensure data models are aligned with enterprise architecture, data governance principles, and established modelling standards.

  • Perform data model reviews, gap analysis, model rationalisation, and impact assessments across existing and target-state platforms.
  • Promote consistency and reuse of enterprise data definitions across business units, geographies, and technology platforms.
  • Contribute to global transformation programmes and strategic initiatives, including Horizon and other enterprise data projects.
  • Support data lineage, metadata management, data quality, and governance activities by ensuring models provide clear and traceable definitions of critical data elements.
