Job Summary

Come work as a Quality Leader, Clinical Quality and Safety with Vancouver Coastal Health (VCH)!

Reporting to the Director, Quality, Safety and Improvement, the Quality Leader provides specialized skills in the support of achieving Vancouver Coastal Health’s (VCH’s) organizational and quality improvement strategic direction. The position provides expertise and support to clinical operations, corporate services and unit-based teams directed at improving the safety and quality of care and patient experience at VCH. The position ensures that initiatives are aligned with organizational goals, objectives and improvement priorities.

The Quality Leader promotes the development and enrichment of an organization-wide improvement culture, and works as part of the team to achieve outcomes, provide leadership to specific projects, support the identification of system improvement opportunities, support the development of knowledge, and the use of quality improvement methods and tools to improve work processes.

The Quality Leader functions at all levels of the organization, across all programs and sites, partners with point-of-care teams (physicians, nursing, and allied care) and interacts with senior leadership, clinical directors, patient and resident care management and corporate and support leaders.

This work is framed within VCH’s commitments to our pillars of Indigenous Cultural Safety, Anti-Racism, Equity, Diversity and Inclusion, and Planetary Health.

As a Quality Leader, Clinical Quality and Safety with Vancouver Coastal Health you will:

Quality Improvement

  • Provide expert advice and support in the preparation of organization-wide quality plans, promoting consistency with organizational strategic priorities as well as compatibility with relevant professional and accreditation standards in collaboration with leaders.

Project and Change Management

title: Staff Data Security Engineer
description:
You desire impactful work.

You’reRGA ready

RGA is a purpose-driven organization working to solve today’s challenges through innovation and collaboration. A Fortune 200 Company and listed among its World’s Most Admired Companies, we’re the only global reinsurance company to focus primarily on life- and health-related solutions. Join our multinational team of intelligent, motivated, and collaborative people, and help us make financial protection accessible to all.

The Staff Data Security Engineer will drive the design and implementation of enterprise data protection capabilities across Microsoft 365, endpoints, and cloud platforms.

This position will play a key role in protecting sensitive data across its full lifecycle, discovering, classifying, and securing data while reducing enterprise risk. You will work across multiple technologies and teams to ensure data security controls are scalable, actionable, and aligned to business and regulatory requirements. It also will work cross-functionally with IT, Legal, Compliance, and business stakeholders to ensure sensitive data is identified, classified, and protected across all endpoints, cloud workloads, and collaboration platforms.

Principle Duties

  • Design, deploy, and tune DLP policies across Microsoft Purview DLP, covering Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive, and endpoint devices

  • Configure and manage labeling policies, trainable classifiers, and exact data match (EDM) for sensitive data types

  • Integrate DLP capabilities with the Defender suite. Configure and manage Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and its Endpoint DLP component to monitor and control data on client devices. Leverage Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps (MDCAS) for cloud-based DLP and real-time monitoring of SaaS applications.

  • Configure data connectors and analytic rules in Sentinel for DLP alerts and email security events.

  • Monitor DLP incidents, conduct root-cause analysis, and drive policy refinement to reduce false positives while maintaining coverage

  • Extend DLP coverage beyond Microsoft 365 to third-party SaaS platforms, on-premises systems, and network egress points to reduce unauthorized data access and exfiltration

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to develop data handling standards and acceptable use policies and establish consistent policy frameworks, enforcement models, and automation for data protection

  • Create and maintain technical documentation, runbooks, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for the Data Security program.

  • Build automation and scalable processes to reduce manual effort Data Security Posture Management (DSPM)

  • Deploy and manage DSPM tooling to provide continuous visibility into sensitive data discovery, risk exposure, and access patterns

  • Leverage Varonis for data access governance, entitlement reviews, and detection of abnormal data access behaviors across file shares, SharePoint, and cloud storage

  • Conduct regular data risk assessments, identify overexposed sensitive data, and drive remediation with data owners

  • Integrate DSPM findings into broader risk reporting and security metrics dashboards

  • Produce regular reporting on policy effectiveness, data risk posture, and key security metrics for leadership

  • Partner with data owners across business units to ensure proper classification of structured and unstructured data assets

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in arts/sciences (BA/BS) or equivalent experience - Required

Required Work Experience

  • 6+ years of experience in information security, with at least 4 years focused on data security, DLP or DSPM.

Required Skills and Abilities

  • Hands-on expertise with Microsoft Purview DLP, including policy creation, scoped deployments, adaptive protection, and incident management

  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Defender XDR suite: Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Cloud Apps, Defender for Identity, and Defender for Office 365

  • Demonstrated experience with Microsoft Sentinel, including custom analytic rules, KQL query development, workbooks, and SOAR playbooks

  • Experience with Varonis Data Security Platform for data access governance, risk prioritization, and threat detection

  • Familiarity with DSPM concepts and tooling, including sensitive data discovery and cloud data risk management

  • Solid understanding of data classification frameworks and Microsoft Purview Information Protection (sensitivity labels, auto-labeling, trainable classifiers)

  • Experience implementing DLP across multiple vectors: email, endpoint, cloud applications, and network

  • Demonstrated capability to analyze, operationalize, and continuously improve security controls and business processes

  • Knowledge of relevant compliance frameworks and regulations: ISO 27001/27701, SOC 2 and NIST‑aligned compliance and security frameworks, particularly as they relate to data protection and DLP

  • Proven experience with email authentication standards (DMARC, SPF, DKIM) and their implementation in Microsoft 365.

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a security-first mindset

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Microsoft certifications: SC-400 (Information Protection Administrator), SC-200 (Security Operations Analyst), SC-100 (Cybersecurity Architect), or AZ-500

  • Experience with additional DLP or CASB platforms (e.g., Symantec DLP, Forcepoint, Zscaler)

  • Familiarity with cloud security posture management (CSPM) in Azure, AWS, or GCP environments

What you can expect from RGA:

  • Gain valuable knowledge from and experience with diverse, caring colleagues around the world.

  • Enjoy a respectful, welcoming environment that fosters individuality and encourages pioneering thought.

  • Join the bright and creative minds of RGA, and experience vast, endless career potential.

We’re excited to get to know you and connect your unique skills with our global opportunities. To create a modern and seamless experience, we use artificial intelligence (AI) in parts of our preliminary screening process. This technology helps us personalize job recommendations, automate interview scheduling, evaluate candidates based solely on experience—without considering name, gender, or other personal details—and provide real-time answers through our chatbot. AI is used only during early screening and never makes hiring decisions. Your RGA recruiter will work closely with you every step of the way to ensure the process feels personal, thoughtful, and focused on you.

Compensation Range:

$126,710.00 - $188,840.00 Annual

Base pay varies depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience and market location. In addition, RGA provides an annual bonus plan that includes all roles and some positions are eligible for participation in our long-term equity incentive plan. RGA also maintains a full range of health, retirement, and other employee benefits.

RGA is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, age, gender identity or expression, sex, disability, veteran status, religion, national origin, or any other characteristic protected by applicable equal employment opportunity laws.

Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering or a related discipline.

AWS certification (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer). Certification in Kubernetes (CKA/CKAD) or Terraform

Position Summary:
Do you want to lead the projects that power AutoNation’s digital transformation? Join AutoNation’s Technology Project Management team as a Project Manager/Scrum Master and help our teams deliver complete solutions that reshape how America buys, sells, and services vehicles. You’ll enable delivery teams, drive features forward, and champion the Agile practices that keep our technology organization moving fast.
As a Project Manager/Scrum Master, you will facilitate Agile ceremonies, coach teams on Agile frameworks and best practices, and apply traditional project management approaches when a project calls for them. You’ll develop project plans, manage risk, scope, and budgets that bring solutions to life, all while clearing the impediments standing between your teams and successful delivery. Your work will drive measurable business impact you can witness first-hand.
Organizational Relationships:
This position reports to the Director, Project Management and provides leadership and support for one or more projects and teams. You will partner and interface with technical leaders, business analysts, product owners, stakeholders, vendors, and extended project team members across AutoNation’s Technology and business organizations.
Job Responsibilities:
• Establish and maintain project governance—cadence, decision forums, and change control—and keep living artifacts current, including the project charter, RACI, RAID/risk log, and decision log.
• Develop project plans that manage resources, schedules, and budgets to meet deliverables and reporting requirements.
• Track and report key project metrics and budget variances, and lead status meetings, translating delivery status into business impact, risks, and the decisions leadership needs to make.
• Manage change requests impacting scope, schedule, and budget through established change control, and communicate impacts to stakeholders.
• Actively manage the execution of the project, including assigning work to project staff, managing project scope and finances, and ensuring the quality of deliverables.
• Ensure planning of go-live and deployment activities and facilitate their execution.
• Keep resource allocations and utilization current and approve team timesheets in the project management tool (Planview PPM Pro).
• Proactively identify, assess, and prioritize project risks; develop mitigation and contingency plans; and maintain a risk/RAID log to track resolution.
• Partner with stakeholders, business analysts, and product owners to understand product and organizational impact, and manage vendor implementations.
• Define and execute the communication plan for team-level activities, managing expectations and providing status updates to customers and management.
• Facilitate and support team ceremonies for one or more development teams, teaching and enforcing the values and principles of Agile while promoting self-organization and the continuous improvement of work standards.
• Assist with resource allocation and effective capacity planning to determine what the team can commit to in any given iteration, and monitor velocity to continuously improve efficiency.
• Learn and actively use project management and ticket-tracking software (such as Planview PPM Pro and Azure DevOps/Jira) to manage the team’s backlog and sprint-committed items.
Qualifications:
• 8+ years of relevant project management experience and a BS degree in Computer Science or a related field, or an MS degree and 6+ years of relevant experience.
• Experience with project management and collaboration tools such as Planview PPM Pro, Azure DevOps/Jira, MS Teams/Office, and SharePoint, and diagramming tools such as Lucidchart, Figma, or Miro (Planview PPM Pro preferred, not required).
• Proven ability to manage scope, schedule, budget, and resources across multiple concurrent projects in a fast-paced, rapidly evolving environment.
• Demonstrated experience with proactive risk management and project governance, including maintaining artifacts such as RAID logs and applying change control.
• Excellent people and communication skills, with experience collaborating across all levels of the organization, including executive leadership and senior management.
• Results-oriented team player who maintains a positive, can-do attitude and drives collaboration.
• Demonstrated experience managing technology projects using Agile/Scrum methodologies (Scrum and/or Kanban), with the ability to apply traditional/waterfall project management when a project requires it.
• Strong understanding of Agile and waterfall frameworks as well as project management methodologies, tools, and techniques.
• Scrum (CSM/PSM) and Project Management Professional (PMP) certifications strongly preferred; SAFe and Six Sigma (Green or Black Belt) certifications a plus.
• Must meet company’s requirements for employment.
Physical Requirements
• Ability to travel less than 5% between AutoNation work locations as required by work assignments and delivery schedules
• Work with computers and other common office equipment
• Work locations are in a corporate office environment with no special physical requirements beyond what is normally expected in a typical modern corporate office

We value innovation, teamwork, and a commitment to making a positive impact in the world.

title: Clinical Coordinator
description:
The Clinical Coordinator reports directly to the Program Director and works in close collaboration with the Clinical Education Director to support the administrative operations of the Clinical phase of the Physician Assistant program. This position is responsible for the development, maintenance, organization, and management of the program’s clinical rotation sites and provides essential administrative support to ensure efficient coordination of supervised clinical practice experiences and compliance with program and accreditation requirements.

Essential Functions (Principal Duties and Job Responsibilities):

  • Coordinate Clinical Placements and Student Compliance Requirements
    • Coordinate the placement and scheduling of students for supervised clinical practice experiences (SCPEs), including verification and tracking of immunizations, background checks, drug screenings, clinical course registrations, and other site-specific onboarding requirements to ensure students meet all clinical placement and regulatory requirements.
  • Manage Clinical Sites and Preceptor Relationships
    • Develop, maintain, and organize clinical rotation sites locally, statewide, and nationally. Serve as the primary point of contact for office managers, preceptors, and clinical sire personnel, and coordinate ongoing communication to support the establishment, maintenance, and effectiveness of clinical education partnerships
  • Administer Preceptor Credentialing and Evaluation Processes
    • Coordinate the annual verification and maintenance of preceptor documentation, including licensure, board certifications, and curriculum vitae, and other required records. Monitor, collect, and maintain preceptor evaluations of student performance and ensure all documentation complies with institutional, regulatory, and accreditation requirements
  • Manage Clinical Education Data and Accreditation Compliance Activities
    • Support the Clinical Education Director in the collection, maintenance, and management of clinical education data and records. Assist with continuous review processes and ensure compliance with federal, state, institutional, and accreditation standards, including documentation required for program assessment and self-study activities
  • Coordinate Clinical Assessments and Student Support Services
    • Administer end-of-rotation (EOR) examinations and provide students with clinical site information, including location details, contact information, and housing resources when applicable. Coordinate and communicate site-provided housing arrangements and other logistical information necessary to support student success during clinical rotations
  • Conduct Clinical Site Monitoring and Quality Assurance Activities
    • Participate in clinical site visits and evaluate the quality and effectiveness of supervised clinical practice experiences as part of the program’s ongoing assessment and continuous quality improvement processes
  • Coordinate Financial and Administrative Support Activities
    • Coordinate preceptor and clinical site payments, serve on program committees and ad hoc workgroups, and participate in institutional activities, including commencement and convocation. Perform other related duties as assigned to support the operational needs of the Physician Assistant Program

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required:

  • Demonstrated knowledge of physician assistant and/or health professions clinical education processes, including supervised clinical practice experiences (SCPEs), clinical placement requirements, and accreditation standards
  • Demonstrated proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and database management systems, including Word, Excel, Outlook, and electronic record management systems
  • Excellent verbal, written, interpersonal, and professional communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with students, faculty, preceptors, healthcare administrators, and external partners
  • Strong organizational skills with demonstrated ability to prioritize competing responsibilities, manage multiple deadlines, and maintain attention to detail in a fast-paced environment
  • Demonstrated ability to maintain confidential and sensitive information in accordance with institutional policies and applicable privacy regulations
  • Strong project management, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills
  • Ability to independently manage complex administrative processes and exercise sound judgment and discretion
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and maintain effective working relationships with diverse stakeholders
  • Ability to travel locally and regionally to clinical sites as needed
  • Demonstrated proficiency in data management, recordkeeping, and quality assurance activities
  • Ability to work collaboratively as part of an interdisciplinary team while maintaining a high level of professionalism and customer service

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities Preferred:

  • Knowledge of ARC-PA accreditation standards, PAEA clinical education requirements, and best practices in health professions education
  • Experience using clinical education management systems, student information systems, and electronic scheduling platforms
  • Experience with affiliation agreements, preceptor credentialing, and clinical compliance processes
  • Knowledge of higher education policies, student support services, and academic program administration
  • Experience with data analysis, reporting, and continuous quality improvement initiatives
  • Experience managing multiple clinical partnerships and complex scheduling logistics
  • Experience coordinating large-scale projects and event administration

Education and Experience Required:

  • High school diploma
  • One to two years of experience in physician assistant education, medical education, clinical education, or health professions education administration

Education and Experience Preferred:

  • Bachelor’s degree in healthcare administration, Education, Business Administration, Management, Public Health, or a related field
  • Three to five years of experience in physician assistant education, medical education, clinical education, or health professions education administration
  • Experience coordinating clinical placements, preceptor relationships, and student compliance requirements

title: RevOps Analytics & BI Analyst
description:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

This role is about improving the quality, speed, and confidence of the decisions we make across the revenue organization. The longer we operate without enhanced analytical support, the more technical debt compounds — and the greater the risk that we act on inaccurate data or miss opportunities to improve pipeline, conversion, retention, and revenue execution.

You will create the trusted reporting foundation that allows decisions to move faster, makes core revenue metrics consistent, and gives teams self-serve visibility into what is working and where we need to intervene. We are looking for a business-facing analytics and BI lead who can translate GTM questions into clear metrics, dashboards, and recommendations.

What they'll own

  • Build and maintain the curated Cortex data layer — dbt models and transformations from raw sources to trusted tables.

  • Design a scalable transformation architecture that supports future datasets and use cases.

  • Define and standardize core business calculations (ARR, pipeline, conversion rates, forecasting, etc.).

  • Create and maintain the semantic layer that becomes the company's single source of truth.

  • Build and own the official dashboards, metrics and reporting layer on top of that foundation.

Must-haves

  • Strong SQL and hands-on data modeling; experience with dbt (or an equivalent transformation framework).

  • Proven dashboard / BI craft — designs clear, decision-driving views, not just charts.

  • Strong data-visualization sensibility (including graph / relationship visualization) and metric definition.

  • Owns the full path: raw data → model → metric → dashboard.

  • Business-oriented — translates GTM / RevOps questions into data, rather than just working tickets.

Nice-to-haves

  • BigQuery and the modern data stack; Python for heavier transformations.

  • Experience in a GTM / RevOps / commercial-analytics context.

  • Comfortable partnering directly with stakeholders and presenting insights.

What success looks like (first 6 months)

  • A governed, documented curated layer everyone queries — instead of rebuilding business logic over and over.

  • Standardized, agreed definitions for our core revenue metrics.

  • A first set of official, self-serve dashboards live on the single source of truth.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves quickly. We are a high velocity, high ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly as we experiment and iterate

  • Work that often requires operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires comfort navigating ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

At the same time, many people find this work deeply rewarding. If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute. Learn more: Interviewing at TRM: How We Hire and What Success Looks Like

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

Privacy Policy and Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com.

To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form.

Recruitment agencies

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.

We point you at the goal; you decide the path: channels, campaigns, experiments, whatever moves the number. The surface is broad: paid acquisition on one side; SEO, CRM and lifecycle - onboarding, activation, retention, win-back. You do the hands-on work yourself, without agencies, and you instrument everything as you go: event tracking, dashboards, attribution. You work directly with the founders, product, design, and medical team. No layers slowing you down.

Growing a consumer health brand carries dimensions you won't find in a typical growth role. Every claim in every communication has to hold to a clinical-grade bar. You market a product built on sensitive health data, which means trust isn't a brand value, it's a conversion factor: privacy, transparency, and rigor shape how you acquire.

Responsibilities

  • End-to-end funnel ownership: Drive the full growth lifecycle, including acquisition, conversion, CRM, and retention. Responsible for the path forward, the channels, the experiments, and the final results
  • Performance & lifecycle: Scale high-impact acquisition assets and build robust lifecycle strategies (onboarding, activation, retention, win-back) to maximise member lifetime value
  • Experimentation & optimisation: Systematically identify and fix funnel leaks, eliminating ineffective approaches and scaling successful ones
  • Technical execution: Build and maintain an analytics stack. Utilise event tracking, SQL, and automation tools to ensure data accuracy and clear attribution without reliance on external support
  • Strategy & AI integration: Leverage AI tools to accelerate research, copy, operations, and analysis while maintaining high standards for rigor and clinical accuracy

Need to have

  • 5+ years in growth or growth marketing, with at least 2 years at a DTC, subscription, or consumer-product brand where you owned a number
  • A true full-funnel operator - comfortable moving between paid, SEO, CRM/lifecycle, and conversion in a single week, and doing the hands-on work yourself
  • You’ve (AI) coded things before: event tracking, automations
  • Data-driven by default: fluent in analytics and attribution, can build your own dashboards, and lets the numbers settle the argument
  • Demonstrably fast: ships experiments in days, not weeks, and iterates on what the data says
  • Uses AI tools to move faster and do more - research, copy, analysis - without losing judgment.
  • Fluent in English; comfortable working across our DACH-first markets

Great to have

  • German fluency (a strong plus for our Swiss and DACH markets); French a bonus
  • SEO depth - technical SEO, content strategy, or programmatic
  • Experience at an early-stage or growth team, building from scratch
  • Experience with health, wellness, or consumer biotech brands

Frequently asked questions

A track record of user-first thinking. Fast execution, with even faster iteration. A passion for healthcare. And someone who doesn't take themselves too seriously.

First, a quick video call to see if there’s a match. Then, two video or in-person interviews with the founders. After that, usually a mini-project to collaborate on together — followed by reference checks and an offer.

It depends on the role; see the specification for more details. In general, we’re building 2 main in-person hubs: Zurich and Munich — with flexibility to work from home regularly.

  • Apoiar os projetos na definição e adequação dos acessos necessários;
  • Interagir com equipes técnicas, projetos, áreas de negócio e demais stakeholders;
  • Registrar as atividades e alterações realizadas;
  • Seguir os processos de aprovação, segurança e governança definidos pela empresa.

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência profissional com Gestão de Acessos SAP;
  • Experiência com gestão de usuários e perfis SAP;
  • Experiência prática com SAP GRC Access Control (GRC AC);
  • Experiência com SAP IDM (Identity Management);
  • Conhecimento de roles, perfis e autorizações SAP;
  • Vivência com processos de criação, alteração, manutenção e revogação de acessos;
  • Experiência com provisionamento de usuários e acessos;
  • Experiência em ambientes DEV, QAS e PRD;
  • Capacidade de levantar e entender necessidades de acesso junto às equipes de projetos;
  • Conhecimento de processos de aprovação e validação de acessos;
  • Perfil analítico, organizado e atento aos detalhes;
  • Boa comunicação e facilidade para interação com diferentes áreas.

Conhecimentos técnicos desejáveis

  • SAP GRC Access Control (GRC AC);
  • SAP IDM – Identity Management;
  • Access Request Management (ARM);
  • Access Risk Analysis (ARA);
  • Business Role Management (BRM);

  • Conhecimentos em Segregação de Funções (SoD);
  • Conhecimento de Matriz de Acessos;
  • Vivência com processos de auditoria e governança de acessos.

Perfil que buscamos

Profissional Pleno, com experiência prática e hands-on em Gestão de Acessos SAP, especialmente em ambientes que utilizem GRC AC e IDM.

É importante ter autonomia para entender uma demanda de projeto, identificar as necessidades de usuários e perfis, estruturar os requisitos, interagir com as equipes envolvidas e encaminhar a demanda para validação e aprovação.

Após a aprovação, deverá possuir experiência para executar as alterações e configurações necessárias nos ambientes correspondentes, seguindo os processos e procedimentos estabelecidos.

Buscamos um profissional analítico, organizado, comunicativo e orientado à resolução de problemas, com capacidade de atuar em conjunto com equipes técnicas e de negócio.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em projetos de implementação ou evolução de SAP GRC AC e/ou SAP IDM;

  • Vivência com processos de Access Risk Analysis, Access Request Management e Business Role Management;

  • Vivência em ambientes com processos formais de aprovação, governança e auditoria de acessos;

Come work as a Lead, Integrated Child and Youth Program, MHSU with Vancouver Coastal Health (VCH)!

Vancouver Coastal Health is looking for a Lead, Integrated Child and Youth Program, MHSU to join the Mental Health and Substance Use (MHSU) team in Richmond, BC. Apply today to join our team!

Under the Pathway to Hope, the Province has established Integrated Child and Youth (ICY) teams in several communities defined by school district boundaries. Each ICY team supports a cluster of Public, Independent and First Nations operated schools and will include all children and youth within the geographic region, including those who do not attend a school. These community-based multidisciplinary teams coordinate and deliver wraparound mental health and substance use services and supports for children and youth 0-19 and their families. Integrated Child and Youth teams are comprised of team members employed by various organizations and ministries.

As a Lead, Integrated Child and Youth Program, MHSU with Vancouver Coastal Health you will:

  • Champion the integration of service across the team and community, play a critical role in ensuring fidelity to the ICY model of care, and leads team integration and cohesion to enable effective provision of mental health and substance use supports to children, youth and families in the applicable service area.
  • Ensure that the service delivery will be flexible and outbound, reflecting the preferences of children, youth, and families. Through the collective impact of partners working together in an integrated way, children and youth with mild, moderate, and severe mental health and/or substance use challenges and their families/caregivers will have timely, equitable access to a seamless system of culturally safe and effective interventions that are based on the unique strengths, needs and risks of children, youth and families.

title: Senior Specialist QA
description:
Introduction to role:
Are you ready to safeguard the quality of life-changing medicines and keep patient supply flowing without compromise? Do you thrive at the intersection of compliance, investigation, and continuous improvement, turning complexity into clear, timely decisions that matter?

In this role, you will anchor quality assurance across our Irish manufacturing sites, ensuring clinical and commercial products meet cGMP, corporate, and regulatory requirements. You will be the quality point person for cross-functional teams, partnering with Manufacturing, QC, Engineering, Planning and QPs to deliver right-first-time outcomes and reliable batch release. Your work will protect product safety, quality and efficacy—and by extension, support patients who rely on our medicines and the continuity of our global markets.

Accountabilities:
- Quality Leadership for Irish Sites: Provide technical expertise on QA and compliance to safeguard product quality and secure uninterrupted supply.
- GMP Documentation and Batch Review: Maintain and execute schedules for the timely review and approval of SOPs, master batch records, validation materials, and policies aligned to clinical and commercial needs.
- Deviation and CAPA Excellence: Lead and support investigations, apply root cause analysis, and implement risk-proportionate CAPAs that prevent recurrence and strengthen systems.
- Technology Transfer and New Product Introduction: Support transfers and NPIs to ensure compliant, validated, and inspection-ready implementation.
- Validation Oversight: Deliver QA review and approval of validation protocols and reports; provide independent quality oversight of validation activities.
- QP Release Support: Collaborate to maintain the product release schedule and ensure all quality prerequisites for certification are met.
- Regulatory Interface: Coordinate referrals of regulatory documentation (dossiers, site impact assessments, annual reports, QP declarations) and market-specific materials for site accreditations and product reviews.
- Audit Readiness and Inspections: Proactively sustain audit readiness and actively support internal audits and regulatory agency inspections.
- Digital Quality Metrics: Analyse data and develop reports on quality metrics and KPIs using digital tools; translate insights into targeted improvement actions.
- GxP Advice and Training: Provide site-wide GxP guidance; plan and support quality training for internal and external stakeholders.
- Coaching and Team Development: Guide early-career team members on quality processes, digital tools, and compliance requirements.
- Cross-Functional Partnering: Act as the quality point person, enabling fast, informed decisions with Manufacturing, QC, Engineering, Site Services and Planning to optimize patient supply.
- Continuous Improvement and Risk: Benchmark internal and external QA practices to identify and embed more efficient and effective approaches; drive risk assessments and process improvements.
- Management Delegation: Act as delegate for QA management as required to ensure continuity of leadership and decision-making.

Essential Skills/Experience:
- A minimum of 7 years relevant experience within the pharma industry or a related field.
- Third level qualification (e.g., B.Sc. in science/pharmacy) with a minimum of 7 years’ experience in a cGMP Quality environment; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
- Strong knowledge of cGMP requirements for pharmaceutical manufacturing and/or packaging.
- Direct experience of GMP management within a pharma/biopharma company, including exposure to FDA, HPRA/EMA or authorities of similar standing.
- Direct experience of New Product Introduction.
- Experience with quality processes across multiple areas.
- Experience interpreting and guiding team members around principles and concepts of compliance management within a regulated environment.
- Experience troubleshooting issues across quality areas.
- Experience implementing newer digital tools and technologies related to QA reporting, documentation, and analysis.
- Good knowledge of relevant computer packages (e.g., TrackWise or similar).
- Planning and organizing skills to plan, execute and track Quality Assurance commitments and adjust to changing priorities.
- High level technical skills including analytical, auditing, pharmaceutical manufacturing, and regulatory inspection management; technical writing skills.
- Excellent accuracy and attention to detail.
- Excellent interpersonal skills with strong verbal and written communication, and the ability to represent company interests, objectives and policies in a responsible and professional manner.
- Demonstrated mature leadership and interpersonal influencing skills.
- Advanced problem-solving skills with proven ability to independently analyze complex issues, identify root causes, develop effective solutions, and lead or participate in high‑risk investigations using critical thinking and sound judgment.

Desirable Skills/Experience:
- Experience of sterility assurance for drug products and in pharmaceutical manufacturing processes.
- Experience conducting data analysis and generating insights on quality metrics and KPIs using digital tools and processes.
- Experience coordinating regulatory documentation such as dossiers, site impact assessments, annual reports, or QP declarations.
- Experience benchmarking internal and external quality assurance practices to identify and apply innovative, efficient approaches.

Why AstraZeneca:
Join a team dedicated to transforming the lives of people with rare and devastating diseases, where your expertise directly shapes the safety and availability of our medicines. We combine the agility and ownership of a biotech environment with the scale and investment of a global science-led organization. You will work alongside curious, generous colleagues—scientists, engineers, QPs and operators—in the same room solving the same problem, turning patient needs into decisive quality actions. Expect tailored development, modern digital tools, and leaders who value kindness alongside ambition, so you can stretch your capabilities while staying grounded in what matters most: delivering for patients.

Call to Action:
If you’re ready to turn your QA mastery into measurable impact for patients and accelerate your own growth, take the next step and share your CV today!

title: Data Analyst — Regulatory Reporting
description:
We are seeking an experienced Data Analyst — RegulatoryReporting to support a regulatory reporting transformation within an APAC banking environment. The role will take ownership of the data requirements, mapping, validation, and data quality activities required for regulatory reporting, consolidating the data work that sits alongside the regulatory reporting platform implementation being delivered by IT.

The successful candidate will have strong hands-on experience working with regulatory reporting data, particularly MAS 610,and will be comfortable working across Finance, Regulatory Reporting, Data, and Technology teams. Experience supporting implementations or enhancements involving platforms such as Regnology, Agile Reporter, or Axiom ishighly desirable.

Key Responsibilities

  • Gather, analyse, and document data requirements for regulatory reporting, with a particular focus on MAS 610 and related regulatory submissions.
  • Define and maintain source-to-target data mappings between upstream banking systems, finance data sources, regulatory reporting data models, and reporting templates.
  • Work alongside the IT-led regulatory reporting platform implementation to ensure data requirements are complete, accurate, traceable, and aligned with reporting logic.
  • Analyse regulatory reporting data dictionaries, data models, taxonomy, and reporting attributes and translate regulatory requirements into detailed data specifications.
  • Perform hands-on data validation and reconciliation to confirm the completeness and accuracy of data flowing into the regulatory reporting solution.
  • Define data quality rules, validation controls, exception criteria, and testing scenarios for regulatory reporting data.
  • Execute data quality testing, investigate exceptions, identify root causes, and coordinate remediation with relevant business and technology teams.
  • Support the mapping and documentation of Finance and Regulatory Reporting processes, including manual adjustments, journals, reconciliations, and reporting controls.
  • Perform reconciliations of regulatory reporting outputs and underlying data back to the General Ledger and other Finance systems.
  • Identify gaps between current-state data and target regulatory reporting requirements and recommend appropriate remediation or transformation rules.
  • Support system integration testing, user acceptance testing, parallel runs, and implementation activities related to regulatory reporting data.
  • Work closely with Regulatory Reporting, Finance, Data, Risk, and Technology stakeholders to resolve data issues and ensure reporting requirements are understood consistently.
  • Produce clear documentation covering data lineage, mapping logic, validation rules, reconciliations, data quality controls, and issue resolution.
  • Where appropriate, develop dashboards or visualisations to communicate data quality, reconciliation results, exceptions, and reporting trends.

Required Experience

  • 5+ years of experience working with regulatory reporting data within banking or financial services, preferably in an APAC regulatory environment.
  • Demonstrable hands-on experience with MAS 610 regulatory reporting, including data mapping, validation, reconciliation, and reporting requirements.
  • Strong experience translating regulatory reporting requirements into detailed data requirements and source-to-target mappings.
  • Experience working alongside or supporting a regulatory reporting platform such as:
  • Regnology
  • Agile Reporter
  • Axiom / AxiomSL
  • Strong understanding of regulatory reporting data dictionaries, data lineage, reporting attributes, and data models.
  • Hands-on experience defining and testing data quality rules and controls.
  • Strong SQL skills, with the ability to query, analyse, reconcile, and validate large and complex datasets.
  • Experience with Finance processes relevant to regulatory reporting, including:
  • General Ledger reconciliation
  • Manual adjustments and journals
  • Data aggregation and transformation
  • Reporting controls and exception management
  • Experience supporting regulatory reporting testing activities, including SIT, UAT, parallel runs, and data validation.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with Power BI or similar data visualisation tools for building data quality, reconciliation, or management reporting dashboards.
  • Broader knowledge of Singapore and APAC banking regulatory reporting requirements.
  • Experience working on regulatory reporting transformation or platform implementation programmes.

We're a fast-growing, Series A/B-backed EdTech company building an AI-powered mobile learning platform used by tens of millions of students across the globe. Our suite of tools — including an AI tutor, smart flashcards, homework assistance, and peer-generated study notes — helps students study smarter and perform better academically.

We're looking for a motivated Engineering Intern to join our team and contribute to the product and infrastructure powering one of the most widely used student learning platforms in the world. This is a hands-on role where you'll work alongside experienced engineers and ship real code from day one.

What You'll Do

  • Collaborate with full-time engineers on building and improving features across the platform

  • Write clean, maintainable code and participate in code reviews

  • Help troubleshoot and resolve technical issues in production and development environments

  • Contribute to mobile and/or backend development efforts depending on team placement

  • Work closely with product and design teams to deliver user-facing improvements

  • Participate in agile ceremonies including standups, sprint planning, and retrospectives

What We're Looking For

  • Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field

  • Solid fundamentals in at least one programming language (e.g. JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Swift, Kotlin, or similar)

  • Eagerness to learn, take ownership, and deliver in a fast-paced startup environment

  • Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset

  • Genuine interest in education technology and building products that matter to students

Nice to have:

  • Prior experience with mobile development (iOS or Android) or web frameworks

  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure or backend services

  • Previous internship or project experience in a software engineering context

Work authorisation: Applicants must be authorised to work in Germany or the United Kingdom. No visa sponsorship is available.

Location

This role is on-site in either Berlin, Germany or London, United Kingdom. You must be willing and able to commute to one of these offices regularly.

Compensation & Benefits

Compensation details were not specified for this role. You'll be working within a collaborative, mission-driven team at a well-funded EdTech scaleup with significant global reach, gaining exposure to real-world engineering challenges and a modern, agile development culture.

Come work as a Contracts Coordinator, Facilities, Real Estate & Regional Strategic Development Initiatives with Vancouver Coastal Health (VCH)!

Reporting to the Manager of Contracts and Optimization, Facilities, Real Estate and Regional Strategic Development Initiatives, at Vancouver Coastal Health (VCH), the Contracts Coordinator is responsible for overseeing and optimizing contract management, procurement processes and specific projects across the organization. The Contract Coordinator works closely with VCH operations supervisors, managers, directors, financial planning and operations, and various VCH team members, contractors/consultants and external agencies/vendors promoting consistency in management practices in obtaining the best value and excellence in our contracted services and projects. The Contracts Coordinator works with the Manager of Contracts and Optimization and independently to communicate with internal and external stakeholders/customers in a manner that promotes positive and respectful relationships, as well as Facilities contract management.

The Warehouse Packaging / Operator is responsible for supporting safe and efficient production, packaging, material handling, and warehouse operations. This position operates production and packaging equipment, prepares finished products for shipment, moves materials throughout the facility, and performs routine quality and safety checks.

The successful candidate will be dependable, safety-focused, able to work in a fast-paced manufacturing environment, and committed to meeting production and quality standards.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Safely operate packaging, production, and material-handling equipment according to established procedures.

  • Set up, start, monitor, and shut down assigned packaging or production equipment.

  • Monitor equipment during operation and make basic adjustments when necessary.

  • Identify equipment issues, jams, or abnormal operating conditions and promptly notify the appropriate supervisor or maintenance personnel.

  • Package, seal, label, palletize, and prepare finished products according to production specifications.

  • Inspect products and packaging for quality, accuracy, damage, contamination, or other defects.

  • Verify product codes, labels, lot numbers, dates, quantities, and packaging materials as required.

  • Supply production and packaging areas with materials necessary to maintain continuous operations.

  • Move raw materials, packaging supplies, finished goods, pallets, and other materials throughout the facility.

  • Load, unload, stage, organize, and store materials in designated warehouse locations.

  • Complete required production, inventory, quality, and warehouse documentation accurately.

  • Maintain organized work areas and follow established housekeeping and sanitation requirements.

  • Assist with equipment cleaning and basic sanitation activities as assigned.

  • Follow all company safety procedures, including proper use of personal protective equipment (PPE).

  • Follow Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs), food safety requirements, quality standards, and company policies.

  • Communicate production, equipment, quality, and safety concerns to leadership promptly.

  • Participate in shift changeovers, product changeovers, and line preparation activities.

  • Assist other production and warehouse employees as operational needs require.

  • Meet established productivity, attendance, quality, and performance expectations.

  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

Equipment Operation

Depending on assignment and training, employees may operate or work around:

  • Packaging and production machinery

  • Conveyors

  • Pallet wrappers

  • Labeling and coding equipment

  • Pallet jacks

  • Scales and weighing equipment

  • Forklifts or other powered industrial equipment, if properly trained and authorized

Qualifications

Required

  • High school diploma or GED preferred.

  • Previous manufacturing, warehouse, packaging, machine operation, or production experience preferred.

  • Ability to understand and follow verbal and written work instructions.

  • Ability to perform basic mathematical calculations.

  • Ability to work effectively as part of a production team.

  • Ability to maintain reliable and predictable attendance.

  • Ability to work safely in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

  • Willingness to learn equipment operation, quality standards, and production processes.

Preferred

  • Previous food manufacturing or packaging experience.

  • Previous machine operator experience.

  • Warehouse or inventory experience.

  • Forklift or powered industrial truck experience.

  • Familiarity with GMP, food safety, sanitation, or quality-control requirements.

Physical Requirements

The employee must be able to perform the essential functions of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation, including:

  • Frequently stand and walk for extended periods throughout the shift.

  • Frequently bend, reach, push, pull, grasp, and perform repetitive hand and arm movements.

  • Regularly lift and carry up to 80** pounds**.

  • Work around moving machinery and production equipment.

  • Safely perform repetitive packaging and material-handling activities.

  • Wear required PPE and comply with facility safety requirements.

Work Environment

This position works primarily in a manufacturing and warehouse environment. Employees may be exposed to varying temperatures, noise, moving equipment, wet or slippery surfaces, food ingredients, and other conditions commonly associated with manufacturing operations.

Employees are expected to comply with all safety, sanitation, food safety, quality, and operational requirements applicable to their assigned work area.

Performance Expectations

Success in this position includes:

  • Safe operation of assigned equipment

  • Consistent achievement of production expectations

  • Accurate packaging and labeling

  • Compliance with quality and food safety requirements

  • Proper material handling and inventory practices

  • Reliable attendance and punctuality

  • Effective communication with coworkers and supervisors

  • Prompt reporting of equipment, safety, or quality concerns

  • Maintaining a clean and organized work area

title: Pædagog Gylling børnehus
description:
Pædagog til vuggestuen i Gylling Børnehus – vil du være med til at skabe trygge børnefællesskaber? Drømmer du om en hverdag tæt på børnene, forældrene og kollegerne – i et lille børnehus med stor sammenhængskraft?

I Gylling Børnehus søger vi en uddannet pædagog til vores vuggestuegruppe. Her får du mulighed for at blive en vigtig del af et overskueligt og varmt børnehus, hvor relationer, leg, tryghed og fællesskaber er omdrejningspunktet for vores pædagogiske praksis.

Stillingen er på 30-37 timer om ugen med ansættelse pr. 1. oktober eller snarest derefter.

Velkommen til et børnehus med sjæl, nærvær og stærke fællesskaber Gylling Børnehus er en integreret 0-6 års institution med ca. 50 børn fordelt på to børnehavegrupper og én vuggestuegruppe. Vi holder til i et ældre hus med masser af sjæl og charme, og vi har en skøn legeplads, der giver gode muligheder for leg, bevægelse og fordybelse.

Vi ligger som nabo til skolen og bruger blandt andet deres gymnastiksal, bibliotek og sportsplads. Samtidig er vi en aktiv del af et landsbysamfund, hvor forældresamarbejdet og kontakten til lokalmiljøet betyder meget.

Det pædagogiske fundament Vi er en del af Dagtilbud Midt & Syd, som består af fem børnehuse, ressourcegrupper, pædagogiske vejledere og en dagtilbudsleder. I Gylling Børnehus har vi desuden vores egen pædagogiske leder tæt på hverdagen.

Vores kerneopgave er at skabe lege- og læringsfællesskaber, hvor alle børn kan deltage, trives og udvikle sig. Vi arbejder ressourceorienteret og er optagede af, at alle børn oplever sig som værdifulde og betydningsfulde deltagere i fællesskabet.

Vi møder børn som unikke individer og støtter dem i at indgå i trygge, forpligtende og udviklende fællesskaber. Derfor er positive børnefællesskaber, nærværende voksne og stærke relationer centrale i vores arbejde. Vi er uddannet i ICDP og Tryghedscirklen, som er en vigtig del af vores fælles faglige tilgang.

En hverdag med genkendelighed, nærvær og plads til initiativ I vuggestuen arbejder vi med faste rutiner, små børnegrupper og pædagogiske aktiviteter, der tager afsæt i børnenes behov, perspektiver og interesser. Vi skaber en genkendelig hverdag, hvor børnene kan føle sig trygge, blive nysgerrige og få mod på at deltage.

Vi bruger vores rammer aktivt, både inde og ude, og vi er glade for ture, legepladsen og de muligheder, der findes i nærmiljøet. Som pædagog hos os får du indflydelse på planlægning, udvikling og kvalificering af den pædagogiske praksis.

Du bliver en del af en erfaren personalegruppe, hvor vi hjælper hinanden, samarbejder på tværs og tager fælles ansvar for at skabe de bedste betingelser for børnene.

Vi leder efter dig, der brænder for vuggestuepædagogik Vi søger en pædagog, som har lyst til at være tæt på de yngste børns udvikling, leg, relationer og første erfaringer med fællesskaber. Du må gerne være fagligt nysgerrig, initiativrig og optaget af at skabe en hverdag med både ro, glæde, omsorg og udvikling.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • er uddannet pædagog og fagligt velfunderet i arbejdet med børns leg, trivsel og udvikling
  • kan skabe trygge, stimulerende og fleksible lege- og læringsmiljøer med afsæt i børneperspektivet
  • arbejder ressourceorienteret og ser både barnets og fællesskabets styrker og potentialer
  • møder børn, forældre og kolleger anerkendende, empatisk og professionelt
  • er nærværende, tydelig og omsorgsfuld i relationen til både børn og voksne
  • kan bidrage til en forudsigelig hverdag med tryghed, glæde og deltagelsesmuligheder for alle børn
  • er omstillingsparat, initiativrig og fleksibel i en hverdag, hvor både struktur og spontanitet har plads
  • har kendskab til ICDP og Tryghedscirklen – eller lyst til at lære mere og uddanne dig inden for området
  • vægter det gode forældresamarbejde og tager aktivt ansvar for dialogen med familierne
  • er en holdspiller, der bidrager til et positivt, ligeværdigt og tillidsfuldt samarbejde
Det får du hos os Hos os får du en arbejdsplads, hvor faglighed, samarbejde og hverdagsglæde går hånd i hånd. Vi er en lille personalegruppe, hvor der er kort vej fra idé til handling, og hvor alle bidrager til, at både børn og voksne trives.

Du får mulighed for at deltage aktivt i planlægning og udvikling af børnehusets pædagogiske praksis med afsæt i de styrkede pædagogiske læreplaner og Odder Kommunes Børn- og Ungepolitik. I Dagtilbud Midt & Syd bygger vores fælles pædagogiske fundament på fem byggesten: samhørighed, mestring, dannelse, nysgerrighed og glæde.

Vi tilbyder ugentlig forberedelsestid, faste gruppemøder og månedlige personalemøder. Du bliver samtidig en del af både det nære fællesskab i Gylling Børnehus, det større fællesskab i Dagtilbud Midt & Syd og Odder Kommune.

Vi sætter pris på omsorg, humor og hjælpsomhed i hverdagen – og vi kan godt lide at grine sammen. Samtidig har vi en engageret forældregruppe og et stærkt lokalmiljø, der bakker op om børnehuset.

Har du lyst til at være en del af Gylling Børnehus? Så glæder vi os til at høre fra dig. Du er meget velkommen til at ringe og aftale et besøg, hvis du har lyst til at opleve huset, stemningen og hverdagen, inden du søger.

For yderligere oplysninger kan du kontakte pædagogisk leder Marianne Nejmann på Marianne.nejmann@odder.dk eller tlf. 29222796.

Du kan også kontakte dagtilbudsleder Lene Rasmussen på L.rasmussen@odder.dk eller tlf. 24667996.

title: Quality Control Inspector II
description:
Job Summary

The Quality Control Inspector II is responsible for performing inspections of incoming materials, in-process components, and finished products to ensure compliance with customer specifications, engineering drawings, company standards, and regulatory requirements. This position utilizes precision measuring equipment, interprets technical documentation, supports quality system activities, and assists in identifying and resolving quality issues. The Quality Control Inspector II serves as a resource to production personnel and may assist in training less experienced inspectors.

Essential Job Functions

  • Perform incoming, in-process, first article, and final inspections in accordance with established procedures and quality standards.
  • Verify product conformity using precision measuring instruments, gauges, and inspection equipment.
  • Read and interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, specifications, and customer requirements
  • Accurately document inspection, testing, and measurement results.
  • Identify and document nonconforming product and ensure proper segregation and disposition.
  • Support root cause investigations and corrective action activities for quality issues.
  • Maintain inspection records and controlled documentation in accordance with quality system requirements.
  • Verify calibration status of measuring and test equipment prior to use and assist with calibration record maintenance.
  • Monitor production processes to ensure compliance with established quality standards.
  • Communicate quality concerns and inspection results to production, engineering, and management teams.
  • Participate in internal audits and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Assist in preparing and reviewing First Article Inspection (FAI) documentation.
  • Train and mentor Quality Control Inspector I personnel as assigned.
  • Maintain a safe and organized work environment.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

    Education and Experience

    • High School Diploma or GED required.
    • Associate degree in a technical or manufacturing-related field preferred.
    • Minimum of two (2) to four (4) years of quality inspection experience in a manufacturing environment.
    • Aerospace manufacturing experience preferred.
    • AS9102 First Article Inspection experience preferred
    • Visual acuity, color recognition, and depth perception necessary to perform inspection functions
    • Strong understanding of inspection techniques and quality assurance principles.
    • Working knowledge of ISO 9001 and AS9100 quality management systems.
    • Proficiency in the use of calipers, micrometers, height gauges, optical comparators, and other measuring devices.
    • Ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings and GD&T preferred.
    • Ability to prioritize work and meet deadlines in a fast-paced manufacturing environment
    • Proficient with Microsoft Office applications and quality documentation systems.
    • Experience with ERP systems, calibration systems, or similar quality systems preferred

We are seeking a Product Owner to help shape and continuously improve our Sportsbook platform, taking ownership of defined features and initiatives from discovery through delivery and post-launch. You will work within a structured product team, partnering closely with a senior Product Manager while having meaningful ownership of your assigned product areas.

As you demonstrate impact, sound judgement, and domain mastery, you will progressively take on broader ownership and greater autonomy. This role offers a clear path for developing your expertise in product discovery, prioritisation, stakeholder management, and the Sportsbook domain.

Work closely with development teams by answering questions, clarifying requirements, resolving product-related issues, and helping remove blockers to facilitate timely product delivery.

Collaborate with other departments as needed to ensure successful product outcomes. Define success metrics for your initiatives where appropriate, track them through delivery and post-launch, and report progress and learnings to the Product Manager.

Communicate updates on product releases and the status of ongoing development efforts to the broader organization, ensuring transparency and alignment.

Continuously assess the live product, identifying areas for improvement and addressing gaps between the expected and actual user experience. Develop improvement proposals and work with the Product Manager to prioritise and implement them.

Key Requirements

Must

2–4 years of Product Owner, Business Analyst, or equivalent product role experience, with demonstrable ownership of features through the full delivery lifecycle - from discovery through post-launch.

Solid experience managing and prioritising a product backlog, working closely with the Product Manager and development teams to deliver value incrementally.

Solid experience with Agile practices (Scrum, Kanban), including sprint planning, sprint reviews, and backlog refinement, with the ability to work effectively in fast-paced, iterative environments.

Experience writing clear, actionable user stories and defining well-structured acceptance criteria, ensuring development teams and stakeholders have a shared understanding of requirements and intended outcomes.

Strong ability to work with cross-functional teams, including engineering, data, product design, business analysis, marketing, and operations.

Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to identify issues, evaluate options, make informed trade-offs, and drive resolution across both product development and live operations.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts in a simple and accessible way for non-technical stakeholders.

Prior experience in the gambling, betting, gaming, or sportsbook industry will be considered a plus.

An interest in sports, sports betting, or the broader gambling industry is an advantage and can help build domain knowledge quickly.

title: Senior Rust or Java Developer, Fixed Income Trading, Senior Vice President
description:
Senior Rust/Java Developer — Low-Latency eTrading Controls & Regulatory Reporting

The Applications Development Senior Lead Analyst is a senior level position responsible for designing, building, and delivering the low latency eTrading controls and regulatory reporting platform for the Fixed Income business. The role owns the control that protects every execution: real‑time pre‑trade risk controls at the point of trade, and the regulatory and trade reporting infrastructure that sits on the highest‑integrity data path. The overall objective is to lead the design and delivery of a latency‑aware, audit‑first control and reporting stack that keeps both the firm’s trading floor and the regulatory framework safe without compromising execution speed.

Responsibilities

Partner with Markets eTrading management, trading desks, risk, and compliance to define architecture for real‑time pre‑trade risk controls and the regulatory reporting platform, ensuring integration with existing Firm and Markets technology infrastructure and control frameworks

  • Design and deliver the latency‑critical control and reporting paths in Rust, owning end‑to‑end design of real‑time pre‑trade risk checks (credit, mandatory/tenor limits, kill switches, price/tick validation) that fire inline on the hot execution path
  • Lead integration and hand‑off with the existing Java‑based trading and reporting stack, bridging the Rust low‑latency control core with the broader Java ecosystem and downstream regulatory systems
  • Build and maintain the regulatory reporting infrastructure — including MiFID II / SEC / CFTC trade reconstruction, record‑keeping, and best‑execution reporting — with an audit‑first, append‑only, tamper‑evident design that guarantees data integrity and completeness end to end
  • Own the latency budget for controls: engineer risk checks and reporting capture so they add minimal, predictable overhead to the execution path, profiling, and tuning hot paths to meet strict latency and throughput SLAs
  • Implement robust detection and escalation for control and reporting failures — including fail‑open versus fail‑closed decisioning, real‑time alerting, and reconciliation of reported versus executed trades — so gaps are surfaced with transparency
  • Serve as advisor and technical lead to the engineering team, allocating work, conducting code reviews, setting engineering standards for safety‑critical, latency‑sensitive control systems, and championing Rust adoption where it is the right tool
  • Appropriately assess risk when technical and architectural decisions are made, demonstrating consideration for the firm’s reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients, and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules, and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment, and escalating, managing, and reporting control issues with transparency

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of relevant experience in application development, systems programming, or low‑latency platform engineering, ideally within a financial services or electronic trading environment
  • Deep, production‑grade experience with Rust in latency‑critical, high‑throughput systems — including unsafe code, memory mapping, lock‑free/allocation‑free hot paths, and cross‑platform deployment — combined with strong working knowledge of Java and the ability to bridge the two ecosystems
  • Demonstrated expertise in low‑latency engineering: kernel and network tuning, busy‑polling, ring buffers, cache‑line optimization, zero‑copy I/O, and quantitative benchmark/measurement methodologies
  • Proven, hands‑on experience in electronic trading controls and regulatory compliance in a market’s environment, including pre‑trade risk controls, MiFID II / SEC / CFTC trade and transaction reporting, trade reconstruction, and best‑execution record keeping
  • Subject Matter Expert (SME) in at least one of: real‑time pre‑trade risk and control systems, regulatory/Trade reporting frameworks (MiFID II, EMIR, SEC/CFTC), or high‑integrity, audit‑first data pipelines
  • Experience owning the full lifecycle of safety‑critical, latency‑sensitive software through design, delivery, and 24/7 operational support, with a rigorous testing discipline (property‑based, chaos, and load testing) and a demonstrable focus on data integrity and reconciliation
  • Demonstrated leadership and project management skills, with a track record mentoring senior and mid‑level engineers and setting engineering standards
  • Ability to adjust priorities quickly as circumstances dictate in a fast‑paced, real‑time trading technology environment
  • Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication, including the ability to translate complex technical controls and regulatory concepts for non‑technical business stakeholders

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience
  • Master’s degree preferred
