title: Quality Leader, Clinical Quality and Safety
description:
Salary Details

The salary range for this position is CAD $46.39/Hr. - CAD $66.68/Hr.

Job Summary

Come work as a Quality Leader, Clinical Quality and Safety with Vancouver Coastal Health (VCH)!

Reporting to the Director, Quality, Safety and Improvement, the Quality Leader provides specialized skills in the support of achieving Vancouver Coastal Health’s (VCH’s) organizational and quality improvement strategic direction. The position provides expertise and support to clinical operations, corporate services and unit-based teams directed at improving the safety and quality of care and patient experience at VCH. The position ensures that initiatives are aligned with organizational goals, objectives and improvement priorities.

The Quality Leader promotes the development and enrichment of an organization-wide improvement culture, and works as part of the team to achieve outcomes, provide leadership to specific projects, support the identification of system improvement opportunities, support the development of knowledge, and the use of quality improvement methods and tools to improve work processes.

The Quality Leader functions at all levels of the organization, across all programs and sites, partners with point-of-care teams (physicians, nursing, and allied care) and interacts with senior leadership, clinical directors, patient and resident care management and corporate and support leaders.

This work is framed within VCH’s commitments to our pillars of Indigenous Cultural Safety, Anti-Racism, Equity, Diversity and Inclusion, and Planetary Health.

As a Quality Leader, Clinical Quality and Safety with Vancouver Coastal Health you will:

Quality Improvement

  • Provide expert advice and support in the preparation of organization-wide quality plans, promoting consistency with organizational strategic priorities as well as compatibility with relevant professional and accreditation standards in collaboration with leaders.
  • Provide leadership, facilitation, and coordination as required to organizational committees, improvement groups and operational/implementation groups.
  • Support leaders and teams in the identification of opportunities to improve the quality, safety, and patient experience as well as the design and implementation of strategies to make these improvements.
  • Identify and support resolution to problems or barriers to ensure success of the project
  • Identify the information requirements of teams, projects and/or initiatives, and develop strategies to meet those needs.
  • Research regional, provincial, national and international health care trends and innovations.
  • Provide information, reports, analyses, recommendations and sustainment plans to teams, Director, Quality, Safety and Improvement, organizational leaders and Senior Leadership
  • Team as required to support evaluation and decision-making.
  • Maintain expert knowledge related to the methods and tools of continuous quality improvement and their application.
  • Ensure a consistent application of the methods and tools of continuous quality improvement in the organization.
  • Act as a resource and coach to others in this regard. Role model quality improvement principles by promoting staff involvement in decision-making.

Project and Change Management

  • Provide project and change management expertise to advance the strategic priorities in the organization to achieve outcomes.
  • Ensure a consistent application of change management practices in the organization.
  • Monitor the budget and human resource needs for assigned projects.
  • Identify risks associated in the duration of the project.

Education/Training

  • Facilitate learning and deliver educational sessions aligned with quality improvement, successful management and integration of change and quality improvement.

Coaching/Facilitation

  • Provide coaching and facilitation as required to organizational committees, planning groups and operational/implementation groups.Accreditation.
  • Promote and provide assistance in accreditation preparations and support leaders in the organization to ensure compliance of standards as part of the commitment to continuous improvement.

Collaboration

  • Build strong relationships with key internal stakeholders to successfully complete projects and initiatives across VCH.
  • Work collaboratively with external stakeholders to successfully complete joint initiatives, both regionally and provincially.
  • Carry out responsibilities in accordance with health and safety requirements. Immediately report unsafe situations by notifying supervisor or other appropriate personnel.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Master’s Degree in Health Services Administration, Science or Business Administration of related studies, with three (3) to five (5) years recent, related experience with quality improvement, or an equivalent combination of education, training and experience.
  • Expert knowledge and three (3) years’ experience utilizing the methodology and tools of continuous improvement to support process improvement and system redesign.

Knowledge & Abilities

  • Knowledge of and experience with quality improvement methodologies (Model for Improvement, LEAN, Six Sigma), techniques (measurement, learning models, change management theory, influencing techniques) and tools (e.g., process mapping, workflow diagrams, system monitoring and evaluation, PDSA cycles, data display with run and control charts).
  • Develops and maintains strong relationships with key internal and external partners to promote and enhance services provided with sensitivity to diversity and indigenous lens.
  • Practices the recognition, inclusion and support of all types and aspects of diversity at all stages of engagement, with an understanding of the issues faced by people from equity-deserving groups.
  • Displays comprehensive knowledge of project management principles and methodologies and ability to coach team members on these skills.
  • Utilizes independent thinking and creative problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills to function within a complex interdisciplinary environment.
  • Works effectively under time pressure to meet deadlines, balance work priorities and resolve problems in a timely manner.
  • Physical ability to perform the duties of the position.

Closing Statement

TheraPeds Partners is a Colorado based, therapist-owned and operated organization. We partner with our local schools to provide School Psychology services to PreK–12 students nationwide. Our mission is to deliver high-quality School Psychology services while making meaningful connections in a collaborative learning environment.

This is a part-time, on-site role as a School Psychologist serving a school located in Parker, CO.

The School Psychologist will be responsible for providing therapy services to students, conducting assessments, developing IEP plans, evaluating and eligibility processes, collaborating with interdisciplinary teams (therapists, educators, parents), supporting students according to their IEP. title: IT Architect Endpoint Management
description:
We are looking for an IT Architect Endpoint Management profile to join our IT team. The position provides advanced technical support to internal users across different countries and global regions, while also contributing to system administration and network operations to ensure stable and secure IT services.

Join us in shaping the future of IT security, developing secure and sustainable endpoint architectures, and actively contributing to making our digital workplace resilient and compliant. With us, you’ll have the freedom to contribute big ideas and take initiative. As part of an interdisciplinary and diverse team, you’ll apply your expertise in endpoint management to ambitious projects, help shape standards and roadmaps, and ensure that security and compliance requirements are reliably implemented in accordance with BSI-CON-11.1. We look forward to receiving your application for our office in Málaga.

Due to the international scope of the role, working hours are not fixed and may include evening, night, weekend, or rotating shifts, depending on the regions being supported.

Key Responsibilities

Endpoint Architecture & Strategy

  • Develop and design a highly secure endpoint management environment with clear target architectures, standards, and governance models.
  • Ensure that security, compliance, and regulatory requirements (e.g., BSI-CON-11.1 and related guidelines) are embedded into endpoint architectures and operational processes.
  • Evaluate, design, and implement new endpoint technologies and solutions to continuously improve the digital workplace experience.
  • Lead endpoint management projects from planning and design through implementation and operational transition.

Endpoint Operations & Management

  • Provide Level 2/3 support for complex endpoint-related incidents, service requests, and problem management activities.
  • Manage incidents through their full lifecycle, perform root cause analysis, and drive permanent resolution of recurring issues.
  • Support and maintain Microsoft Intune, Entra ID, and Microsoft 365 endpoint management services.
  • Configure, test, and optimize device policies, compliance policies, configuration profiles, and endpoint security controls.
  • Monitor endpoint compliance, coordinate remediation activities, and support device lifecycle management processes.
  • Support onboarding, offboarding, device provisioning, and deployment activities for end users.

Software Deployment & Continuous Improvement

  • Oversee software packaging, testing, deployment, and lifecycle management activities for business applications and endpoint platforms.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve application deployment and device management issues.
  • Validate new endpoint configurations, policies, and solutions before production rollout.
  • Participate in pilot deployments, testing initiatives, automation efforts, and continuous service improvement programs.

Stakeholder & Vendor Management

  • Manage external service providers and coordinate interfaces between IT Security, Infrastructure, Workplace Services, and Operations teams.
  • Act as a technical advisor and escalation point for endpoint-related topics across the organization.
  • Support knowledge sharing and technical enablement within the Endpoint Management team.

Documentation & Governance

  • Create and maintain technical documentation, architecture standards, operational procedures, and knowledge base articles.
  • Document recurring issues, standard solutions, and architectural decisions.
  • Ensure endpoint management processes and documentation align with security and compliance requirements.
  • 4+ years of experience in Endpoint Management, IT Operations, or advanced IT Support
  • Experience with Microsoft Intune and endpoint management solutions
  • Knowledge of software packaging and application deployment
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills
  • Understanding of endpoint security and compliance concepts
  • Basic PowerShell knowledge is an advantage
  • Strong communication and customer service skills
  • A high level of English is required (C1)
  • To ensure your work-life balance, we offer the option of mobile working
  • We promote your professional and personal development through individually tailored student mentoring
  • Make valuable contacts within Drees & Sommer and expand your professional network
  • Modern workplace and equipment; Teams meetings and participation in corporate workshops
  • Receive compensation that gives you financial independence during your studies

title: Data Center Operations Engineer
description:
As an Operations Engineer supporting Singtel’s GPU-as-a-Service (GPUaaS) platform, you will contribute to the implementation, integration, and day-to-day operations of data centre environments that enable customers’ AI and High-Performance Computing (HPC) workloads.   • Identify potential workplace safety and health risks within the data centre environment.
  • Conduct visual inspections of servers and cooling distribution units.
  • Perform server troubleshooting in collaboration with remote engineering teams.

  • Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Building Services, or a related discipline.
  • Broad understanding of data centre electrical and mechanical infrastructure, including fire safety systems, building management systems (BMS), equipment maintenance, and space planning.
  • Experience in maintaining and operating data centre equipment, with emphasis on electrical and mechanical systems.
  • Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
  • Organised, adaptable, and able to respond to changing operational requirements and schedules.
  • Demonstrated willingness to learn and develop skills in GPU-oriented and mission-critical data centre technologies.

title: Internship Credit Risk Policies & Frameworks
description:
Internship Credit Risk Policies & Frameworks

We are looking for an energetic intern that wants to help us update our Credit Risk policies (theory) and help us improve the bank by testing whether the people that work for ING adhere to these policies (practice). Our Credit Risk Policy team works from our head office in Amsterdam (Bijlmerdreef 106). The role is full-time (36 hours), hybrid (2-3 days from the office), and we pay a market-based internship fee (each month). Internship duration is 6 months. Start date is mid-September.

The Opportunity

Credit Risk at a bank manages the risk whether a customer won’t pay back the money they owe (for instance a mortgage, credit card or a company loan). As you can imagine, this means it is the biggest risk that banks face, and we spend a lot of time and energy to figure out the best ways to make sure our client pays back the money they owe us, while keeping the interest of our clients and society into account as well. Our team makes the credit risk policies for the entire bank which provides the bankers with rules and guidance how they should manage this risk. We oversee ~70 different policies/procedures and work in groups to create and update these documents annually.

The internship is a great opportunity to learn how a bank works, help us think about how we can improve our processes, and figure out where things are going wrong and suggest improvements.

The Team

Our team is very diverse, international, energetic, and smart, but we always welcome new inspiration. We have 15 team members of which about half are international. There are people with a lot of experience that will have an answer to almost any question, but there are also people that are starting their career. It’s a good mix that allows us to work together on the complex topics we are responsible for, but we also catch up frequently at the bar around the corner.

What you'll do

  • Work in groups to update our Credit Risk policies that ING globally must adhere to.
  • Collaborate with and be trained by junior and senior policy experts.
  • Meet people outside our team to discuss our policies, which is good for your network.

How to succeed

To take on this challenging and rewarding opportunity, you’ll need:

  • A Master or Bachelor student (3rd year minimum) with a strong interest in banking
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • High ambition and energy level.
  • Organisational and project management skills.
  • Fluency in English, Dutch not required.

Rewards and benefits

This is a great opportunity to train with highly skilled people who are experts in their field. You’ll do a lot and learn a lot – not only about credit risk and the bank, but also about yourself and whether this type of environment is right for you.

You’ll also benefit from:

  • Internship allowance
  • Your own work laptop
  • Hybrid working
  • Personal growth and challenging work with endless possibilities
  • An informal working environment with innovative colleagues

Questions?

Contact the recruiter attached to the advertisement for more information. Want to apply directly? Please upload your CV and motivation letter by clicking the “Apply” button.

title: Data Analyst- Banking Data Ingestion & Reconciliation
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Data Analyst with strong banking domain knowledge and hands-on expertise in data profiling, validation, reconciliation, and source-to-target analysis. The role will focus on ensuring the completeness, accuracy, and integrity of source data ingested into the Bronze layer of the data platform across key banking domains including Management Accounting, Financial Accounting, RegulatoryReporting, and Transaction Banking.

The successful candidate will work closely with business, finance, data engineering, and technology teams to identify data quality issues, validate ingestion outcomes, reconcile source-to-Bronze data, and document data lineage and transformation requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform detailed data profiling, validation, and reconciliation of source data loaded into the Bronze layer.
  • Validate source-to-Bronze ingestion for completeness, accuracy, consistency, and integrity.
  • Develop and execute reconciliation checks covering record counts, balances, control totals, field-level comparisons, duplicates, null values, data types, and business-rule validations.
  • Investigate and analyze data discrepancies between source systems and the target data platform.
  • Identify root causes of data quality and reconciliation issues and work with data engineering and source-system teams to resolve them.
  • Perform source data analysis across banking domains such as:
  • Management Accounting
  • Financial Accounting
  • Regulatory Reporting
  • Transaction Banking
  • Translate business and finance requirements into detailed data validation and reconciliation rules.
  • Create and maintain source-to-target mappings, data lineage documentation, reconciliation evidence, and data quality reports.
  • Use SQL, Databricks, Spark, Python, notebooks, and Excel to perform large-scale data analysis and profiling.
  • Build dashboards and visualizations using Power BI to communicate data quality, reconciliation results, trends, exceptions, and key metrics.
  • Collaborate with Finance, Risk, Regulatory Reporting, Transaction Banking, Data Governance, Data Engineering, and Technology teams.
  • Support testing activities including data validation, SIT/UAT reconciliation, defect investigation, and production data verification.
  • Ensure data controls and reconciliation processes comply with established banking data governance and audit requirements.

Required Experience

  • 6 years of experience in data analysis within the banking or financial services industry.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience in data profiling and source-to-target reconciliation, particularly for source-to-Bronze or similar raw data ingestion layers.
  • Strong domain knowledge in at least one of the following:
  • Management Accounting
  • Financial Accounting
  • Regulatory Reporting
  • Transaction Banking
  • Strong understanding of banking data, financial data structures, accounting concepts, transactional datasets, and data quality controls.
  • Experience investigating complex data discrepancies and performing root-cause analysis.

Technical Skills

  • Advanced SQL for querying, profiling, reconciliation, and validation of large datasets.
  • Hands-on experience with Databricks and/or Apache Spark.
  • Experience working with Databricks notebooks or similar notebook-based analytical environments.
  • Proficiency in Python and/or advanced Excel for data analysis, reconciliation, and automation.
  • Experience documenting data lineage, source-to-target mappings, and reconciliation rules.
  • Working knowledge of Power BI for dashboarding, reporting, and data visualization.
  • Familiarity with modern data lake, lakehouse, or cloud-based data architectures would be advantageous.

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
description:
See what you can do with Prophix

At Prophix, we’re building the platform that helps finance teams stop managing spreadsheets and start driving strategy. Prophix One brings planning, reporting, consolidation, and automation together in a single place, and we are expanding its AI capabilities faster than ever. If you want to work on a product that genuinely changes how finance teams operate, and do it alongside people who care about getting it right, this is where you want to be.

We’re headquartered in the Greater Toronto Area, with teams and offices across North America, Europe, and Australia. Trusted by more than 3,000 finance teams across 100+ countries, Prophix One is built for organisations that want to plan smarter and move faster.

As a Senior Full-Stack Engineer on the FP&A Plus platform, you will design, build, and maintain the modular .NET capabilities that more than 2,500 finance teams around the world rely on every day for budgeting, reporting, and integrated financial planning. Working within a collaborative agile team alongside engineers, product managers, and QA specialists, you will own meaningful slices of a large, domain-driven modular-monolith — shipping high-quality, testable code that directly shapes how finance professionals plan and make decisions. This is a role for an engineer who takes pride in correctness, cares about architecture, and wants their work to matter at scale.

What You Will Do

  • Design and build new features within one or more FP&A Plus bounded-context modules (budgeting, workflow, reporting, journal management, data import, and more), following established Abstractions / implementation / UnitOfWork / UnitTests patterns.
  • Write efficient, correct data-access code against AWS Aurora Serverless (PostgreSQL), applying a clear understanding of its auto-scaling capacity model, connection-pooling behaviour, and timeout semantics rather than assuming fixed-capacity database behaviour.
  • Build and consume event-driven integrations using AWS SQS via MassTransit and scheduled workflows via Quartz.NET as part of cross-module feature delivery.
  • Apply the platform's module-flag-based authorization model correctly when building new endpoints or MCP tools that interact with tenant data.
  • Ensure quality through automated testing with xUnit, Moq, and FluentAssertions in a continuous integration environment, including integration tests tagged for the DB-integration test suite where appropriate.
  • Investigate and resolve defects across pre-production, production, and post-release patches with thorough root-cause analysis rather than surface-level fixes.
  • Contribute to code reviews, architecture discussions, and performance tuning of data-heavy operations within your module area.
  • Coordinate cross-module technical dependencies, clearly defining and respecting cross-module contracts in a large, distributed modular system.

What You Will Bring

We hire for potential as much as experience. If this role excites you but you don’t check every box, we still want to hear from you. At Prophix, people who ask good questions, adapt quickly, and bring a fresh perspective often make the biggest impact.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience building production-grade distributed applications.
  • Strong proficiency in C# and .NET/Core, with hands‑on experience using PostgreSQL and Entity Framework (or a comparable ORM/data-access pattern).
  • Demonstrated expertise in microservices or modular-monolith architectures and domain-driven design patterns.
  • Cloud-native AWS experience with services including Lambda, SQS, Aurora Serverless (PostgreSQL), and S3.
  • Proficiency in both Windows and Linux environments for developing and managing complex distributed systems.
  • Solid command of Git source control and continuous integration tooling.
  • Practiced in unit and integration testing with an agile and test-driven development mindset.
  • Post‑secondary degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related discipline — or equivalent professional experience.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across technical teams.
  • Must be legally entitled to work in the country where this role is located
  • Comfortable using AI tools responsibly to support tasks such as research, drafting, and data review
  • Able to learn new tools and adapt as technology and workflows evolve.
  • Curious, open to new approaches, and motivated to continuously improve.
  • Collaborative mindset when working across teams and with AI supported tooling.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience operating PostgreSQL on a serverless or auto-scaling managed offering such as AWS Aurora Serverless at production scale.
  • Exposure to OLAP or multi-dimensional data models, and/or event-driven architecture (message queues, pub/sub) beyond basic usage.
  • Understanding of identity and access management principles including OAuth2/OIDC, JWT, SSO, and MFA.
  • Experience building or consuming LLM/agent tooling (MCP or comparable) — an emerging and actively growing area of the Prophix platform.
  • Academic or practical knowledge of corporate financial concepts such as planning, budgeting, forecasting, or consolidation.

What Success Looks Like

  • 30 days: You know our platform, our customers, and how your team operates. You’ve completed onboarding and are contributing to live work.
  • 90 days: You’re working independently, owning deliverables end to end, and building relationships across functions and regions.
  • 6 months: Your fingerprints are on something real. You’ve improved a process, shipped something meaningful, or earned a seat at the table on a decision that matters.

Why Join Prophix?

Prophix is headquartered in the GTA, so joining our team puts you close to where decisions are made, strategy is set, and careers are built. You’ll collaborate across North America, Europe, and Australia, developing breadth you simply can’t get at a single market company. Our people move across functions, work directly with customers in different industries, and take on meaningful challenges early. We’re a company that competes on talent. That means we invest in the people who show up curious, move fast, and want to leave things better than they found them. Our values are Pursue Excellence, Build with Purpose, Create Wins for All, and Drive Continuous Innovation, and they guide how we actually make decisions.

Compensation

The total target compensation for this role is $145,000CAD to $165,000CAD, in accordance with applicable pay transparency laws. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors such as skills, experience, location, and internal equity.

What’s Included for You?

  • Comprehensive health, dental, vision, and mental-health coverage
  • Retirement savings with employer contributions
  • Parental leave top-up
  • Annual wellness allowance
  • Generous paid time off including vacation and sick time
  • Education assistance and tuition reimbursement
  • Social events, team activities, and opportunities to build community
  • Opportunities to participate in Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives
  • Quarterly Town Halls and Kickoffs that bring teams together to celebrate wins, share updates, and look ahead at what’s next

Accessibility & AI Transparency

Prophix promotes an accessible hiring process. If you need accommodation at any stage, we’ll work with you. Some interviews may be recorded so our hiring team can review and assess responses fairly and consistently. As part of our commitment to Responsible AI, we use a small number of AI-supported tools to help with tasks like resume review, shortlisting, or creating interview summaries. AI is never used as the sole basis for hiring decisions, and your personal data is never used to train AI models. If you'd prefer not to take part in any AI-assisted step, just let us know and we’ll be happy to accommodate.

title: Application engineer - dx & vrv
description:
Daikin Middle East & Africa is a subsidiary of Daikin Industries Ltd. and the leading provider of heating, cooling, ventilation, air purification, and refrigeration technology. The company designs, manufactures and brings to market a broad portfolio of equipment, as well as tailor‑made solutions for residential, commercial, and industrial purposes in Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EMEA). To date, Daikin EMEA has over 12 000 employees across more than 59 consolidated subsidiaries. It has 12 major manufacturing facilities based in Belgium, the Czech Republic, Germany, Italy, Spain, Turkey, Austria, and the UK. Our aim is to drive sustainable and effective solutions, sparking a good climate for the generations to come. And all this can only be achieved because of our People.

About The Role

The Application Engineer – DX & VRV plays a key role in delivering technically sound, optimized, and commercially competitive HVAC solutions across Daikin's sales organization. This role is responsible for equipment selection, system design validation, technical compliance, and application engineering support throughout the project lifecycle. You will work closely with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, and other internal stakeholders, and ensure that proposed DX and VRV solutions meet customer requirements, local regulations, and Daikin engineering standards while contributing to successful project execution and business growth in Qatar.

How You Will Make An Impact Provide application engineering support to all Sales functions throughout the project lifecycle, from project inquiry to order confirmation. Design, size, and select DX, VRV and AHU equipment using Daikin selection software (VRV, AHU selection software, and other approved engineering tools). Review project specifications, tender documents, HVAC drawings, and schedules to develop compliant and optimized technical solutions. Validate equipment selections to ensure technical feasibility, energy efficiency, compliance with project requirements, and adherence to Daikin engineering standards. Prepare technical submittals, equipment schedules, selection reports, and engineering documentation to support project proposals. Provide value engineering recommendations and alternative solutions that improve technical performance and commercial competitiveness. Coordinate with Product Management, Sales, Factory Engineering, and other internal teams to resolve technical queries and ensure timely project support. Support quotation preparation by providing accurate technical selections, engineering calculations, and costing inputs. Participate in technical meetings with consultants, customers, contractors, and internal stakeholders to present solutions, discuss design requirements, and address application-related questions. Stay current with HVAC technologies, local regulations, industry standards, and Daikin product developments to provide best‑in‑class application support. Ensure smooth technical handover to the execution team following order confirmation. What You Need To Succeed Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, HVAC Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. Minimum 5 years of experience in HVAC Application Engineering, Technical Support, or HVAC System Design, with strong expertise in DX and VRV systems, preferably within the Qatar or GCC market. Strong knowledge of HVAC system design, equipment selection, psychometrics, heat load calculations, and energy‑efficient system applications. Hands‑on experience using HVAC selection and design software, including VRV, Auto CAD, AHU selection software and Microsoft Office applications. Solid understanding of MEP drawings, HVAC design standards, tender specifications, and consultant requirements. Proven experience providing technical support across multiple sales channels, including equipment selection, solution optimization, value engineering, and technical proposal development. Ability to analyze project requirements, identify technical risks, and recommend practical engineering solutions. Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to build effective relationships with consultants, contractors, customers, and internal stakeholders. Excellent planning, organizational, and problem‑solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and meet tight deadlines. Fluent in English. Arabic language skills are an advantage. Knowledge of international HVAC standards (ASHRAE and AHRI) and familiarity with the Qatar Construction Specifications (QCS) and other applicable local regulations will be an advantage. Our employees are the beating heart of our company. At Daikin, you get to work in a positive environment backed by trust, creativity and continuous improvement. We are deeply committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace culture that reflects the communities we serve. Good climate starts with people. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Founding People & Talent Lead
description:
About the Role

A fast-growing, seed-stage AI company in Munich is hiring a Founding People & Talent Lead to build the Talent and People function from scratch. This is a high-impact, hands-on founding role working directly alongside the founding team to solve the single most critical scaling challenge for a high-growth AI business operating in a large, underserved market.

The company automates inside sales processes — quoting, order handling, and customer inquiries — for distributors and manufacturers using enterprise-grade AI. With strong early traction across the DACH region and backing from top-tier investors, the team is now ready to scale headcount rapidly and needs a sharp, high-agency operator to own that journey end-to-end.

Early emphasis will be heavily on Talent Acquisition, with increasing scope into broader People operations as the company grows.

What You'll Do

  • Build and own the full hiring engine — leading recruiting end-to-end from role definition through to offer and close.

  • Source and close exceptional candidates across functions, spending the majority of your time on talent early on.

  • Design and scale recruiting processes, analytics, workflows, and operating rhythms that enable fast, high-quality hiring.

  • Partner with founders and team leads to define role expectations, calibrate hiring decisions, and challenge org design.

  • Shape People systems over time, including onboarding, performance calibration, career progression frameworks, and compensation benchmarking.

  • Develop and execute an employer brand strategy to attract top talent across the DACH region and beyond.

  • Build and nurture a talent network across universities, startups, and technical communities.

  • Leverage AI tools and experiment continuously with new recruiting workflows to increase hiring velocity and quality.

  • Champion a high hiring bar and implement scalable measures to maintain standards as the company grows.

  • Contribute actively to company culture and hire with a long-term retention and development lens.

What We're Looking For

Must-have:

  • 2–5 years of experience with meaningful time in Talent Acquisition, People, or org development at a high-growth startup or scaleup.

  • Demonstrated experience leading end-to-end recruiting across all functions (role definition, sourcing, assessment, closing) — ideally in a hypergrowth context (e.g. 10→50 or 30→100 employees).

  • Structured thinker who can design systems and execute them independently (design, implement, iterate).

  • Strong storytelling and relationship-building skills with a track record of sourcing and closing senior candidates.

  • Daily user of AI tools with a genuine curiosity to experiment with new workflows.

  • Ability to build employer branding and a talent network to attract top candidates in the DACH region and beyond.

  • Full professional fluency in English.

  • Comfortable with on-site work in Munich and a high-agency, ambiguous environment.

Nice-to-have:

  • German language skills (a meaningful plus for DACH hiring and employer branding).

  • Experience with performance calibration and compensation benchmarking as part of scaling People operations.

  • Background or strong interest in B2B SaaS or AI/enterprise software environments.

  • Openness to growing into a broader People leadership role as the company scales.

Location & Work Arrangement

This role is based on-site in Munich, Germany. The team works together in person and this role is expected to be present in the office. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

Compensation & Benefits

Compensation details were not specified for this role. You will work as a core founding team member at a well-funded, early-stage company with significant scope for ownership, career growth, and impact.

title: 3 X F, er det dig? Vi søger en sygeplejerske til Hæmatologisk afdeling, afsnit M, Sjællands Universitetshospital
description:
FAGLIGHED, FÆLLESSKAB og FEDT SPECIALE

Kære kommende kollega

Vi er blevet opnormeret og søger derfor pr. den 1. september/oktober 2026 eller efter aftale en sygeplejerske til fastansættelse i vores sengeafsnit.

I afsnit M varetager vi plejen og behandling til patienter med Myelomatose, akut leukæmi og benigne hæmatologiske sygdomme. Vi prioriterer, at hvert patientforløb er individuelt og tværfagligt tilrettelagt samt at det sker i et tæt samarbejde med patienten og dennes pårørende. Den gode relation, kontinuitet og medinddragelse er essentielle begreber i vores sygepleje.

Når du træder ind i vores afsnit, vil du mærke stoltheden over vores fag og hvor dedikerede både de nye og erfarne er for at udføre den bedst mulige sygepleje for vores patienter. Sygeplejegruppen består af ca. 30 sygeplejersker og 5 social- og sundhedsassistenter, som er alt fra nyuddannede til over 10+ års erfaring.

Vi er af den overbevisning, at vores kompetencer udvikles i fællesskab. Der er tæt sparring med vores fantastiske læger samt mulighed for at dykke dybt i patientcases gennem fælles dialog – det gør os unikke.

Vi værdsætter et kulturbærende arbejdsmiljø, hvor der er plads til alle. Spørgsmål og refleksioner er en del af vores hverdag. Dem kan der aldrig være for mange af. Du kan følge med i både vores faglige og sociale hverdag på vores Instagram profil: @haematologiskafsnit.m_suh.

Udvikling af sygeplejen samt det at have mod og turde at tænke nyt til gavn for patienterne, de pårørende, organisationen, hinanden og os selv er en stor del af vores hverdag. Vi er meget inspireret af aktionslæring og arbejder ud fra en personcentreret tilgang. Hvilket betyder, at vi formår at komme helt ind under det enkelte menneskes liv og sygdom i sammenhæng. Det er derfor ikke ualmindeligt at følge en patient fra indlæggelse til deres sidste tid.

Specialet og afdelingen rummer ubeskrivelig mange muligheder for læring og kompetenceudvikling både fagligt og personligt, samt det åbner op for gode videreuddannelsesmuligheder. Alle, uanset funktion og stilling, kan være med til at udvikle, forandre og forbedre sygeplejen.


Onboarding – introduktion til hæmatologi:
  • 1 års individuelt tilrettelagt Onboarding Program med mentorordning. Det er en oplæringsperiode, der bedst muligt bliver skræddersyet til dine kompetencer og læringsmål. Vi tager udgangspunkt i, hvad du kommer med af erfaring, samt hvilke kompetencer du skal udvikle og videreudvikle hos os. De første 4 uger vil du følges med din mentor i alle vagtlag.

“Jeg er vild med den måde, der er blevet taget hånd om mig som ny. Aldrig før har jeg glædet mig i denne grad til at møde ind. Det føles som om, at jeg altid har været en del af holdet, det er så fedt at blive værdsat som en aktuel kollega” - [Sygeplejerske Malthe]

Mulighed for evig udvikling:
  • At være en del af en interessegruppe inden for dit interesseområde f.eks. Akut sygepleje, Palliation, Ernæring, HDT m.m.
  • Oplæring i alle afsnittets funktioner herunder vores ambulatorie og dagafsnit.
  • Oplæring i at håndtere CVK og anlægge PVK, inkl. ultralydsvejledt PVK.
  • Oplæring i HDT og CAR-T
  • Et højt prioriteret læringsmiljø med tre hæmatologiske grundkurser.
  • Årlig SKILLS-dag.
  • Kursus i medicinsk kræftbehandling, der består af et teoretisk E-learningskursus og praktisk oplæring i håndtering af kemoterapi undervejs og afslutningsvis en praktisk oplæring dag.
  • Oplæring i de daglige funktioner, f.eks. stuegang, medicinhåndtering m.m.

”Som noget nyt begynder nye sygeplejersker at gå stuegang på 1-2 patienter efter 4 uger. Det var lidt nervepirrende i starten. Men det er så fedt. Det er utrolig lærerigt at være i et makkerpar med en erfaren læge, som man kan spørge om alt. Det har virkelig gjort og gør en forskel for min læringskurve” – [Sygeplejerske Oliver]

Samskabende kultur og fokus på et udviklende og lærende arbejdsmiljø:
  • Tværfaglige konferencer, sygeplejefaglige møder, tværfaglig stuegang m.m.
  • Kolleger, både monofagligt og tværfagligt, som brænder for specialet, og som alle føler, at vi har en pligt til at bidrage til kerneopgaven og det sociale fællesskab.
  • Et omsorgs- og tillidsfuldt psykisk arbejdsmiljø, hvor vi prioriterer trivsel, dialog og samvær meget højt. Ved behov har vi supervision ved hospitalets præst og/eller psykolog.
  • Vi er meget opmærksomme på at kombinere faglighed og det at have det sjovt sammen både i og uden for arbejdstiden. Vi går meget op i det sociale samvær er på plads, og det er rart at møde op.


Vi håber, at du er blevet fristet til at søge en stilling hos os. Hæmatologisk erfaring er godt, men ikke en forudsætning for at søge. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at lære specialet at kende. Så finder vi ud af resten sammen. Vi er opmærksomme på den enkelte ansatte, og ingen falder igennem sprækkerne.

Stillingen er med weekendvagt hver 3. weekend og 37 timer pr. uge, men kom gerne med et alternativ, hvis du har et andet ønske ift. timetal. Er du aften- eller natteravn og gerne vil have fast eller fortrinsvis aften- eller nattevagter, er det helt klart også en mulighed.

Den 4. oktober 2026 skal afdelingen flytte til Køge. Det er en stor forandring og en rigtig spændende proces, som det er vigtigt, at du har lyst til at være en del af. Vi skal sammen finde ud af, hvordan vi bedst får flyttet afdelingen til Køge.

Ønsker du at komme forbi og se afdelingen, har du nogle spørgsmål eller lignende, eller lyst til at møde personalet, så tøv endelig ikke med at kontakte os, vi giver hjertens gerne en kop kaffe!

Vi håber at høre fra dig.

Mange hæmatologiske hilsener fra os alle på H60-M! 😊🩸


Startløn for overenskomstansatte

Regionen er forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startlønnen for stillingen. Du får oplyst grundløn, centralt fastsatte tillæg og pension i den relevante overenskomst. Udover startlønnen, kan lønnen indeholde eventuelt forhandlede tillæg afhængigt af stillingen, dine erfaringer og kvalifikationer.

Se startlønnen på regionens hjemmeside

Om Sjællands Universitetshospital

Sjællands Universitetshospital er Danmarks nyeste universitetshospital med aktiviteter i Køge, Roskilde og Nykøbing F. Vi er et modigt og udadvendt universitetshospital, hvor vi hver dag arbejder for at skabe et sammenhængende sundhedsvæsen og større lighed i sundhed for borgerne i regionen.

Vores optageområde er præget af flere borgere med kronisk sygdom og sociale udfordringer end landsgennemsnittet. Derfor arbejder vi målrettet med innovation, nye samarbejdsformer og løsninger, der bringer behandling tættere på borgerne.

Hos os bliver du en del af en ambitiøs arbejdsplads, hvor samarbejde på tværs, høj faglighed og løbende forbedringer er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Vores ledelsesværdier er nytænkning, følgeskab, ordentlighed og fællesskab, og de sætter retning for, hvordan vi arbejder, udvikler os og skaber gode resultater – for både borgere og medarbejdere.

title: Senior R&D Engineer
company: XNERGY AUTONOMOUS POWER TECHNOLOGIES PTE. LTD.
description:
Xnergy is a multi-VC-funded and sovereign-backed global deep-tech leader in high-power universal wireless charging for electrified mobility. With deployments in close to 40 countries and adoption by nearly 120 autonomous robotics companies, Xnergy was recognised as an APAC 25 company in 2020 by Cleantech Group.

The APAC25 is an annual list of 25 private sustainable innovation companies recognised for their potential to make a significant impact over a five- to ten-year horizon.

Headquartered in Singapore, Xnergy is expanding its geographical presence into key markets, including the US and LATAM.

Role Overview

We are looking for an Senior R&D Engineer to support the development of wireless power and charging technologies. The role covers grant-related work, proof-of-concept prototype development, and coil design activities. The candidate should be hands-on and comfortable working across electrical design, PCB development, embedded/software coding, and wireless power coil design.

Key Responsibilities

Grant Writing and Project Documentation

  • Support the preparation of grant proposals, technical write-ups, project scopes, milestones, budgets, and deliverables.
  • Translate engineering concepts into clear technical documentation for internal stakeholders, grant agencies, and external partners.
  • Prepare progress reports, technical summaries, test results, and supporting materials for funded R&D projects.

Proof-of-Concept Prototype Development

  • Design, build, and validate proof-of-concept prototypes for wireless power and charging applications.
  • Perform electrical design, component selection, circuit bring-up, debugging, and performance testing.
  • Develop and maintain prototype test setups, including measurement procedures, fixtures, and validation plans.

PCB and Electrical Design

  • Design and review schematics and PCB layouts for power electronics, control circuits, sensing circuits, and wireless charging systems.
  • Work with PCB vendors and manufacturing partners to support fabrication, assembly, troubleshooting, and design revisions.
  • Ensure designs consider reliability, manufacturability, thermal performance, EMI/EMC behavior, and system safety.

Embedded / Software Development

  • Develop firmware or software for prototype control, monitoring, data acquisition, communication, and test automation.
  • Work with microcontrollers, sensors, communication interfaces, and control algorithms as required by the project.
  • Support debugging across hardware, firmware, and system integration layers.

Wireless Power Coil Design

  • Design, simulate, prototype, and test wireless power coils and magnetic structures.
  • Evaluate coil geometry, coupling, efficiency, thermal behavior, alignment tolerance, shielding, and foreign object detection considerations.
  • Support optimization of transmitter and receiver coil designs for target power levels, form factors, and application constraints.

Testing, Validation, and Reporting

  • Plan and execute experiments to evaluate system performance, efficiency, thermal behavior, electrical safety, and reliability.
  • Analyze test data, identify root causes of technical issues, and recommend design improvements.
  • Maintain clear engineering records, test reports, design notes, and project documentation.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related engineering discipline.
  • Hands-on experience in electrical design, PCB development, embedded systems, or power electronics.
  • Experience with laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, power supplies, electronic loads, network analyzers, LCR meters, and thermal measurement tools.
  • Ability to troubleshoot hardware and system-level issues independently and systematically.
  • Good technical writing skills and the ability to prepare clear reports, grant documents, and engineering documentation.
  • Strong ownership, practical problem-solving ability, and willingness to work hands-on with prototypes.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with wireless power transfer, inductive charging, resonant converters, magnetic design, or power electronics.
  • Experience with coil simulation, electromagnetic simulation, or tools such as ANSYS Maxwell, COMSOL, LTspice, MATLAB, Python, or equivalent platforms.
  • Experience with microcontroller firmware, communication protocols, control loops, or test automation.
  • Experience supporting government grants, R&D projects, or collaborative research programs.
  • Familiarity with EMI/EMC considerations, safety standards, thermal design, and product development workflows.

The ideal candidate is a practical engineer who can move between concept development, hands-on prototyping, testing, documentation, and technical communication. This person should be comfortable with ambiguity, able to learn quickly, and willing to take ownership of prototype development from early investigation through validation.

title: Stagiair Adviseur Vermogen regio Nijmegen
description:
Stagiair Adviseur Vermogen

Heeft beleggen jouw interesse? En sta je open voor een carrière binnen de financiële sector? Deze meewerkstage voor de periode vanaf februari 2027 betekent dat je onder begeleiding van een persoonlijke coach binnen Adviesteam Vermogen in- en outbound werkzaamheden verricht die een Adviseur Vermogen dagelijks doet. Afgestemd op jouw kennis en ervaring doorloop je, samen met maximaal drie andere stagiaires, een leertraject en ga je aan de slag met het (verder) ontwikkelen van jouw gespreksvaardigheden, sales skills en het behalen van de benodigde vakdiploma’s. Het doel is om je zelfstandig, op een ING locatie en digitaal (vanuit huis), te laten werken en dagelijks contact te laten hebben met particuliere- en zakelijke klanten over beleggen bij ING.

Leertraject fase 1:

  • Je start tegelijkertijd met maximaal vier stagiaires en komt te werken binnen het Digitaal Vermogen Team (DVT). Een groot team van adviseurs die het 1e aanspreekpunt zijn voor bestaande klanten in het ‘Guided model’ (belegd vermogen van € 50.000 tot € 500.000) én verantwoordelijk zijn voor de centrale leadgeneratie vanuit outbound-, inbound- en online activiteiten richting de commerciële teams van Adviesteam Vermogen en Private Banking.
  • Je gaat onder begeleiding van een persoonlijke coach vrijwel direct starten met klantcontact via outbound bellen om je gespreksvaardigheden ‘on the job’ te ontwikkelen en de Way of Working te leren. Indien nodig behaal je onder werktijd de benodigde vakdiploma’s waardoor je meer verschillende type klantcontacten mag afhandelen.

Leertraject fase 2:

  • Na het succesvol afronden van fase 1 ga je ‘echt’ aan het werk. De nadruk in deze fase ligt op het verder ontwikkelen van je (sales) vaardigheden en gaat het tempo van klantcontact omhoog via outbound- en inbound belwerkzaamheden.
  • Je krijgt targets en gaat deelnemen aan performance dialogen met de andere stagiaires met als doel om van elkaar te leren. Een persoonlijke coach blijft je gedurende deze periode begeleiden.
  • Je krijg presentaties van collega’s die jou gaan uitleggen wat zij doen en gaat op locatie meekijken. Hiermee krijg je een beter beeld van mogelijke banen binnen ING.

Wat vraagt deze stage van je?

Je wilt graag tijd investeren in het verder ontwikkelen van jouw gespreksvaardigheden en je ervaring in klantcontact. Beleggen heeft je interesse, je bent een goede gesprekspartner en wilt klanten graag helpen bij het maken van de juiste keuzes. Je bent sales gedreven, resultaat gericht, neemt initiatief en kunt goed omgaan met feedback. Verder:

  • Je studeert aan een Hbo-opleiding en spreekt vloeiend Nederlands.
  • Je hebt WFT Basis in je bezit of bent bereid deze te halen voordat je bij ons start. Het liefst heb je ook WFT Vermogen en/of MiFID Informeren of ben je bereid deze te halen. Alle opleidingskosten worden vergoed door ING.
  • Je bent flexibel inzetbaar en combineert thuiswerken met werken vanuit één van de hub locaties Den Haag, Eindhoven, Leeuwarden, Zaandam en Zwolle of vanuit een ING-huis bij jou in de buurt.

Wat bieden wij?

  • Een meewerkstage vanaf februari 2027 afgestemd op de eisen vanuit jouw opleiding.
  • Een persoonlijke coach en leren onder werktijd.
  • Een uitdagende en leerzame omgeving met veel inzichten over mogelijke werkzaamheden binnen ING.
  • Een marktconforme stagevergoeding van EURO 700,- (bruto) bij een 36-urige werkweek.

Jouw sollicitatie

Stuur je CV voorzien van een motivatie waarin je uitlegt wie je bent, waarom jij de juiste kandidaat bent voor dit leertraject en op welke wijze je affiniteit met beleggen en/of de financiële markten hebt? Wij maken graag kennis met je.

Heb je vragen? Stuur dan een mail naar Bart Janssen, Digitaal Vermogen Team: Bart.Janssen1@ing.com.

description:
D-Wave Quantum Inc. (NASDAQ: QBTS) is a leader in the development and delivery of quantum computing systems, software, and services. About The Role

D-Wave is seeking an experienced AI Platform DevOps Engineer to join our Product Development team. In this role, you will design, build, deploy, and operate AI-powered tools, platforms, and workflows that improve developer productivity, automate repetitive tasks, reduce operational overhead, and accelerate the delivery of our quantum computing technologies.

Working alongside talented DevOps engineers and Product Development teams, you will help build and evolve our internal AI platform, integrating technologies such as Amazon Bedrock, AI agents, n8n, Artifactory, ArgoCD, and other supporting services into scalable, secure, and reliable development workflows.

You will play a key role in designing and operating AI-powered development, on-call, and agentic workflows, partnering across engineering teams to prioritize, implement, and continuously improve AI initiatives that enable innovation across the organization.

  • Continuously monitor and improve the performance, durability, and reliability of our internal AI platform

  • Experience integrating third-party services and APIs, including REST-based integrations, within Linux-based environments
  • Ability to work independently, solve ambiguous technical problems, collaborate across teams, and translate business workflows into scalable technical solutions

A D-Waver's DNA

  • Education – Delivering evidence-based professional learning, technical assistance, direct services, and educational programs grounded in industry standards and best practices.

description:
About the Role

Join an early-stage enterprise AI automation company building the next generation of AI coworkers. In this hands-on engineering role, you will design, ship, and own production AI agents that observe real human workflows and automate the repetitive, time-consuming tasks within them — freeing teams to focus on high-value work. You'll operate end-to-end, from talking directly with customers to deploying and monitoring agents in production, and you'll have a direct impact on real-world efficiency gains across industries like financial services, insurance, and professional services.

The team moves fast, values pragmatic experimentation, and expects each member to own their work fully from idea to production.

What You'll Do

  • Turn observed, screen-based workflows into reliable, deployable AI agents that perform work autonomously.

  • Work closely with customers to understand their operations, gather requirements, and identify high-value automation opportunities.

  • Ship automations that measurably replace hours of manual, repetitive effort.

  • Own production AI agents end-to-end: design, build, deploy, monitor, and iterate.

  • Run structured experiments with new models, prompting techniques, and use cases; benchmark results and ship what works.

  • Maintain observability for live agents — metrics, dashboards, and alerting.

  • Design thoughtful AI × Human interfaces that make automation practical and trustworthy for end users.

What We're Looking For

Must-haves:

  • 5+ years of experience in ML/AI product development, with a strong focus on building and delivering production-grade AI agents.

  • Proven track record shipping LLM-based systems in production (not just prototypes).

  • End-to-end ownership of production AI agents: build → deploy → monitor → improve.

  • Strong Python programming skills and deep experience deploying LLMs and AI agents at scale.

  • Demonstrated ability to turn observed or documented workflows into deployable AI automations.

Strongly preferred:

  • Experience designing AI interfaces for effective human-AI collaboration.

  • Hands-on experimentation with emerging models and techniques, including benchmarking and solution selection.

  • Experience with observability and monitoring tooling for AI systems.

  • Comfort operating in early-stage, fast-moving environments with limited process overhead.

  • Customer-facing experience: gathering requirements, iterating on feedback, and communicating technical trade-offs clearly.

Work style:

  • Product-minded — you think about user outcomes, not just technical correctness.

  • End-to-end owner — you don't hand off; you see things through.

  • Collaborative but self-directed — you work well with customers and teammates and can chart your own path.

This role is on-site in Munich, Bavaria, Germany. Candidates must be willing and able to work from the Munich office. Visa sponsorship is not available — applicants must already have the right to work in Germany.

Compensation details were not provided for this listing. You will have the opportunity to discuss a competitive package, commensurate with experience, during the interview process.

title: AP Specialist - Vendor Maintenance
description:
Join Our Team as an AP Specialist – Vendor Maintenance!

Harris County, the third most populous county in the nation, provides an array of critical services to its community, including public health initiatives, disaster recovery efforts, toll road management, flood mitigation, and justice administration. The Harris County Auditor's Office plays an essential role in supporting these services by overseeing the financial operations of over 90 departments. Under the leadership of the County Auditor, the office includes the Accounting and Internal Audit divisions, ensuring integrity and efficiency in the county's fiscal management.

Ready to ignite your potential? Join our dynamic team as an AP Specialist – Vendor Maintenance and become an essential part of getting the work of Harris County done! We're not just looking for an AP Specialist; we're seeking a whiz who understands 1099s and payment reporting, is a stickler for the fine details, and can climb the mountain of tasks that accounts payable is responsible for in such a short amount of time. If you're passionate about accounts payable and making a real impact in the community you live in, your next exciting chapter starts here!

Why Join Us?

Harris County offers a dynamic, family-friendly workplace that prioritizes employee well-being and professional growth. Benefits include:

  • Competitive Pay: Up to $59,000, based on experience.
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Including a zero-premium medical plan for employees, with affordable coverage options for spouses and dependents.
  • Outstanding Retirement Plan.
  • Paid Parental Leave: Up to 12 weeks.
  • Generous Paid Time Off: Vacation, sick leave, 11 paid holidays, and 1 floating holiday.
  • Subsidized Transit/Commute assistance.
  • Prime Downtown Location: Newly renovated office in the heart of Downtown Houston.
  • Professional Development: Opportunities for growth and skill-building.
  • Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) Qualifying Employer.
  • Corporate Discounts and memberships.

About the Role

As an Accounts Payable Specialist, you will play an integral role in maintaining the integrity, compliance, timeliness, and accuracy of vendor data in the County that works with thousands of vendors throughout the year. This role demands flexibility to multi-task, problem-solving skills, a commitment to accuracy under pressure, and an ability to maintain professionalism in challenging situations.

The Accounts Payable department processes 1,500–2,000 claims daily - over 30,000 payments monthly, requiring an AP Specialist who values accuracy, efficiency, and exceptional customer service. While not a processor, this role makes hundreds of vendor updates monthly.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Serving as the general first point of contact when vendors seek to modify their profile. (such as bank account information, address, name changes etc.)
  • Ensuring all necessary documentation (e.g., valid W-9, proper banking information, voided checks) is made available to Purchasing for all new vendors being set up.
  • Returning problematic documentation to vendors and assisting them with completion by pointing out deficiencies.
  • Conducting a monthly review of all new and modified vendor profiles to ensure proper documentation is on file and the vendors information is accurate with regards to remittance address, reporting status, etc.
  • Performing calendar yearend tasks related to vendor maintenance in preparation for 1099 reporting, including the bulk e-Serve verification of all active vendors.
  • Escalating critical issues surrounding vendor set ups/changes to management when solutions are not easily reached.

Essential Requirement:

To be considered for this role, you'll need:

  • A high school diploma or equivalent.
  • One to three (1-3) years of experience in vendor/supplier management, purchasing, or a high-volume accounts payable invoicing environment.
  • Thorough understanding of the full cycle AP process and 1099 payment reporting requirement.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Microsoft Excel.

Ideal Attributes

Beyond the essentials, we're looking for someone who is:

  • Accuracy and Attention to Detail: It's crucial for maintaining the integrity, compliance, timeliness, and validity of vendor data.
  • Strong Communication Skills: Excellent verbal, listening, and written communication skills are required. The role involves being a primary point of contact for vendor data with diverse stakeholders, including external and internal business partners.
  • Organizational Skills: The ability to plan and organize multiple tasks simultaneously is needed. This is important for managing a complex workload with many moving parts.
  • Problem-Solving & Analytical Skills: Above-average problem-solving, critical thinking, and analytical skills are beneficial.
  • Technical Proficiency: Experience with PeopleSoft or similar ERP systems is a significant plus.
  • Customer Service Focus: A commitment to customer service is essential. This involves interacting with current and future vendors, responding to inquiries, assisting with documentation, and ensuring their accounts are set up correctly so they are eligible to receive payments.
  • Adaptability and Flexibility: The best candidates are adaptable and flexible with the office environment, work schedule, and assignments. They should be willing to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Reliability and Consistency: Being consistent and reliable is a key characteristic of successful individuals in this role. Regular and predictable attendance is required.

Work Environment:

  • Physical requirements include sitting for extended periods; lifting and pushing/pulling up to 40 lbs.
  • Work Schedule: Monday–Friday, 40 hours/week
  • May be required to work more than forty hours during the workweek or on weekends when special projects need to be completed, or deadlines need to be met.

Our Mission and Vision The mission of the Harris County Auditor's Office is to be a progressive, independent organization recognized for professionalism in fiscal oversight. Our vision is to foster sound financial management and operations at every level of county government while upholding the highest standards of integrity and stewardship.

title: Software Development, Lead Associate
description:
Responsibilities

Peraton is seeking a Mid-level DevSecOps Engineer to join our team of qualified, diverse professionals. In this role, you will support the security, reliability, and compliance of mission‑critical systems within the DME Program. The ideal candidate will play a key part in integrating security throughout the development lifecycle, maintaining adherence to federal cybersecurity standards, and ensuring the operational readiness of modernized systems at the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS). This position supports a highly visible environment where strong technical execution, security rigor, and cross‑team collaboration are essential.

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the Information System Security Officer (ISSO) for the ClaimsCore Program, ensuring full compliance with FISMA Moderate, FedRAMP Moderate, and CMS ARS 5.1 security requirements.
  • Prepare, maintain, and update all Certification and Accreditation (C&A) and Security Assessment and Authorization (SA&A) documentation, including System Security Plans (SSPs), Security Assessment Reports (SARs), Contingency Plans, and Plan of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms).
  • Conduct and document ongoing risk assessments, vulnerability assessments, and security control evaluations across the program’s cloud and on‑premises environments.
  • Manage and coordinate the Authority to Operate (ATO) lifecycle, including initial authorization, continuous monitoring, control implementation reviews, and audit preparation.
  • Ensure zero open Critical or High vulnerabilities at system go-live and maintain compliance with vulnerability remediation SLAs.
  • Respond to and manage security incident notifications within required timelines (1 hour for initial reporting). Coordinate with internal security teams and external stakeholders to support incident response processes.
  • Support internal and external audits, including CSRAP, CFO, OMB A‑123, and annual security assessments.
  • Collaborate with DevOps, engineering, and operations teams to integrate security best practices into CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and deployment processes.
  • Monitor and enhance security posture using tools such as vulnerability scanners, SIEM platforms, configuration management tools, and compliance automation platforms.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of security procedures, engineering practices, and system hardening baselines.
  • Assist in the implementation and maintenance of cloud security configurations aligned with agency and program requirements.
  • Provide security guidance during architecture reviews, design sessions, sprint planning, and change control processes.
  • Ensure security documentation, diagrams, inventories, and boundary definitions are accurate and up to date.

Qualifications

Qualifications (Required):

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or related field; additional experience may be substituted in lieu of degree.
  • 5 to 7 years of experience in cybersecurity, DevSecOps, or system engineering roles supporting federal programs.
  • Experience acting as an ISSO or security engineer for a FISMA Moderate or FedRAMP Moderate system.
  • Hands-on experience preparing security authorization documentation such as SSPs, SARs, POA&Ms, and Continuous Monitoring updates.
  • Strong understanding of NIST 800‑53 security controls, Risk Management Framework (RMF), CMS ARS 5.1, and continuous monitoring requirements.
  • Practical experience supporting or integrating security processes in DevSecOps pipelines, CI/CD workflows, or automated deployment environments.
  • Experience with vulnerability management tools and processes, including scanning, analysis, and remediation tracking.
  • Ability to support audits and communicate effectively with assessment teams, program stakeholders, and government security representatives.
  • U.S. citizenship and the ability to obtain and maintain a public trust or equivalent clearance.

Qualifications (Preferred):

  • Experience supporting CMS programs or other HHS components.
  • Familiarity with FedRAMP documentation, cloud boundary definitions, and cloud-native security practices.
  • Experience with AWS or Azure security services, cloud configuration baselines, and cloud compliance frameworks.
  • Working knowledge of tools commonly used within Peraton and similar enterprises, such as GitLab/GitHub CI/CD, Jenkins, Terraform, Ansible, Tenable, Splunk, or similar platforms.
  • Security certifications such as Security+, CISSP, CISM, CCSP, or AWS/Azure security certifications.
  • Experience integrating legacy systems into modern cloud or hybrid architectures with secure migration practices.
  • Knowledge of container security (Docker, Kubernetes) and infrastructure-as-code security scanning.

Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.
